icons.name: heart
icons.label: Heart
icons.intent: The heart gives one short acknowledgement beat and returns to its anchored resting pose.

icons.name: bell
icons.label: Bell
icons.intent: The bell rings. Light: the bell swings out from its mount, the clapper trails it and strikes, a ring arc flicks out on each side and fades as it spreads, and the swing decays back to rest in smaller beats. Strong: a wider swing that rings twice, once at each end of the swing, and the clapper chases the bell through a longer decay. The mount never moves.

icons.name: search
icons.label: Search
icons.intent: The search finds something. Light: the magnifier glides out to the left, scanning, and comes back to land on its spot with a hit; the lens pops as it finds, and a glint draws on inside the lens and fades. Strong: it scans left and then right before landing, the lens pops harder with a rebound, and the glint snaps on.

icons.name: star
icons.label: Star
icons.intent: The star is awarded and shines. Light: it gathers in, pops out with a rebound, and as it comes down from the pop five sparks flash out between its points and fade as they fly. Strong: a deeper gather with a counter-twist, then the star pops harder with a twist the other way, swings back through two decaying beats, and the sparks fly further.

icons.name: check
icons.label: Check
icons.intent: An explicit completion transition; the result remains until Reset is selected.

icons.name: sliders
icons.label: Sliders
icons.intent: The top handle over-drags and corrects; the lower handle answers with its own smaller over-drag before both return.

icons.name: lock
icons.label: Lock
icons.intent: A connected padlock closes and retains its state; Unlock is an explicit reverse.

icons.name: folder
icons.label: Folder
icons.intent: A complete front panel springs open from its bottom hinge; one sheet pops up behind it, then everything closes in one motion.

icons.name: crown
icons.label: Crown
icons.intent: The crown is placed and gleams, for premium. Light: the crown lifts off its band with a slight tilt, drops back onto it with a hit and a squash, the band gives under it, and a glint flashes off its upper right as it lands. Strong: a dip first, then the crown is raised higher, tilts one way and the other, lands with a hit and a smaller second bounce, and glints flash on both sides in turn.

icons.name: app-grid
icons.label: Apps
icons.intent: The app launcher opens. Light: the centre dot of the three-by-three grid pops, and the pop ripples out to the four edge dots and then to the four corner dots, each a beat later, before all settle. Strong: the whole grid first gathers in toward its centre, then bursts back out past its place as the pop ripples outward, and settles in two beats.

icons.name: cursor-click
icons.label: Click
icons.intent: The pointer clicks. Light: the arrow presses in toward its tip and stops with a hit, the three click rays blink out and burst back from the tip past their length, and the arrow springs back and settles. Strong: a double click, a first quick press with a small burst, then a deeper press with a bigger burst and a two-beat settle.

icons.name: puzzle-piece
icons.label: Extension
icons.intent: An extension snaps into place. Light: the puzzle piece is lifted out up and to the right with a slight tilt, then driven back down into its slot and stops with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: it is pulled out further, worked back in with a wiggle one way and the other, and pressed home with a hit, a rebound and a second, smaller hit.

icons.name: sticky-note
icons.label: Sticky note
icons.intent: A sticky note is jotted down. Light: the two lines of writing are written out across the note from the left, and the note dips under the pen and comes back. Strong: the note is slapped on first, swinging in from a tilt about its top corner and landing with a hit and a small bounce, then the two lines are written out.

icons.name: building
icons.label: Building
icons.intent: The office building lights up, for a company or organization. Light: the windows light up floor by floor from the ground, each pair popping bigger and settling a beat after the floor below. Strong: the same wave runs up faster and harder, then a second, smaller wave runs back down from the top floor. The building and door never move.

icons.name: shapes
icons.label: Shapes
icons.intent: The shapes pop into place in turn, for categories or design elements. Light: the triangle squeezes and pops with a twist, then the square a beat later twisting the other way, then the circle, each settling back. Strong: a harder round of pops in the same order, then a second, smaller round runs through them again.

icons.name: toolbox
icons.label: Toolbox
icons.intent: The toolbox is opened. Light: the lid pops up off the box, tipping back on its left hinge and carrying the handle, then claps shut with a hit and a small bounce. Strong: the lid rattles twice first, then is thrown open higher and slams shut, bouncing twice while the box jolts under it. The two latches stay on the box.

icons.name: cube
icons.label: Cube
icons.intent: The cube turns to show its depth, for a 3D object or model. Light: it turns a quarter of the way to its right, its front edge sweeping across as the left face widens and the right face narrows, then swings back square with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: it hops and turns further, swings back as it lands with a hit, then turns again a little less and settles.

icons.name: sitemap
icons.label: Sitemap
icons.intent: The sitemap branches out from its root page. Light: the root page is pressed and sends a link down: the stem draws down from it, the two branches draw out to the sides, and each child page pops as its branch reaches it, the left one first. Strong: a deeper press with a pop of the root as it sends, the links draw faster, and the child pages pop bigger and settle in two beats.

icons.name: infinity
icons.label: Infinity
icons.intent: A light runs the endless loop, for unlimited. Light: the infinity sign dims and a bright stroke traces it in one pass, through the right loop and back through the left, and as the trace closes the sign brightens and stretches a little wider before springing back. Strong: the stroke runs the loop twice, the second lap a little slower, and the sign stretches much wider and springs back in two beats as the second lap closes.

icons.name: handshake
icons.label: Handshake
icons.intent: Two hands shake on a deal, for a partnership or agreement. Light: the clasped hands and cuffs pump up, come down firmly with a hit, and three short rays flash above the clasp on the downbeat before everything settles. Strong: two pumps, the second smaller, with the rays flashing on each downbeat.

icons.name: download
icons.label: Download
icons.intent: A download lands. Light: the arrow drives down into the tray and stops dead; the tray takes the knock, rebounds and settles, and a content line draws out from the middle of the tray where the arrow lands. The spent arrow fades and a fresh one drops in from above to its rest pose, and the line fades as it settles. Strong: a short wind-up, a harder drive, a bigger knock that rebounds twice, and the line snaps out.

icons.name: upload
icons.label: Upload
icons.intent: The file goes up. Light: the arrow sinks to load, then launches up out of the tray; the tray recoils under the push, rebounds and settles, and the arrow overshoots and settles 2.2 units higher, where it stays. Strong: a deeper load, a harder launch that settles in two beats, and a bigger recoil that rebounds twice. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose.

icons.name: copy
icons.label: Copy
icons.intent: A copy is made. Light: the front sheet presses into its source, then slides out diagonally to its new place, overshoots and settles there; a check draws on inside the sheet as it leaves and fades once it has settled. Strong: a deeper press, a longer slide that settles in two beats, and the check snaps on. The source never moves. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose.

icons.name: trash
icons.label: Trash
icons.intent: Something is thrown away. Light: the lid flips open on its right-hand hinge, a crumpled scrap drops from under the raised edge into the bin and vanishes inside, and the lid drops shut with a hit and one chatter while the whole bin dips on contact. Strong: the lid flips wider and holds longer, two scraps drop in one after the other, and the lid slams with two chatters and a deeper dip.

icons.name: edit
icons.label: Edit
icons.intent: The pencil lifts, lands, drives the ink stroke quickly, then lifts with follow-through; the written mark stays.

icons.name: send
icons.label: Send
icons.intent: The message leaves. Light: the plane draws back, launches along its nose, overshoots and settles 2.4 units ahead, where it stays; three speed lines streak out behind its wings and tail as it goes and fade. Strong: a deeper draw-back, a longer launch that settles in two beats, and the streaks follow in turn. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose.

icons.name: bookmark
icons.label: Bookmark
icons.intent: The place is marked. Light: the ribbon lifts, then drops into the page, stretching as it falls, lands 1.2 lower with a hit and a squash, bounces once and stays seated. Strong: a higher lift, a harder drop with more stretch, a deeper squash and two decaying bounces before it seats. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose.

icons.name: refresh
icons.label: Refresh
icons.intent: Two arrow assemblies turn clockwise once and settle.

icons.name: eye
icons.label: Eye
icons.intent: Light makes one full fast blink. Strong glances wide, the lids snap shut and reopen with a damped flutter; the pupil remains clipped inside the aperture.

icons.name: menu
icons.label: Menu
icons.intent: The outer bars pull apart, then converge and rotate past the X before settling; the middle bar clears early and the reverse springs the three-bar menu back.

icons.name: eye-off
icons.label: Hide
icons.intent: The view is hidden. Light: a slash strikes down across the eye from top-left to bottom-right, and the eye flinches shut as it is struck, then reopens behind the slash with a small widening and settles; the slash stays. Strong: the eye squeezes fully shut first, the slash strikes across it and snaps a little past its length before settling, and the eye reopens with a flutter. Show reverses it: the slash retracts to the top-left and the eye pops wide open and settles.

icons.name: unlink
icons.label: Unlink
icons.intent: The link breaks. Light: the two halves of the chain slide together along their axis until they hook into each other like a link, then snap apart past their place with a jolt, rebound and settle; the break marks burst out on both sides of the gap as they part. Strong: they hook together and tug once against each other, then tear apart harder, overshoot farther and settle in two beats, and the break marks burst out wider. The halves are rigid; they only slide along their shared axis.

icons.name: scroll-to-top
icons.label: Scroll to top
icons.intent: The page jumps back to the top. Light: the arrow dips to load, then shoots up and stops dead against the top bar; the bar takes the knock, rebounds and settles. The spent arrow fades at the top and a fresh one rises from below into its place. Strong: a deeper load, the same hard stop, and a bigger knock that rebounds twice.

icons.name: screenshot
icons.label: Screenshot
icons.intent: The screen is captured. Light: the two capture brackets on the screen snap in on the region and lock with a hit, a flash fills the screen and fades, and the brackets spring back out past their place and settle. Strong: the brackets open a touch first, then capture twice in a burst, two snaps and two flashes, and spring back out farther before they settle. The monitor never moves.

icons.name: new-file
icons.label: New file
icons.intent: A new file is created. Light: the page gathers in, then springs out past its size and settles, and the plus on it is drawn on again from its top and left ends as it springs. Strong: the page gathers in deeper and springs out farther in two beats, and the plus snaps on.

icons.name: backspace
icons.label: Backspace
icons.intent: A character is deleted backwards. Light: the key is struck back toward its point and stops with a hit while its cross is drawn on again, then it rebounds and settles. Strong: two quick strikes, the second deeper, and the cross is drawn on again with each one, like a held backspace.

icons.name: embed
icons.label: Embed
icons.intent: A code snippet is embedded. Light: the slash lifts out and the brackets part to make room, then the slash drops back in between them from above and stops dead, and the brackets clamp shut on it, close a little past their place and settle. Strong: the brackets part wider, the slash drops from higher and lands with a bounce, and the brackets slam shut and rebound twice.

icons.name: restart
icons.label: Restart
icons.intent: The device restarts. Light: the power bar drops down into the ring, switching off; the ring with its arrow turns one full turn clockwise, and as its gap comes back round to the top the bar shoots back up into it, switching on with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: the ring winds back first, spins past the top and settles back, and the bar slams up and rebounds twice.

icons.name: tap
icons.label: Tap
icons.intent: A finger taps the screen. Light: the hand presses in toward its fingertip and stops with a hit, the touch ring above the fingertip spreads out and fades as it lands, and the hand springs back while a fresh ring grows back in place. Strong: a double tap, two quick presses, the second deeper, each sending a ring out wider.

icons.name: swipe
icons.label: Swipe
icons.intent: A finger swipes across the screen. Light: the hand eases back a touch, then swipes left under the arrow, runs a little past and settles; the arrow's left head kicks out as the finger reaches it, and the hand glides back to the middle. Strong: the hand swipes left and then all the way right, each head kicking out in turn as the finger reaches it, before the hand settles back in the middle.

icons.name: home
icons.label: Home
icons.intent: Welcome home: the front door opens. Light: the door leaf swings out on its left hinge, past edge-on, until it lies open against the wall beside the doorway, knocks and bounces once, and soft light shows in the empty doorway; then the door swings shut, latches with a hit and a small rebound, and the light goes out. Strong: the door is flung open, bounces twice against the wall, holds open longer with brighter light, and slams shut with a rebound and a second, smaller knock. The house never moves.

icons.name: calendar
icons.label: Calendar
icons.intent: A complete date leaf lifts, flips fast over the binding line and lands; its date mark stays on the paper and the next page is exposed.

icons.name: clock
icons.label: Clock
icons.intent: A quarter of an hour passes. Light: the minute hand sweeps from 12 to 3 in one fast move, lands with a hit, recoils and settles; the hour hand is geared to it at a true 12:1 and creeps on 7.5 degrees. Strong: the minute hand jumps in three 5-minute ticks, each a hit with a recoil, the last the hardest with a second, smaller recoil. The hands never pass the new time, the case never moves, and the new time holds.

icons.name: camera
icons.label: Camera
icons.intent: A photo is taken. Light: the shutter button clicks down, the iris snaps shut behind the lens and the flash fires: three rays burst up from the top of the camera and fade; the iris springs back open and the button pops up with a small rebound. Strong: burst mode: two shots in turn, the button clicks twice, the iris blinks twice and the flash fires twice, the second harder. The body and lens never move.

icons.name: image
icons.label: Image
icons.intent: The picture is reframed to a new crop. Light: the landscape swipes left inside the fixed frame, its left hill sliding out past the edge, overshoots the new crop a little and snaps back into it; the sun is farther away and follows the hills a beat later, so the scene has depth. Strong: a faster, longer swipe that overshoots further and settles in two beats, with the sun trailing further behind. The frame never moves and the new crop holds.

icons.name: mail
icons.label: Mail
icons.intent: The full triangular flap springs open above its seam, a letter pops from the pocket and settles; the letter returns before the flap closes.

icons.name: message
icons.label: Message
icons.intent: A bouncing typing cadence passes through three dots, one reply at a time, then all three return to rest.

icons.name: phone
icons.label: Phone
icons.intent: An incoming call: the phone rings. Light: two ring arcs flick out of the open corner beside the earpiece, inner then outer, and fade, while the rigid handset rattles about its centre in two decaying beats. Strong: two bursts of rings, ring, pause, ring, and the handset rattles through each burst.

icons.name: microphone
icons.label: Microphone
icons.intent: Sound arrives and the microphone takes it. Light: one pair of sound arcs travels in from the upper sides and fades into the capsule; the capsule dips in its cradle on arrival and settles. Strong: two waves arrive in turn and the shock-mounted capsule takes two decaying hits. The stand never moves.

icons.name: volume
icons.label: Volume
icons.intent: Sound emphasis travels from the near arc to the far arc; in Strong each arc is pushed outward and springs back while the speaker stays fixed.

icons.name: wifi
icons.label: Wi-Fi
icons.intent: Signal acquires from the source outward; in Strong each band gathers in, snaps to full strength and settles into its retained connected state.

icons.name: cloud
icons.label: Cloud
icons.intent: The wind blows the cloud. Light: two speed lines streak in from the left above it, one after the other, and fade; the gust shoves the cloud right, and it drifts back with one small rebound. Strong: two gusts in turn: the lines streak twice and the cloud is shoved twice, further the second time, before it drifts back and settles.

icons.name: sun
icons.label: Sun
icons.intent: The sun comes out. Light: a wave of light runs clockwise from the top ray: each ray pulls back into the disc and shines out again in turn, and the disc swells once as the light goes out. Strong: the rays shine out past their length and spring back in turn while the ring of rays turns a little with the light and springs back, and the disc swells harder.

icons.name: moon
icons.label: Moon
icons.intent: Night falls. Light: the crescent rocks back on its curve and settles in two shrinking beats while two sparkle stars twinkle in beside it, one after the other, and fade. Strong: the crescent rocks deeper with more decaying beats, and each star twinkles twice before it fades.

icons.name: location
icons.label: Location
icons.intent: The pin drops onto its place. Light: the rigid pin lifts, drops and lands on its tip with a hit and a small rebound, and a ground ripple spreads out from the tip and fades. Strong: a higher drop, a bounce and a second, smaller landing, with a ripple on each contact.

icons.name: compass
icons.label: Compass
icons.intent: The needle seeks north. Light: the needle kicks 40 degrees off its bearing, swings back past it and settles in shrinking swings (40, -16, 7, -2.5). Strong: a bigger kick and two more swings (75, -36, 17, -8, 3) before it locks on. The case never moves.

icons.name: link
icons.label: Link
icons.intent: The link connects. Light: the two loops draw apart along the chain until they barely hold, then snap back into each other with a hit; click marks flash out from both sides of the join and the loops rebound a touch and settle. Strong: they draw apart further, snap together harder, knock a second time with a smaller bounce, and the click marks flash out twice. The loops are rigid; they only slide along their shared axis.

icons.name: shield
icons.label: Shield
icons.intent: The shield leans in, takes the hit, and rings down through two damped corrections at its lower point. Strong redirects one incoming signal at the edge while the attached check stays stable.

icons.name: cart
icons.label: Cart
icons.intent: An item is added to the cart. Light: a parcel drops in from above and disappears behind the rim into the basket; as it lands, the basket and handle dip on the wheels with a hit, rebound and settle. Strong: two parcels drop in turn, the second one harder, and the basket takes two decaying hits. The wheels never move.

icons.name: settings
icons.label: Settings
icons.intent: The rigid gear sweeps through two detents in one movement and springs into its final index.

icons.name: user
icons.label: User
icons.intent: The person perks up to say hello. Light: the shoulders crouch, the head pops up and lands back with a small bounce, and the shoulders stretch up with it and squash as it lands. Strong: a deeper crouch, a higher pop and a firmer landing, then a second, smaller hop before it settles. The head stays round.

icons.name: users
icons.label: Users
icons.intent: The group says hello in turn. Light: the person at the back crouches, pops up and lands with a bounce, and a beat later the person in front answers with a smaller hop; shoulders stretch with each pop and squash on each landing. Strong: a higher pop and a second hop at the back, each echoed by the front person a beat later. Heads stay round.

icons.name: key
icons.label: Key
icons.intent: The key unlocks. Light: the rigid key pushes in along its shaft and seats with a dead stop, turns on its inserted tip and stops with a click, then turns back and withdraws, quicker and smaller than the action. Strong: a short draw-back before a harder push that bounces on seating, a wider turn that clicks and rebounds, then the same quick return. The key never bends.

icons.name: scan
icons.label: Scan
icons.intent: The scanner locks focus, then reads. Light: the four brackets snap in on the target and spring back out, then the scan bar crosses the frame at a steady speed and stops dead at the lower edge. Strong: a deeper focus snap, the same steady pass, and on arrival the brackets squeeze once more to confirm the capture. The bar holds at the lower edge.

icons.name: battery
icons.label: Battery
icons.intent: Power arrives and the battery charges. Light: a bolt strikes down into the empty cell, then the level sweeps across it to the retained charge in one decisive fill and the bolt is absorbed. Strong: a harder strike, then the level climbs in three ticks, each smaller, and holds. The level never overshoots; the shell and terminal never move.

icons.name: plug
icons.label: Plug
icons.intent: The plug connects. Light: it draws back, then pushes home into its rest pose with a hit; impact ticks flash out from the top corners where the face meets the socket, the plug rebounds a little and seats, and the cable whips a beat behind and settles. Strong: a deeper draw-back, a harder push that knocks twice, two flashes of ticks, and a bigger cable whip.

icons.name: bluetooth
icons.label: Bluetooth
icons.intent: The Bluetooth rune keeps its geometry while an upper-path signal leads the lower response.

icons.name: monitor
icons.label: Monitor
icons.intent: A stationary display wakes its content, then the Strong layout resolves into two panels.

icons.name: smartphone
icons.label: Smartphone
icons.intent: A clipped content stack scrolls inside a stationary phone; Strong flicks quickly and decelerates into the next item.

icons.name: laptop
icons.label: Laptop
icons.intent: The laptop opens and wakes. Light: the rigid lid swings up from the hinge, overshoots its working angle a little and settles back, and a glint draws across the screen and fades as it comes on. Strong: the lid cracks open first, then swings up harder with a bigger overshoot and two settling swings before the glint. The base and hinge never move; the lid holds open.

icons.name: printer
icons.label: Printer
icons.intent: The printer feeds the page out. Light: the rollers draw the blank sheet down into the top and, a beat later, push the printed page out of the slot in one quick feed that stops dead; the printed line rides on the page. Strong: the page comes out in two chunks, the second shorter, each stopping dead like a stepping feed. The page is a fixed size and never overshoots; the housing never moves.

icons.name: document
icons.label: Document
icons.intent: Ink writes left to right, with the second line following the first; the completed document holds.

icons.name: clipboard
icons.label: Clipboard
icons.intent: Something is put on the clipboard. Light: the clip tips open on its hinge and the old lines fade away, then the clip snaps shut on the new sheet with a small bounce and its two lines write on, top line first. Strong: the clip opens wider, slams shut with a bounce and a settle, and the lines write on more deliberately. The board never moves.

icons.name: book
icons.label: Book
icons.intent: One complete leaf bows across a fixed spine, exposes the next page, and settles on the left.

icons.name: credit-card
icons.label: Credit card
icons.intent: Tap to pay. Light: the rigid card dips onto the reader and holds the tap; two contactless waves draw on above it from the centre outward, inner then outer, and fade before the card lifts back with a small overshoot. Strong: a firmer tap that bounces once on contact and holds while the waves signal twice, then a clear rebound on release. The reader never moves.

icons.name: wallet
icons.label: Wallet
icons.intent: The leather flap pivots from its right seam; its round clasp follows the hinge, Strong exposes and reseats one card edge, then the flap closes.

icons.name: gift
icons.label: Gift
icons.intent: The gift opens with a surprise. Light: the lid pops up with a tilt, a spark flashes out of the gap on each side, and the lid drops back and bounces once; the bow rides on the lid and swings a beat behind it. Strong: the lid knocks once from inside, then pops higher with more tilt, a fan of two sparks flashes out of each side, and the lid lands with two decaying bounces. The box never moves.

icons.name: flag
icons.label: Flag
icons.intent: The flag is planted to mark the spot. Light: the flag lifts and plants with a dead stop, and the cloth whips once from the impact and settles. Strong: a higher lift (kept 1.4 inside the canvas), a harder plant that bounces once while two ground puffs flash out sideways at the foot of the pole, and the cloth whips harder with a decaying flutter. The pole stays rigid.

icons.name: chart
icons.label: Chart
icons.intent: Three data bars rise from one baseline into staggered target values and retain the result without overshooting the data.

icons.name: filter
icons.label: Filter
icons.intent: The filter is applied and the list narrows. Light: a push passes down through the funnel: the full-width source dips, then each tier below dips in turn and narrows as it passes, stopping dead at its result width. Strong: a deeper push with a rebound, the same narrowing in order, then a second smaller push follows through. The source keeps its width; the widths are data and never overshoot.

icons.name: keyframes
icons.label: Keyframes
icons.intent: Cause: playhead press. Action: track clears. Response: a rigid diamond appears. Result: two keys remain; the preview resets separately.

icons.name: ai-assistant
icons.label: AI assistant
icons.intent: The assistant thinks, then replies. Light: the orbit whips one turn round the core and comes to rest; as it lands the core flashes bigger (the answer forms) and the speech bubble swells once a beat later as the reply goes out, then both settle. Strong: the orbit winds back before the turn, overshoots its stop and settles; the core flashes harder and the bubble swells further with a second, smaller swing.

icons.name: prompt
icons.label: Prompt
icons.intent: The cursor blinks, text is typed in three chunks, the prompt mark nudges as it submits.

icons.name: system-instructions
icons.label: System instructions
icons.intent: The root issues a new rule and it is written into the tree. Light: the root node presses and sends; the spine runs on below the last rule and the new rule writes out to the right, overshoots its length a little and settles; the root springs back as the rule lands. Strong: the root presses harder, the instruction ripples down the existing rules in turn (each stretches out from the spine and springs back), then the new rule writes out, overshoots further and settles twice. Rules never leave the spine.

icons.name: context-window
icons.label: Context window
icons.intent: The oldest token drops out, the remaining tokens shift one slot left, a new token arrives on the right.

icons.name: response-stream
icons.label: Response stream
icons.intent: The cursor blinks, the third line arrives in three chunks with the cursor leading, then idles.

icons.name: autocomplete
icons.label: Autocomplete
icons.intent: The ghost suggestion clears, then the typed text and caret advance together to accept it

icons.name: rewrite
icons.label: Rewrite
icons.intent: Text erases and retypes longer; Strong first withdraws and redraws the rewrite arrow before typing in two passes

icons.name: summarize
icons.label: Summarize
icons.intent: Lines contract to an uneven summary above a fixed chevron; Strong gathers the outer lines first and the chevron dips once

icons.name: translate
icons.label: Translate
icons.intent: A and 文 stay put; an underline arrow draws from the source glyph to the target and opens its head

icons.name: brainstorm
icons.label: Brainstorm
icons.intent: Rays stretch from the bulb; Strong draws them in, bursts them in sequence, then settles

icons.name: reasoning
icons.label: Reasoning
icons.intent: A thought works its way through the chain, step by step. Light: the thought hops out of the first node, arcs over and drops into the second with a hit, and the node takes it with a pop; a beat later it hops on and drops into the third, which pops too. Every visited node keeps its mark. Strong: the first node gathers and launches the thought, the hops are higher, and each node takes a harder pop and settles. The links never move.

icons.name: conversation-branch
icons.label: Conversation branch
icons.intent: A reply branch swings outward from the fork and activates; Strong lets the other branch yield first

icons.name: prompt-template
icons.label: Prompt template
icons.intent: A slot fills inside the brackets; Strong parts the brackets before the fill and closes them after

icons.name: tone-control
icons.label: Tone control
icons.intent: The needle swings to the chosen setting; Strong winds back slightly, then travels and stops exactly on it

icons.name: answer-compare
icons.label: Answer compare
icons.intent: Two candidate answers; the chosen one lifts while the other settles lower. Strong weighs both first

icons.name: follow-up
icons.label: Follow-up
icons.intent: The thread arrow under the bubble extends to ask again; Strong first bounces the typing dots in turn

icons.name: intent-detection
icons.label: Intent detection
icons.intent: The reticle locks onto the message and the intent is found. Light: the four ticks pull out a hair, then clamp in on the bubble with a hit; the lock dot pops into the bubble's centre on the clamp, and the ticks spring back to their locked distance. Strong: the reticle flares out and turns as it searches, swings back and clamps twice, each smaller, and the dot pops bigger and settles. The bubble never moves.

icons.name: response-length
icons.label: Response length
icons.intent: Drag the handle right and every line extends with it; Strong extends in two deliberate steps with a held middle setting

icons.name: conversation-memory
icons.label: Conversation memory
icons.intent: Recall sweeps up the stack: a marker grows beside each remembered row; Strong nudges each row forward as it is recalled

icons.name: structured-output
icons.label: Structured output
icons.intent: Two lines indent under the first and gain key markers; Strong lets the brace flex once the structure nests

icons.name: knowledge-base
icons.label: Knowledge base
icons.intent: A query pulls the middle volume up out of a three-volume shelf. Strong dips first, over-pulls, settles, and the neighbours lean into the gap and recover.

icons.name: semantic-search
icons.label: Semantic search
icons.intent: Under the lens a flat text line turns into a meaning wave, hump by hump. Strong presses the lens onto the page first, then the wave forms with a small flexible overshoot.

icons.name: citations
icons.label: Citations
icons.intent: Two quotation marks state a claim; a footnote rule draws beneath them, anchor tick first, then the source line. Strong stamps the marks down before the rule draws.

icons.name: embeddings
icons.label: Embeddings
icons.intent: A token appears at the origin and travels out along its vector to sit near an existing point. Strong prepares at the origin, places the token decisively, then settles with bounded spatial follow-through. Existing data never moves.

icons.name: knowledge-graph
icons.label: Knowledge graph
icons.intent: A new edge grows from the hub to an unlinked node, which snaps into place as it connects. Strong leans the hub toward it first and lets the linked neighbours rebalance afterwards.

icons.name: document-chat
icons.label: Document chat
icons.intent: The document types its answer. Light: the cursor dot on the last line hops once like a typing indicator, and the reply line types out from it. Strong: the cursor hops twice, the reply types out in two words, and the finished line drops into place with a small kick and settles. The bubble and the first two lines never move. Ends with the reply line written.

icons.name: source-grounding
icons.label: Source grounding
icons.intent: The statement lands on its source and the ground takes it. Light: the statement block lifts on its stem and drops back onto it with a hit, and the impact runs down through the ground symbol: each bar dips slightly and flares wider in turn, top to bottom. Strong: a higher lift, a harder slam and a second small landing, with a wave through the ground on each contact. The stem stretches with the block and the ground symbol stays where it is.

icons.name: retrieve-context
icons.label: Retrieve context
icons.intent: A card lifts from its reader slot and its retrieved line writes.

icons.name: vector-store
icons.label: Vector store
icons.intent: Three vectors are pulled down onto a crate lid and stored.

icons.name: dataset
icons.label: Dataset
icons.intent: A table gains a new row and a value is entered into it.

icons.name: classification
icons.label: Classification
icons.intent: A token is sorted into a bin. Light: the token drops down the stem onto the splitter, the splitter tips left under it like a switch, the token rolls down the left arm and lands in the left bin, which takes the hit and settles while the splitter rights itself. Strong: the splitter first tips right (the token hesitates), then commits left; the token lands harder and the bin rebounds twice. Ends with the token in the left bin.

icons.name: clustering
icons.label: Clustering
icons.intent: Scattered points gather around two cluster centroids.

icons.name: entity-extraction
icons.label: Entity extraction
icons.intent: An entity is pulled out of the text and the text closes behind it. Light: the entity pill pops up out of its line, overshoots and settles above it, and as it clears, the two halves of the line snap shut with a hit. Strong: the pill sticks for a moment (a tug down), then pops out higher, swells as it drops back onto its place above the text and settles with two swings; the line halves snap shut, rebound and snap again. Ends with the pill above the closed line.

icons.name: fact-check
icons.label: Fact check
icons.intent: A stamp presses down and leaves a checkmark imprint.

icons.name: source-rank
icons.label: Source rank
icons.intent: A source is promoted on the podium. Light: the right column shoots up past the left one while the left sinks, overshoots and settles, and a rank-up chevron flies off its top and fades. Strong: the columns crouch the other way first, then swap harder with two settling swings, and two chevrons fly up in turn. Ends with the right column higher than the left, as in v1.

icons.name: index-data
icons.label: Index data
icons.intent: Entries are written onto a tabbed divider while its back tab is pulled and reseated.

icons.name: deduplicate
icons.label: Deduplicate
icons.intent: The duplicate record dissolves and the survivor recentres.

icons.name: data-cleaning
icons.label: Data cleaning
icons.intent: A broom sweeps three specks off the canvas.

icons.name: context-attach
icons.label: Context attach
icons.intent: A pushpin drops onto a note card and the attached context writes.

icons.name: long-term-memory
icons.label: Long-term memory
icons.intent: A memory vault dial turns to its next locked position.

icons.name: image-generate
icons.label: Image generate
icons.intent: A prompt becomes a picture: the easel stays rigid while a hill rises from the horizon line and a sun dawns beside it.

icons.name: generative-fill
icons.label: Generative fill
icons.intent: A photo with a missing corner region receives a generated tile that slides in and seats flush, completing the picture.

icons.name: background-remove
icons.label: Background remove
icons.intent: The portrait backdrop behind a cut-out subject splits at the centre, slides apart and fades; the subject stays in place as the retained result.

icons.name: object-select
icons.label: Object select
icons.intent: A pointer arrives and touches an object; a three-quarter selection ring opens around the object toward the pointer and stays as the selection.

icons.name: image-upscale
icons.label: Image upscale
icons.intent: The corner handle drags the image up to a larger size. Light: the drag arrow shoots out to the upper right and settles, and the frame stretches after it from the small original, overshoots a little and settles. Strong: the arrow tugs in toward the image first, then yanks out further, and the frame follows with a bigger overshoot and two settling swings. The original stays anchored bottom-left. Ends with the large frame, as in v1.

icons.name: style-transfer
icons.label: Style transfer
icons.intent: A wipe rod slides across a framed photo; each ridge it crosses softens into painted strokes and stays painted.

icons.name: smart-crop
icons.label: Smart crop
icons.intent: Two crop corners slide in around the subject, then the missing corners draw to close the frame.

icons.name: image-caption
icons.label: Image caption
icons.intent: The picture is read, then a two-line caption is typed beneath it and stays written.

icons.name: text-to-speech
icons.label: Text to speech
icons.intent: A rounded letter A speaks: sound arcs grow outward from its side and remain.

icons.name: speech-to-text
icons.label: Speech to text
icons.intent: Voice bars settle into pills as their words are written out in chunks below and stay.

icons.name: voice-chat
icons.label: Voice chat
icons.intent: Two fixed speech bubbles take turns speaking. Strong leaves a listening pause before the second voice replies.

icons.name: audio-generate
icons.label: Audio generate
icons.intent: A source node generates a waveform. Strong gathers the signal, extends it, and settles the last response.

icons.name: audio-clean
icons.label: Audio clean
icons.intent: A filter envelope closes around uneven audio and levels its peaks in a left-to-right pass.

icons.name: music-generate
icons.label: Music generate
icons.intent: One note becomes a beamed pair. Strong adds a short pickup, then each attached note answers the rhythm.

icons.name: video-generate
icons.label: Video generate
icons.intent: A hinged clapper opens and closes. The slate and board receive the impact together, then return to still.

icons.name: storyboard
icons.label: Storyboard
icons.intent: Panel one is drawn; panels two to four are sketched in order. Strong sketches each mark faintly, dwells, then inks it.

icons.name: motion-generate
icons.label: Motion generate
icons.intent: A ball runs a path drawn 15% ahead of it; opaque in-betweens appear once the ball has cleared them. Strong pulls back first, overshoots the exit tangent by 0.8, then settles.

icons.name: code-generate
icons.label: Code generate
icons.intent: Two lines are typed between brackets; the cursor blinks off to wrap, on at the next line. Strong opens the brackets, types with word pauses, blinks once, closes them.

icons.name: code-explain
icons.label: Code explain
icons.intent: A callout unfolds under a code line, then two explanation lines are written. Strong pinches the brackets to select the code, unfolds, annotates, then releases.

icons.name: code-review
icons.label: Code review
icons.intent: The slash of a code sign bends into a check. Strong grips with the brackets, releases, morphs with a bounded tip overshoot, holds.

icons.name: ai-agent
icons.label: AI agent
icons.intent: Lens scans right; Strong nods the antenna first and settles the body

icons.name: agent-team
icons.label: Agent team
icons.intent: Peers raise antennas in turn; Strong has the lead signal first

icons.name: tool-call
icons.label: Tool call
icons.intent: The tool is called and does its job. Light: the wrench drives along its jaw onto the hex port, seats with a hit and a small rebound, then torques: the nut snaps a sixth of a turn to its next flat while the wrench kicks clockwise and springs back. Strong: the wrench pulls back first, drives in harder, and turns the nut one flat in two decaying ratchet strokes (40 then 20 degrees). Light and Strong both end a sixth of a turn on, which is the same drawing, so the seated wrench and the nut are the result.

icons.name: agent-workflow
icons.label: Agent workflow
icons.intent: Packet leaves the trunk and follows the upper branch into its node

icons.name: task-plan
icons.label: Task plan
icons.intent: The plan unrolls step by step. Light: the second step shoots out from its marker into a full bar and snaps against its end, and the third follows 100 ms later, each with a small rebound. Strong: the steps unroll one at a time, each overshooting its end and settling, so the plan visibly lands in order. The first step never moves; the prepared state shows the later steps as markers.

icons.name: agent-handoff
icons.label: Agent handoff
icons.intent: The sender unit leans and pushes the payload bead along the bus; the receiver nods on receipt and keeps the payload.

icons.name: approval-step
icons.label: Approval step
icons.intent: A request token waits at a closed gate; approval lifts the bar and the token passes through. Open gate and passed token stay.

icons.name: guardrails
icons.label: Guardrails
icons.intent: An agent disc drifts off lane, meets the rail exactly, the rail gives, and the disc is steered back to a clean lane.

icons.name: model-router
icons.label: Model router
icons.intent: The switch arm pivots on its hub from the middle port to the selected top port and holds that setting.

icons.name: model-training
icons.label: Model training
icons.intent: The ball rolls down the loss bowl on its inner contour and settles at the minimum; Strong overshoots the far slope and searches back. The minimum stays.

icons.name: fine-tune
icons.label: Fine-tune
icons.intent: A struck tuning fork rings and holds its pitch marks.

icons.name: model-evaluation
icons.label: Model evaluation
icons.intent: The model is weighed. Light: a weight drops onto the left pan, the beam tips under it, swings back past level and settles level as the reading is taken and the weight fades. Strong: the model drops onto the left pan and the beam tips hard, then a reference weight drops onto the right pan and swings it back; the beam rocks in decaying beats to level and both weights fade. The pans hang plumb from the beam ends; the post and base never move.

icons.name: confidence-score
icons.label: Confidence score
icons.intent: Evidence comes in and confidence rises. Light: the interval clamps in on the estimate and stops dead, the estimate condenses with a quick squeeze, and the score marker follows along the axis and lands on its higher score. Strong: two samples arrive: the interval clamps in two decaying steps, the estimate squeezes at each, and the marker steps up twice. The interval and the score never overshoot; the tight interval and the higher score stay.

icons.name: inference
icons.label: Inference
icons.intent: Inputs are consumed by the node and the output extends.

icons.name: batch-inference
icons.label: Batch inference
icons.intent: The whole batch is submitted at once. Light: the three cards drive right as one block until the top and bottom cards strike the collector's arm tips, rebound and settle pushed in; the collector takes the impact a beat later and springs back. Strong: the batch winds back first, drives in harder and settles in two beats, and the collector is knocked further and settles in two beats. The cards stay pushed in.

icons.name: local-model
icons.label: Local model
icons.intent: On-device model: the chip core spins up to a locked angle and every pin seats outward.

icons.name: model-deploy
icons.label: Model deploy
icons.intent: A model unit lowers into its serving dock, seats, and its status lamp comes on.

icons.name: model-version
icons.label: Model version
icons.intent: A new version is cut. Light: a new branch draws up out of the trunk and turns toward the right, and the new version record pops out of its tip with an overshoot and settles. Strong: the branch shoots up faster and the record slides out along it from the elbow, overshoots its place and settles in two beats. The two earlier versions never move; the new branch and record stay.

icons.name: usage-meter
icons.label: Usage meter
icons.intent: The needle sweeps to current usage and the limit mark appears ahead of it.

icons.name: ai-connection
icons.label: AI connection
icons.intent: The cable swings from one node onto the other, settles, and the lower link completes.

icons.name: loading-spinner
icons.label: Loading spinner
icons.intent: Three vanes pass the signal clockwise; Strong carries momentum through a larger clockwise sweep.

icons.name: loading-dots
icons.label: Loading dots
icons.intent: A three-dot relay: each landing cues the next dot; Strong adds a small return from contact.

icons.name: progress-ring
icons.label: Progress ring
icons.intent: Four fixed sectors confirm progress clockwise and keep the completed value.

icons.name: progress-steps
icons.label: Progress steps
icons.intent: The progress line advances between three milestones; Strong advances continuously through the fixed checkpoints.

icons.name: hourglass
icons.label: Hourglass
icons.intent: Sand drains through a fixed neck into the lower chamber; Strong makes the transfer readable in two stages.

icons.name: queued
icons.label: Queued
icons.intent: The leading ticket advances to its stop; the waiting tickets follow in order.

icons.name: paused
icons.label: Paused
icons.intent: Two brake bars separate and lock into place; Strong seats the left bar before the right.

icons.name: cancelled
icons.label: Cancelled
icons.intent: A second diagonal closes the cancellation mark; the completed cross stays visible.

icons.name: error
icons.label: Error
icons.intent: A rigid exclamation stem strikes downward; the dot receives the contact and settles.

icons.name: warning
icons.label: Warning
icons.intent: The alarm goes off. Light: the exclamation stem is struck down from the top and stops dead above its dot; the strike buzzes the whole sign in a quick decaying side-to-side shake while two alarm flashes draw out beside the apex and fade. Strong: a harder strike, a wider and longer buzz, and the flashes go off twice. The sign stays rigid.

icons.name: info
icons.label: Info
icons.intent: The dot cues a written information stem and its short foot; the completed letter remains.

icons.name: help
icons.label: Help
icons.intent: A question is asked. Light: the question hook writes itself on from its top-left tip, over the curve and down the stem, and the dot pops in under it as the punctuation and settles. Strong: the question mark swings in from a quizzical tilt while it writes, overshoots upright and settles, and the dot pops harder with a second rebound. The ring never moves.

icons.name: no-results
icons.label: No results
icons.intent: A scan crosses the lens once, then an empty-result dash records the answer.

icons.name: empty-state
icons.label: Empty state
icons.intent: The last card lifts clear of the tray and disappears; the empty container stays visible.

icons.name: offline
icons.label: Offline
icons.intent: The signal recedes from outside in as a diagonal records the offline state; the final bands retain clear contrast.

icons.name: reconnect
icons.label: Reconnect
icons.intent: The two plugs pull clear, align, and seat; disconnect is an explicit reverse action.

icons.name: cloud-sync
icons.label: Cloud sync
icons.intent: Data goes up and comes back down. Light: the upload arrow rises away into the cloud and fades while a fresh one slides up into its place; 120 ms later the download arrow answers, dropping away and fading while a fresh one drops into place. Strong: the upload arrow dips before it launches, the cloud swells as it takes the upload, and each fresh arrow overshoots its place and settles. The cloud never moves in Light.

icons.name: saved
icons.label: Saved
icons.intent: The write head seats, then a two-stroke check records the saved result.

icons.name: notification-dot
icons.label: Notification dot
icons.intent: A message arrives first; its unread badge then grows into the reserved corner.

icons.name: session-expired
icons.label: Session expired
icons.intent: The remaining session time drains, then a cross records the expired state.

icons.name: orbit-comet
icons.label: Comet ring
icons.intent: A comet traces one continuous orbit.

icons.name: counter-arcs
icons.label: Counter arcs
icons.intent: Two arcs counter-rotate in separate lanes.

icons.name: wave-dots
icons.label: Wave dots
icons.intent: A signal travels through five spaced points.

icons.name: ripple-rings
icons.label: Ripple
icons.intent: Signals expand from a fixed source.

icons.name: corner-relay
icons.label: Corner relay
icons.intent: Attention passes clockwise between four corners.

icons.name: infinity-run
icons.label: Infinity runner
icons.intent: A runner passes through a continuous figure eight.

icons.name: bead-relay
icons.label: Bead relay
icons.intent: Three beads exchange places around a rounded triangle.

icons.name: equalizer-bars
icons.label: Equalizer
icons.intent: A travelling signal changes five line lengths.

icons.name: bead-track
icons.label: Bead track
icons.intent: Packets circulate on a closed capsule track.

icons.name: planet-orbit
icons.label: Planet orbit
icons.intent: A fixed center receives continuous orbital activity.

icons.name: square-snake
icons.label: Square snake
icons.intent: A short stroke follows a drafted square circuit.

icons.name: sync-arrows
icons.label: Sync arrows
icons.intent: A pair of arrows circulates continuously.

icons.name: pinwheel
icons.label: Pinwheel
icons.intent: Six swept paddles turn around a fixed hub.

icons.name: bounce-ball
icons.label: Bounce ball
icons.intent: A ball compresses at a clear contact point.

icons.name: travel-wave
icons.label: Travel wave
icons.intent: A continuous waveform moves across the frame.

icons.name: sweep-hand
icons.label: Sweep hand
icons.intent: A clean hand sweeps a circular dial.

icons.name: helix-strands
icons.label: Helix
icons.intent: Two flat signal bands move with attached crossbars.

icons.name: atom-rings
icons.label: Atom
icons.intent: Three paths carry separate circulating electrons.

icons.name: morph-ring
icons.label: Morph ring
icons.intent: One continuous outline changes between rounded forms.

icons.name: stack-cycle
icons.label: Stack cycle
icons.intent: Three horizontal bars exchange places on a closed route.

icons.name: bank
icons.label: Bank
icons.intent: The bank opens. Light: the entrance swings open on its left hinge, knocks against its stop, rebounds a little and stays open. Strong: a first tug, then the door is flung open, bounces twice off its stop and stays open. The roof, columns and plinth never move. The reset fades back to the closed door.

icons.name: bank-account
icons.label: Bank account
icons.intent: A new ledger entry posts, then the balance line updates without reversing its value.

icons.name: bank-transfer
icons.label: Bank transfer
icons.intent: Money moves between two accounts. Light: the outgoing arrow winds back and shoots right, the receiving account takes the hit and settles; the incoming arrow answers left a beat later and the sending account takes a smaller hit. Strong: a deeper wind-up and longer shots, and each account is knocked, rebounds and settles. The arrows stay rigid.

icons.name: currency-exchange
icons.label: Currency exchange
icons.intent: Two exchange channels index half a turn around one fixed unit of value.

icons.name: savings
icons.label: Savings
icons.intent: One coin enters the jar and settles above the saved stack. The added coin remains.

icons.name: deposit
icons.label: Deposit
icons.intent: A coin is deposited. Light: the coin hops, falls into the tray, lands with a hit and one small bounce, and stays deposited; the tray gives under it and springs back. Strong: a higher toss, a landing that bounces twice, and a deeper give in the tray. The coin stays rigid. The reset fades back to the coin above the tray.

icons.name: withdraw
icons.label: Withdraw
icons.intent: The ATM feeds a note in two measured steps, then the note value becomes visible.

icons.name: payment-terminal
icons.label: Payment terminal
icons.intent: A physical key press starts approval; the check completes and remains on the terminal.

icons.name: contactless-payment
icons.label: Contactless payment
icons.intent: The phone approaches; three signal bands acknowledge the tap from near to far.

icons.name: recurring-payment
icons.label: Recurring payment
icons.intent: A calendar stays fixed while the payment clock completes its scheduled cycle.

icons.name: receipt
icons.label: Receipt
icons.intent: The paper feeds; item lines print in sequence and the final total stays visible.

icons.name: invoice
icons.label: Invoice
icons.intent: A seal approaches the invoice, stamps once, and stays recorded on the page.

icons.name: refund
icons.label: Refund
icons.intent: The payment goes back. Light: the coin hops and drops onto the return channel; the channel pulls back into the coin and pours out again down and round to the left, and the arrowhead snaps on at the end with a leftward hit and settles. Strong: a higher hop and a harder drop with a rebound, and the arrowhead lands further out, bounces back and settles.

icons.name: bill-payment
icons.label: Bill payment
icons.intent: The bill is paid in. Light: the bill lifts slightly, drops into the payment tray with a hit and one small bounce, and stays seated; the tray gives under it and springs back. Strong: a higher lift, a harder drop that bounces twice, and a deeper give in the tray. The bill and its value move as one rigid object. The reset fades back to the bill above the tray.

icons.name: budget
icons.label: Budget
icons.intent: A share is set aside. Light: the allocation slice tucks back toward the pie, then springs out past its place and settles into its share with a small rebound. Strong: a deeper tuck, a longer spring out that makes the pie recoil, and two settle beats. Both parts stay rigid.

icons.name: transaction-history
icons.label: Transaction history
icons.intent: The ledger advances one entry. A new transaction stays at the bottom while the oldest leaves the timeline.

icons.name: investment
icons.label: Investment
icons.intent: A stem grows from the invested coin; two branches extend in order and retain their growth.

icons.name: portfolio
icons.label: Portfolio
icons.intent: The case is picked up. Light: the handle pulls taut first, then the case lifts off and swings from the handle, and is set down with a thud and a small bounce. Strong: a harder pull, a higher lift with a wider swing, and a landing that bounces twice. The case, seam and latch stay rigid; only the handle stretches.

icons.name: calculator
icons.label: Calculator
icons.intent: A key press computes a result; Strong enters a value first, then confirms it. The display stays posted.

icons.name: vault
icons.label: Vault
icons.intent: The vault wheel takes up slack, indexes a quarter turn, and locks on its next symmetric position.

icons.name: airplane
icons.label: Airplane
icons.intent: The plane takes off. Light: it turns its nose 35° toward the upper right and accelerates out along it, laying a contrail from each wingtip and the tail, and fades before the edge; the contrails hang until it returns; it glides back in from the lower left on the same line, levels off and lands on its rest pose with a small overshoot. Strong: a short draw-back first, a faster launch with contrails twice as long, and a landing that overshoots and settles in two beats.

icons.name: passport
icons.label: Passport
icons.intent: The passport is stamped at the border. Light: the globe emblem swells as the stamp comes up to it, then slams back to size with a hit; impact ticks flash out on both sides of the cover and the booklet dips under the blow and springs back. Strong: a light tap first, then the full stamp: the emblem swells further and slams harder, the ticks fly out further, the booklet dips deeper and settles in two beats. The booklet stays rigid.

icons.name: boarding-pass
icons.label: Boarding pass
icons.intent: The pass is scanned at the gate. Light: a scan beam appears at the left end of the pass, sweeps across it to the right and fades; the pass is accepted: it hops once and lands with a small bounce. Strong: the beam sweeps across and back, a double read, and the pass hops higher and lands with two decaying bounces. The pass stays rigid with all its print.

icons.name: suitcase
icons.label: Suitcase
icons.intent: The grip extends from fixed rails before the case tips onto its rear wheel. The raised handle remains.

icons.name: backpack
icons.label: Backpack
icons.intent: The pack is zipped shut, ready to go. Light: the zip across the flap runs open to the left, then closes back across to the right with a hit, and the pull tugs the pack after it, leaning left then right; the zipped pack hops once and lands with a small bounce. Strong: the zip opens, pauses, and snaps shut harder; the pack hops higher and lands with two decaying bounces while the fabric grab loop lags: it stretches at the top of the hop, squashes on landing and springs back. The pack stays one rigid piece.

icons.name: train
icons.label: Train
icons.intent: The train sets off. Light: the coupling rod drives the wheels through one full turn as the train pulls forward along the rail; the carriage sits back on its springs at the start, pitches forward once and settles, and the train eases back onto its spot. Strong: the couplings take up slack first (a small jolt back), then the rod drives two turns, the pull is longer and the carriage rocks deeper with a two-beat settle. The rail never moves; the carriage, wheels and rod stay rigid.

icons.name: bus
icons.label: Bus
icons.intent: The bus pulls up at your stop. Light: it rides up over a bump, then brakes: the body dives forward on its suspension with a hit while the tyres stay planted and compress, rebounds once and settles, and the headlamps blink as it stops. Strong: it rolls in over two bumps, brakes harder and rebounds twice, and the headlamps blink twice. The body is rigid; only the exposed tyres compress and extend.

icons.name: car-rental
icons.label: Car rental
icons.intent: The rental key is handed over. Light: the key is tossed up with a tilt, drops into its handover spot half a unit lower with a hit and one small bounce, and stays there; 70 ms later the car answers as if unlocked: its body dips on the suspension and springs back. Strong: a dip of the hand, a higher toss with more tilt, a catch that bounces twice, and the car answers with a double bounce, chirp-chirp. The key and car stay rigid; the wheels stay planted. The reset fades the key back to its starting place above the car.

icons.name: ferry
icons.label: Ferry
icons.intent: The ferry sets off across the water. Light: the engines push, the bow lifts and the ferry surges forward while the water sloshes under it; the bow drops back with a hit, the hull bobs once in the water and settles, and the ferry eases back onto its spot. Strong: a bigger push with the bow higher and a longer surge, and the hull bobs twice as the water sloshes back and forth. The ferry stays rigid; the water line stays in place and only changes shape.

icons.name: bicycle
icons.label: Bicycle
icons.intent: A pedal stroke sends the bike off. Light: the crank turns half a revolution; the push lifts the front wheel and the bike surges forward while two speed lines stream out behind it; the front wheel lands with a hit, the rear answers with a small rebound, and the bike eases back onto its spot as the lines fade. Strong: the rider loads the pedal first and the bike rocks back, then the crank turns a full revolution, the front lifts into a small wheelie, the surge goes further with longer streaks, and the landing bounces twice. The bike stays rigid; only the crank turns.

icons.name: hotel
icons.label: Hotel
icons.intent: A welcome flag catches and releases a short breeze above a still, readable hotel facade.

icons.name: bed
icons.label: Bed
icons.intent: Someone goes to sleep. Light: a head lands on the pillow, which squashes with a hit and lofts back with a small rebound; the duvet settles a beat later, and one z drifts up from the pillow, growing, and fades. Strong: a heavier landing, then a second, smaller snuggle into the pillow, with two z's drifting up in turn. The headboard, mattress and foot never move.

icons.name: tent
icons.label: Tent
icons.intent: The tent is pitched. Light: the slack fabric sags low and wide onto the ground, then the tent springs up and snaps taut a little taller than rest with a hit, dips back once and settles. Strong: it sags flatter and lies there a beat before it springs up higher and settles in two decaying beats. The base stays on the ground; the door rides with the fabric.

icons.name: beach-umbrella
icons.label: Beach umbrella
icons.intent: The umbrella pops open for shade. Light: the canopy folds in toward the pole, narrow and drooping, then snaps open wide and flat with a hit, springs back once and settles. Strong: the canopy folds almost shut and holds a beat, snaps open wider, and settles in two decaying beats. The pole and the sand never move.

icons.name: map
icons.label: Map
icons.intent: The paper folds at its two fixed creases. Strong folds both outer panels in a short cascade before spreading flat.

icons.name: route
icons.label: Route
icons.intent: A traveller follows the exact head of a growing journey path, carries speed through the bend, and holds at the destination.

icons.name: globe
icons.label: Globe
icons.intent: A flick spins the globe on its axis. Light: one flick sends the meridians sweeping left to right across the face: the left one crosses to the right, the right one runs off at the limb and a new one comes in from the left; the turn coasts a little past and settles back onto the rest pattern. Strong: a harder spin that turns two meridian spacings, picking up speed through the first and coasting past and settling after the second. The sphere outline, the equator, the stand and the foot never move.

icons.name: ticket
icons.label: Ticket
icons.intent: Admit one: the stub is torn off. Light: the stub tears away from the top, tipping about its lower corner, then drops off down and to the right and fades; the ticket recoils a little from the tear and settles; a fresh stub fades back in at its place. Strong: the stub resists once with a small tug, then tears further and drops farther, and the ticket recoils harder with a two-beat settle. Body and stub stay rigid.

icons.name: luggage-tag
icons.label: Luggage tag
icons.intent: The tag is filled in. Light: the address lines wipe back and are written out again left to right; the pen's push swings the tag on its ring, and it swings back once and settles. Strong: the lines are written with a firmer hand, the tag swings further, and it settles in three decaying swings. The ring never moves; the strap and tag swing as one rigid piece.

icons.name: signpost
icons.label: Signpost
icons.intent: The signpost points the ways. Light: the upper board draws back a little, then thrusts out along its arrow to the right with a hit and springs back with a small rebound; the lower board does the same to the left 80 ms later. Strong: both boards pull back toward the post together, then thrust out harder, upper first, and each settles in two decaying beats. The post and foot never move; the boards slide along their own arrows and stay on the post.

icons.name: storefront
icons.label: Storefront
icons.intent: Light unrolls the awning quietly. Strong pulls the cloth up first, releases a travelling wave, then settles the hem. The header and shop remain fixed.

icons.name: shopping-bag
icons.label: Shopping bag
icons.intent: The bag is picked up. Light: the handle is pulled taut into a peak first, then the bag comes up after it, overshoots and hangs from the peak, swinging once before it settles at the lifted height. Strong: the bag sags as the handle is gathered, is yanked higher, and swings twice from the handle before it settles at the same height. The bag stays rigid; only the handle changes from slack to taut, as in v1.

icons.name: basket
icons.label: Basket
icons.intent: Light lowers the basket strap. Strong sweeps it sideways between fixed attachments, rebounds once and settles with its opening clear.

icons.name: product-tag
icons.label: Product tag
icons.intent: The tag is flicked and swings on its eyelet. Light: a tap lands under the free end (a small burst), the tag swings up about the eyelet, falls back past rest and settles. Strong: the finger presses the end down first, then flicks it harder; the tag swings higher, swings through twice and settles. The tag stays rigid; the eyelet is the pivot.

icons.name: product-variants
icons.label: Product variants
icons.intent: Light slides the selection underline. Strong stretches its leading edge past the next swatch, catches up with its trailing edge and presses the chosen swatch.

icons.name: discount
icons.label: Discount
icons.intent: Light retracts and restores the percent slash. Strong retracts almost fully, pauses, then strikes the slash in a short decisive stroke. Its dots remain fixed within the badge.

icons.name: coupon
icons.label: Coupon
icons.intent: The stub is torn off to redeem the coupon. Light: the stub is tugged down once, then rips up and away; the coupon is drawn after it and snaps back as it tears, a small burst flies from the seam, and the stub drops back onto its redeemed pose with a settle. Strong: a first tug that does not give, a second harder tug, then the rip with more travel and tilt, a fuller recoil and a two-beat settle. The coupon stays rigid; the stub holds torn off.

icons.name: loyalty-points
icons.label: Loyalty points
icons.intent: Light presses the stamp quietly. Strong lifts it first and drives it onto the card with a larger stroke. The earned point remains after the stamp returns.

icons.name: gift-card
icons.label: Gift card
icons.intent: The gift is tied off with a flourish. Light: the ribbon is tugged, so the card dips and the loops pinch down; then the bow springs open, the loops flick up past their pose, a spark flashes out on each side, and the loops swing back once and settle as the card rebounds. Strong: two tugs, the second deeper, then a bigger spring with a fuller burst of sparks and loops that swing twice before they settle. The card stays rigid; the knot stays on the ribbon.

icons.name: subscription-box
icons.label: Subscription box
icons.intent: Light advances the delivery dial once. Strong takes up its hand, makes two quick full turns, then catches the next equivalent index. The parcel stays fixed.

icons.name: checkout
icons.label: Checkout
icons.intent: Light opens the drawer smoothly. Strong releases it with a short preparation, a larger opening and a controlled settle. Exposed guides keep the drawer joined to its console.

icons.name: order-confirmed
icons.label: Order confirmed
icons.intent: A check draws onto the order sheet. Strong sweeps through the corner decisively, then holds the completed confirmation.

icons.name: open-package
icons.label: Open package
icons.intent: The two lid edges split and swing around fixed box corners. Strong opens them in sequence and settles each flap.

icons.name: packing-tape
icons.label: Packing tape
icons.intent: Light dispenses tape smoothly. Strong takes up the pull, drives the roll farther and settles. The strip follows the roll tangent from its fixed free end.

icons.name: return-package
icons.label: Return package
icons.intent: A clear return arrow leads the parcel home. Strong redraws the curl, winds the parcel back, then sends it left with a rigid tilt and a controlled settle. Light is one quiet slide.

icons.name: delivery-truck
icons.label: Delivery truck
icons.intent: Light rolls forward smoothly. Strong recoils onto its suspension, accelerates with a raised nose and settles under braking. Its reverse has a clear brake dip and powered back-out.

icons.name: order-tracking
icons.label: Order tracking
icons.intent: The order reaches its destination. Light: the location pin hops along the route in one arc and drops onto the last stop with a hit and a small bounce; the stop pings as it lands, a ring that spreads and fades. Strong: the pin crouches, hops to the middle stop leaning into the jump, lands with a ping, crouches again and hops on to the last stop with a second, wider ping and two decaying bounces. The pin stays rigid and holds on the last stop; the route never moves. The reverse hops it back, pinging the stops it lands on.

icons.name: pickup-locker
icons.label: Pickup locker
icons.intent: The locker releases its parcel. Light: the latch bolt drops to unlock, then the door springs open along its track, hits its stop and bounces once, while the bolt springs back up. Strong: the bolt is lifted first and snaps down, the door pops ajar with a click, pauses, then slides open hard and bounces twice against its stop. The frame never moves; the door and latch stay rigid and hold open.

icons.name: warehouse
icons.label: Warehouse
icons.intent: Light rolls the shutter up quietly. Strong takes up the slack, lifts it rapidly to a higher opening and settles on its stop. The jambs stay fixed.

icons.name: inventory
icons.label: Inventory
icons.intent: A parcel is put away onto the next stack. Light: the top parcel hops across in one arc and lands square on the right-hand box with a hit; the box under it takes the weight, dips with it and springs back, and the left box lifts a little as it is unloaded. Strong: the parcel crouches into the left box, is tossed higher with a tilt, slaps down flat, and the right stack takes a deeper dip that rebounds twice. Every box stays rigid; the parcel holds in the right column. The reverse hops it back and the left box takes the landing.

icons.name: voice-listening
icons.label: Listening
icons.intent: Sound arrives at an ear in two separate lanes. Strong draws the signal inward with more travel and a small receiving lean.

icons.name: voice-speaking
icons.label: Speaking
icons.intent: A spoken waveform travels through a fixed speech bubble. Strong doubles its cadence and opens its wave height.

icons.name: voice-activity
icons.label: Voice activity
icons.intent: Five level bars carry a left-to-right voice signal. Strong has almost twice the excursion and two crests per cycle.

icons.name: voice-recording
icons.label: Voice recording
icons.intent: A fixed microphone records a live level. Strong has a taller, faster level response; the record dot stays visible.

icons.name: push-to-talk
icons.label: Push to talk
icons.intent: Press the talk key; a short signal leaves both sides. Strong has a deeper, quicker key press and one controlled release.

icons.name: microphone-muted
icons.label: Microphone muted
icons.intent: The slash closes the microphone input. Strong draws decisively through the full diagonal with a short end response. The selected mute state remains.

icons.name: wake-word
icons.label: Wake word
icons.intent: A smart speaker hears its wake word. Light: the voice arrives as a wide arc travelling in from above and fades into the receive arc; the indicator light pops as it lands, the receive arc and light take the hit, and the speaker follows with one nod and settles. Strong: two words arrive in turn, the light pops twice, the second harder, and the speaker nods twice.

icons.name: switch-voice
icons.label: Switch voice
icons.intent: The voice passes to the other speaker. Light: the voice marker leaps in an arc from speaker A and lands on speaker B with a hit; B's head and shoulders dip under it and rebound, and a sound arc swells off the side of B's head and fades as B starts speaking. Strong: the marker first presses down on A, who dips with it, and pushes off into a higher leap; it lands harder on B, who takes it in two beats, and B speaks twice. The marker stays on B. The reverse is the same hand-off back to A.

icons.name: voice-isolation
icons.label: Voice isolation
icons.intent: The voice remains steady while surrounding noise contracts and moves aside. Strong briefly gathers the noise before a decisive reduction.

icons.name: voice-speed
icons.label: Voice speed
icons.intent: Speech speeds up. Light: Play gives one beat as the faster speed engages, and the cadence marks bunch up behind it like cars braking in a queue: the middle mark slams into its tighter slot first, the far one 70 ms later, each hitting home and rebounding once. Strong: Play gathers, then beats harder while the marks first spread out, drive in faster and rebound twice. The first mark never moves; the marks stay at the tighter spacing. The reverse is the exact time reversal: the marks relax back out, far one first.

icons.name: voice-id
icons.label: Voice ID
icons.intent: A spoken passphrase is captured and the voiceprint is recognised. Light: the voiceprint bars swell one after another from left to right as the phrase is spoken; as the last bar settles, the four corner brackets snap in onto the voiceprint (hit), rebound and settle. Strong: two words ripple through the bars, the second taller, and the brackets lock on harder with a bounce.

icons.name: mic-level
icons.label: Mic level
icons.intent: The microphone's input level meter reacts to sound. Light: a pair of sound arcs travels in from the upper sides and fades into the capsule; as it lands, the level bar inside the capsule jumps up and stops dead, holds for a beat, then sinks back to its resting tick. Strong: two sounds arrive in turn; the first lifts the level part way and it starts to fall, the second, louder, drives it to the top, where it holds before sinking back. The microphone itself never moves.

icons.name: active-speaker
icons.label: Active speaker
icons.intent: A participant speaks and is shown as the active speaker. Light: the head bobs as the person says a word and the voice arcs on both sides push out with it, then snap back with a small rebound; as they snap back a wider, shorter ripple carries on outward and fades. Strong: two words, the second louder: the head bobs twice, the second deeper, the arcs push out twice, the second further, and each word sends a ripple out. The shoulders never move.

icons.name: voice-clone
icons.label: Voice clone
icons.intent: A voice is cloned and the copy speaks. Light: the front card carrying the waveform presses back into the original voice behind it, then peels out diagonally to its own place, overshoots and settles; as it lands, its waveform bars swell one after another, the cloned voice saying a word. Strong: a deeper press, a longer peel that settles in two beats, and the clone says two words, the second louder. The original never moves.

icons.name: voice-pitch
icons.label: Voice pitch
icons.intent: The voice's pitch is raised. Light: the pitch knob slides up its track and stops dead on the higher setting, and a beat behind it the voice wave tightens from long, low swells into short, quick ones. Strong: the knob dips to gather, then climbs in two steps, stopping dead on each, while the wave tightens behind it. The knob stays high and the wave stays tight. The reverse lowers the knob and relaxes the wave the same way.

icons.name: discard-recording
icons.label: Discard recording
icons.intent: A voice recording is thrown away. Light: the bin's lid flips open on its right-hand hinge, the recording, a microphone capsule, appears in the opening and drops into the bin, vanishing inside, and the lid drops shut with a hit and one chatter while the bin, marked with a waveform, dips on contact. Strong: the lid flips wider and holds longer, the capsule teeters before it tumbles in, and the lid slams with two chatters and a deeper dip.

icons.name: mic-access
icons.label: Mic access
icons.intent: Microphone access is granted and the microphone goes live. Light: the badge squeezes as its check lifts away, then pops as the check draws back on; a beat later a pair of sound arcs travels in from the upper sides and fades into the capsule, which dips as it hears it. Strong: a deeper squeeze and a bigger pop that bounces once, then two sounds arrive in turn and the capsule takes two hits, the second harder.

icons.name: voice-command
icons.label: Voice command
icons.intent: A spoken command triggers an action. Light: a pair of sound arcs travels in from the upper sides and fades into the microphone capsule, and as it lands the lightning bolt beside it fires: it pops bigger with a quick twist and settles. Strong: two words arrive in turn; the bolt crouches on the first and fires on the second, popping bigger with a crackling shake before it settles. The microphone never moves.

icons.name: karaoke
icons.label: Karaoke
icons.intent: Someone sings along into a handheld microphone. Light: the microphone rocks back on the beat in the singer's hand and swings forward again, a sound arc flicks off its head and fades, and the music note beside it springs up and lands on the beat, its flag whipping out. Strong: two beats: the microphone rocks twice, the note hops twice, the second higher, and an arc flicks out on each beat.

icons.name: pronunciation
icons.label: Pronunciation
icons.intent: A word is pronounced aloud. Light: the lips open on one syllable, the lower lip dropping with the jaw, and close again, while the two sound arcs in front of the mouth swell outward one after the other and settle. Strong: two syllables, the second opening wider and holding longer, and the arcs swell out twice, the second further.

icons.name: play-pause
icons.label: Play / Pause
icons.intent: The play triangle folds into the left pause bar. The right bar grows in the space it clears. Strong pushes forward, folds decisively and settles with a small response.

icons.name: stop
icons.label: Stop
