icons.intent: Playback brakes to a dead stop. Light: the block draws back, then drives forward with two speed lines laid behind it; it stops dead on its place, the lines cut off, and its momentum tips it forward onto its front corner before it rocks back to rest. Strong: a longer draw-back and a faster drive, a harder forward tip and one rock back onto its heel before it settles.

icons.name: next-track
icons.label: Next track
icons.intent: A track moves toward the boundary; the next track arrives from the opposite side. Strong has a prepared launch, boundary response and controlled arrival.

icons.name: previous-track
icons.label: Previous track
icons.intent: A track moves toward the boundary; the next track arrives from the opposite side. Strong has a prepared launch, boundary response and controlled arrival.

icons.name: replay-10
icons.label: Replay 10 seconds
icons.intent: The arrow makes a full directional turn around a fixed 10. Strong winds up, drives through the turn and settles once. The numeral stays upright.

icons.name: forward-10
icons.label: Forward 10 seconds
icons.intent: The arrow makes a full directional turn around a fixed 10. Strong winds up, drives through the turn and settles once. The numeral stays upright.

icons.name: shuffle
icons.label: Shuffle
icons.intent: The tracks are rerouted across each other. Light: both routes pull back into their start, then shoot out again along their crossing paths, the rising route first and the falling one 80 ms later; each arrowhead is knocked forward as its route arrives and settles back. Strong: the routes pull back almost to nothing, shoot out harder 100 ms apart, and the heads are knocked further with a rebound before they settle.

icons.name: repeat
icons.label: Repeat
icons.intent: Two arrows turn to the next equivalent loop position. Strong winds up briefly, turns decisively and settles.

icons.name: playlist
icons.label: Playlist
icons.intent: The selected track moves into play. Strong launches the play marker farther and the list follows with a short, orderly stagger.

icons.name: add-to-queue
icons.label: Add to queue
icons.intent: The add control presses and releases as a new row extends into the queue. Strong gives the press more travel and writes the row in one fast move.

icons.name: headphones
icons.label: Headphones
icons.intent: Sound plays. Light: both ear cups give one beat, like a driver pumping, and a sound arc leaves the inner face of each cup and travels in toward the listener, fading on the way. Strong: two beats, the second harder, each sending its pair of arcs. The band never moves.

icons.name: podcast
icons.label: Podcast
icons.intent: A central voice sends two clear signal rings outward and back. Strong expands the same rings more than three times farther without crowding their gaps.

icons.name: live-broadcast
icons.label: Live broadcast
icons.intent: A fixed broadcast source sends an even signal to both sides. Strong has nearly three times the outward travel while the wave spacing remains clear.

icons.name: cast
icons.label: Cast
icons.intent: A signal reaches the display and reveals its content. Strong sends the signal faster, then opens the content tile with a decisive wipe and a small settle.

icons.name: screen-share
icons.label: Screen share
icons.intent: The screen goes out to the others. Light: the share arrow launches up inside the display, overshoots its raised position and settles there, and as it arrives a ripple peels off the top of the screen and rises away, fading: the display is broadcasting. Strong: the arrow dips first, launches harder with a bigger overshoot and a two-swing settle, and two ripples rise off the screen in turn. The display, stand and foot never move; the arrow holds raised. The reverse lowers the arrow without a ripple.

icons.name: video-call
icons.label: Video call
icons.intent: The camera connects and reveals a caller. Strong gives the whole camera a clear nod before the caller settles into view.

icons.name: closed-captions
icons.label: Closed captions
icons.intent: A caption line opens beneath the letters. Strong writes the line faster, reaches farther and settles to the same enabled state.

icons.name: fullscreen
icons.label: Fullscreen
icons.intent: Four window corners expand into fullscreen. Strong gathers inward, opens farther and settles at the same selected size.

icons.name: picture-in-picture
icons.label: Picture-in-picture
icons.intent: The video pops out and docks. Light: the small window lifts off the screen (it grows), glides down to its dock at the lower right, passes it a little and sets down there with a hit, shrinking under its own weight, and settles at v1's docked position. Strong: the window first draws back toward the corner it leaves and dips, then lifts higher, travels faster, overshoots the dock and sets down harder with two settling beats. The frame never moves; the window stays docked. The reverse plays the same pick-up and set-down back to the expanded position.

icons.name: camera-off
icons.label: Camera off
icons.intent: A diagonal stroke switches the camera off. Strong draws the stroke in one fast move with a small extension and a clean settle.

icons.name: timeline
icons.label: Timeline
icons.intent: The playhead scrubs to a new frame across the clip tracks. Light: the head launches along the ruler, crosses 12 and stops dead a little past its frame; its marks on the two tracks catch up in order (top track, then bottom) and everything settles. Strong: the head first pulls back, then sweeps faster and overshoots farther, rebounding twice before it settles, with the track marks arriving in order behind it. Ruler and clips never move; the preview reset fades it back.

icons.name: add-keyframe
icons.label: Add keyframe
icons.intent: The track opens before a new keyframe lands. Strong drops the key decisively, then settles once.

icons.name: remove-keyframe
icons.label: Remove keyframe
icons.intent: The keyframe lifts out, then the track closes. Strong prepares the key and removes it with a faster main stroke.

icons.name: auto-keyframe
icons.label: Auto keyframe
icons.intent: Auto-key is switched on and records a key. Light: the crown is pressed in and springs back; a beat later the keyed hand sweeps one full clockwise turn, lands on its key past twelve with a dead stop and ticks back. Strong: a deeper press that jolts twice, the hand winds back against the turn, then sweeps the full turn faster, overshooting farther and settling in decaying ticks. The case never moves.

icons.name: keyframe-easing
icons.label: Keyframe easing
icons.intent: A linear keyframe is eased. Light: the diamond's straight sides are pulled in to the hourglass of an eased key, pinching just past it with a dead stop and settling once. Strong: the key first bows out (the sides bulge as the corners are grabbed), then snaps into the hourglass, pinching well past it, and settles in two decaying beats. The reverse eases it back to linear.

icons.name: graph-editor
icons.label: Graph editor
icons.intent: A value graph changes from a straight interpolation to an eased curve. Strong bends against the change briefly, then makes a deeper, faster curve adjustment.

icons.name: bezier-handles
icons.label: Bezier handles
icons.intent: Dragging a tangent handle reshapes the curve. Light: the right handle is grabbed (its knob swells), dragged down so the handle pivots on the anchor, and the curve bends through the anchor to follow it a beat later; on release it snaps back past straight and settles. Strong: the handle is nudged up first, then dragged farther so the curve bends deeper, and the release springs back through two decaying swings. The anchor never moves.

icons.name: motion-path
icons.label: Motion path
icons.intent: A position marker travels its motion path from the first keyframe to the last and lands on it. Light: the marker leaves the start key, runs the actual cubic route (keyed along its arc length), brakes a little past the end key along the route's tangent and settles back onto it; the end key pulses as the marker reaches it. Strong: the marker first backs off the start key, then crosses the route decisively, brakes farther past the end key, undershoots and settles; the end key pulses harder. The route and keys never move; the preview reset fades it back.

icons.name: anchor-point
icons.label: Anchor point
icons.intent: The anchor moves along the layer rim and the layer turns around that new pivot. Strong pulls back before the move and turns the layer farther before settling.

icons.name: layer-stack
icons.label: Layer stack
icons.intent: A layer is set down on the stack. Light: the top layer lifts and drops back onto the stack with a dead stop; the impact passes down, the middle layer dipping 60 ms later and the bottom one after it, and each settles. Strong: the top layer lifts higher and tilts as it is carried, lands flat with a harder hit, and the impact passes down the stack in deeper, decaying beats. The layers stay rigid.

icons.name: parent-layers
icons.label: Parent layers
icons.intent: A parent moves first and pulls its linked child through a flexible pick whip. Strong doubles the travel and gives the child a short delayed catch-up.

icons.name: precompose
icons.label: Precompose
icons.intent: Separate layers gather into an aligned composition. Its enclosing frame appears after the layers land; Strong gathers them faster after a brief outward preparation.

icons.name: trim-layer
icons.label: Trim layer
icons.intent: The layer's out-point is trimmed. Light: the out-point handle drives in 6 and stops dead a little past its mark; the clip's end follows it 50 ms later, shortening the layer, and both settle. Strong: the handle first pulls back, then slams in well past its mark, rebounds and settles; the clip's end follows each beat. The time ruler never moves; the preview reset fades it back.

icons.name: split-layer
icons.label: Split layer
icons.intent: The razor splits the clip in two. Light: the blade drives down through the clip and stops dead at its floor; only then do the two halves spring apart, past their place, and settle, while the blade pulls straight back out. Strong: the blade first lifts to wind up, slams down and jolts once on impact, and the halves burst farther apart and recoil twice before they settle. The halves stay rigid; the preview reset fades it back.

icons.name: time-stretch
icons.label: Time stretch
icons.intent: The clip is stretched and its keyframes spread in proportion. Light: the clip's end is pulled out to its new length and stops dead a little past it; the nearer key follows, then the farther one, each landing in turn and settling. Strong: the clip first squeezes in (the keys bunch up), then is pulled out hard past its new length and settles in decaying beats, with the keys arriving in order behind it. The ruler never moves; the preview reset fades it back.

icons.name: onion-skin
icons.label: Onion skin
icons.intent: Neighboring poses spread from the current frame to show motion over time. Strong exposes a larger sweep earlier; the current pose stays fixed.

icons.name: shape-morph
icons.label: Shape morph
icons.intent: The circle becomes the target square through matching path points. Light: the source circle gives a little first, then the shape's points run out to the rounded square, snapping a touch past it and settling; the target square answers with a pulse as the match lands. Strong: after the source gives, the circle winds back (it pinches and counter-turns), then twists through as it morphs, overshooting both the turn and the corners before settling square, and the target answers harder. The preview reset fades it back.

icons.name: mask-path
icons.label: Mask path
icons.intent: A mask is reshaped by dragging one of its vertices. Light: the right vertex is grabbed (it swells) and dragged out, and the mask boundary stretches with it into a new shape; on release it snaps back past its place, denting the mask a little, and settles. Strong: the vertex is first pushed in, then dragged farther out so the mask bulges wider, and the release springs back through decaying swings. The frame and the other vertices never move.

icons.name: track-matte
icons.label: Track matte
icons.intent: A matte window moves across source columns to reveal the clipped result. Strong sweeps across twice as much content and returns with a clear brake.

icons.name: render-queue
icons.label: Render queue
icons.intent: Render jobs complete in order. Strong fills each job with a faster complete stroke and overlaps the next start with the prior finish.

icons.name: agent-skills
icons.label: Agent skills
icons.intent: A skill cartridge is loaded into its dock. Light: the cartridge drops into the dock and lands with a hit; the dock takes the load, giving under it with the cartridge, and both spring back and settle with the cartridge seated. Strong: the cartridge is lifted first, then driven down harder; the dock gives further and the pair settle in two beats. Eject: the cartridge is pulled up, dragging the dock a little, then pops free; the dock snaps back with a rebound and the cartridge settles above it. Cartridge and dock stay rigid.

icons.name: tool-discovery
icons.label: Tool discovery
icons.intent: A magnifier searches across candidate tools and lifts the selected result. Strong scans faster with a short braking response; clear selection restores the candidates.

icons.name: mcp-tools
icons.label: MCP tools
icons.intent: A tool is connected over MCP: the two-prong plug seats into its tool port. Light: the plug drives in and its prongs meet the port with a hit; the housing is knocked back by the contact, carrying the plug with it, and both spring back and settle with the plug seated. Strong: the plug is pulled back first, then driven in harder; the housing is knocked further and the pair settle in two beats. Disconnect: the plug is pulled back, dragging the housing a little, then comes free; the housing snaps back with a rebound and the plug settles, fully opaque. Plug and housing stay rigid.

icons.name: browser-agent
icons.label: Browser agent
icons.intent: The cursor crosses the page, presses a button and reveals its result. Strong has a much faster main approach and a firmer click. Preview reset clears the result before the cursor returns.

icons.name: terminal-agent
icons.label: Terminal agent
icons.intent: A command is entered, executed and produces an output line. Strong uses a short cursor cue, a faster command burst and a prompt response at Enter.

icons.name: agent-sandbox
icons.label: Sandbox
icons.intent: A process enters an isolated container and the hatches close. Strong drops the process faster and gives the latch one short response. Unseal opens the doors before raising the process.

icons.name: agent-permissions
icons.label: Agent permissions
icons.intent: The access cylinder turns to grant tool permission. Strong makes a wider preparation, a decisive quarter-turn and one short settle.

icons.name: human-input
icons.label: Human input
icons.intent: The run waits for input, a person leans toward the field and enters guidance. Strong types the full line faster with a clearer lean; the completed text stays.

icons.name: agent-checkpoint
icons.label: Agent checkpoint
icons.intent: A checkpoint is saved: a flag is planted at the current execution point. Light: the flag drops and stakes into the node with a hit, the node pops as it takes the flag, and the planted flag quivers about its base and settles. Strong: the flag is raised first, then driven down harder; the node pops bigger and the quiver is wider with more swings. Remove wiggles the flag loose and lifts it back up, with no impact. The track never moves.

icons.name: resume-run
icons.label: Resume run
icons.intent: The run continues from a saved checkpoint and fills the remaining route. Strong departs faster while the checkpoint responds; completed progress stays retained.

icons.name: retry-step
icons.label: Retry step
icons.intent: A return arrow retries the marked step. Strong winds back, makes a fast full turn and settles once. The completed step stays; reset clears only its result.

icons.name: execution-trace
icons.label: Execution trace
icons.intent: Nested execution spans expand along a time axis. Strong produces a faster waterfall, with each child beginning before its parent finishes.

icons.name: parallel-tools
icons.label: Parallel tools
icons.intent: Three separated packets run through concurrent tool lanes. Strong dispatches all three decisively and the sockets confirm arrival. Reset hides each packet inside its opaque socket before dimming the socket.

icons.name: merge-results
icons.label: Merge results
icons.intent: Three tool results gather at a junction and arrive as one result. Strong carries the main action through the merge, then lands quickly. The output stays while preview reset removes its packet.

icons.name: background-run
icons.label: Background run
icons.intent: The task is sent to the background and keeps running there. Light: the front pane steps aside down-left, overshoots a little and settles, and a beat later the progress knob in the back pane runs the length of its track and stops at the end. Strong: the front pane is nudged back first, then pushed further aside and settles in two beats; the knob runs faster and pops as it reaches the end. The back pane's edges stay cut exactly where the front pane covers them. The reset slides the panes back opaque and fades the knob back to its start, as in v1.

icons.name: scheduled-agent
icons.label: Scheduled agent
icons.intent: The timer advances to its marked time, then releases a run. Strong drives the hand to the same scheduled time faster; the release follows arrival and the data never overshoots.

icons.name: event-trigger
icons.label: Event trigger
icons.intent: A signal pulse reaches a listener and triggers its output. Strong carries the pulse faster with a decisive arrival. The wire remains fixed and the completed trigger stays.

icons.name: context-compaction
icons.label: Context compaction
icons.intent: The context closes to a compact readable group. Strong opens the jaws briefly before a fast compression; the text stays ordered without stretching or overshoot.

icons.name: agent-artifact
icons.label: Agent artifact
icons.intent: The agent delivers a finished artifact. Light: the page pops up out of the output tray, overshoots its delivered height and settles, and a glint flashes out on each side as it arrives. Strong: the page presses into the tray first (the tray gives under it and springs back), then pops higher, settles in two beats, and a fan of two glints flashes out on each side. The page and tray stay rigid; the page holds at its delivered height until the preview reset.

icons.name: budget-limit
icons.label: Budget limit
icons.intent: Usage runs up to the budget limit and is stopped dead there. Light: the usage token gathers speed along the rail and stops hard at the limit with a hit, and a shock flashes out of the far side of the limit wall. Strong: usage advances in two surges, a first spend that pauses, then a run that slams into the limit; the shock is wider, three rays. The token never overshoots or rebounds (no refund) and holds at the limit until the preview reset. The rail never moves.

icons.name: arrow-right
icons.label: Arrow right
icons.intent: The arrow goes right. Light: it launches right along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

icons.name: arrow-left
icons.label: Arrow left
icons.intent: The arrow goes left. Light: it launches left along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

icons.name: arrow-up
icons.label: Arrow up
icons.intent: The arrow goes up. Light: it launches up along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

icons.name: arrow-up-right
icons.label: Arrow up right
icons.intent: The arrow goes up right. Light: it launches up right along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

icons.name: arrow-up-left
icons.label: Arrow up left
icons.intent: The arrow goes up left. Light: it launches up left along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

icons.name: arrow-down-right
icons.label: Arrow down right
icons.intent: The arrow goes down right. Light: it launches down right along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

icons.name: arrow-down-left
icons.label: Arrow down left
icons.intent: The arrow goes down left. Light: it launches down left along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

icons.name: chevron-right
icons.label: Chevron right
icons.intent: The chevron moves on, right. Light: it slides right through its point, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh chevron slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a fainter echo chasing it, and the fresh chevron lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats.

icons.name: chevron-left
icons.label: Chevron left
icons.intent: The chevron moves on, left. Light: it slides left through its point, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh chevron slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a fainter echo chasing it, and the fresh chevron lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats.

icons.name: chevron-up
icons.label: Chevron up
icons.intent: The chevron moves on, up. Light: it slides up through its point, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh chevron slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a fainter echo chasing it, and the fresh chevron lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats.

icons.name: chevron-down
icons.label: Chevron down
icons.intent: The chevron moves on, down. Light: it slides down through its point, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh chevron slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a fainter echo chasing it, and the fresh chevron lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats.

icons.name: arrows-horizontal
icons.label: Horizontal arrows
icons.intent: It extends both ways. Light: the two halves launch outward from the middle, each along its own head, and fade before the edges; a fresh pair grows back out of the middle, lands just past rest and settles. Strong: they pull in first, then launch farther while a fading shaft keeps them joined, so the arrow stretches before it goes, and the fresh pair lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. v1's single shaft is split at the middle so each half travels with its head; at rest it draws the same.

icons.name: arrows-vertical
icons.label: Vertical arrows
icons.intent: It extends up and down. Light: the two halves launch outward from the middle, each along its own head, and fade before the edges; a fresh pair grows back out of the middle, lands just past rest and settles. Strong: they pull in first, then launch farther while a fading shaft keeps them joined, so the arrow stretches before it goes, and the fresh pair lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. v1's single shaft is split at the middle so each half travels with its head; at rest it draws the same.

icons.name: arrows-swap
icons.label: Swap arrows
icons.intent: The two lanes trade. Light: the top arrow launches right and fades before the edge while a fresh one slides in from the left and settles; the bottom arrow does the same to the left, 80 ms behind. Strong: each winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail, and its fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats.

icons.name: arrow-turn-right
icons.label: Turn right
icons.intent: The turn is taken. Light: the outlet and head launch right out of the bend, accelerating, and fade before the edge; a fresh outlet slides out of the bend, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back into the bend first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh outlet lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. The stem and bend never move.

icons.name: arrow-turn-left
icons.label: Turn left
icons.intent: The turn is taken. Light: the outlet and head launch left out of the bend, accelerating, and fade before the edge; a fresh outlet slides out of the bend, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back into the bend first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh outlet lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. The stem and bend never move.

icons.name: arrow-u-turn
icons.label: U-turn
icons.intent: The U-turn is taken. Light: the outlet and head launch back down out of the bend, accelerating, and fade before the edge; a fresh outlet slides out of the bend, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back into the bend first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh outlet lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. The stem and bend never move.

icons.name: arrows-expand
icons.label: Expand arrows
icons.intent: It opens out. Light: the four corner arrows launch outward along their diagonals and fade before the edges; a fresh set bursts out of the middle, lands just past rest and settles. Strong: they pull in first, launch farther with speed streaks behind them, and the fresh set lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats.

icons.name: arrows-collapse
icons.label: Collapse arrows
icons.intent: It closes in. Light: the four corner arrows launch inward along their diagonals until their heads nearly meet, fading as they go; a fresh set slides in from the corners, lands just past rest and settles. Strong: they pull out first, launch in harder with speed streaks behind them, and the fresh set lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats.

icons.name: annotation-curve-right
icons.label: Curved pointer right
icons.intent: The curve writes from its source to a fixed target; the head completes the annotation.

icons.name: annotation-curve-left
icons.label: Curved pointer left
icons.intent: The curve writes from its source to a fixed target; the head completes the annotation.

icons.name: annotation-s-curve
icons.label: S-curve pointer
icons.intent: A flowing S connects two levels before the target head opens.

icons.name: annotation-swoop-up
icons.label: Swoop up
icons.intent: The planted stroke sweeps through a broad bend, then finishes at the target.

icons.name: annotation-swoop-down
icons.label: Swoop down
icons.intent: The planted stroke sweeps through a broad bend, then finishes at the target.

icons.name: annotation-loop
icons.label: Curled pointer
icons.intent: One deliberate curl crosses its stem and writes toward a fixed target.

icons.name: annotation-elbow
icons.label: Elbow callout
icons.intent: The line turns through a rounded elbow; the arrowhead opens and settles.

icons.name: annotation-bracket
icons.label: Bracket callout
icons.intent: The source connects, then the bracket opens to mark a range.

icons.name: annotation-callout
icons.label: Callout pointer
icons.intent: A label box sends a curved leader toward the marked detail.

icons.name: annotation-split
icons.label: Split connector
icons.intent: One source reaches its junction before two branches write to separate targets.

icons.name: annotation-merge
icons.label: Merge connector
icons.intent: Two incoming strokes meet before the shared route reaches its target.

icons.name: annotation-double-ended
icons.label: Curved double pointer
icons.intent: The source arrow anchors a broad arch that finishes with a second head.

icons.name: annotation-zigzag
icons.label: Zigzag pointer
icons.intent: A zigzag arrow writes from its source dot to the target. Light: the stroke writes on zig by zig from the dot, then the head opens at the tip. Strong: the dot presses as the pen lands, the zigzag writes fast while its zigs stretch and spring back, and the head snaps open past its angle and settles. The preview reset fades the arrow back to the dot.

icons.name: annotation-wave
icons.label: Wavy pointer
icons.intent: A wavy arrow writes from its source dot to the target. Light: the stroke writes on crest by crest from the dot, then the head opens at the tip. Strong: the dot presses as the pen lands, the wave writes fast while its crests swell and ripple back, and the head snaps open past its angle and settles. The preview reset fades the arrow back to the dot.

icons.name: annotation-spiral
icons.label: Spiral pointer
icons.intent: A spiral arrow unwinds from its source dot and shoots off to the target. Light: the stroke winds out from the dot at its heart in widening turns, runs off along the last turn, then the head opens at the tip. Strong: the dot presses as the pen lands, the spiral whips out fast while its coils swell and spring back, and the head snaps open past its angle and settles. The preview reset fades the arrow back to the dot.

icons.name: annotation-dashed
icons.label: Dashed pointer
icons.intent: A dashed arrow stitches a suggested path from its source dot to the target. Light: the dashes write on one after another along the curve, then the head opens at the tip. Strong: the dot presses as the pen lands, the dashes stitch in quickly, each sliding into place along the path and settling, and the head snaps open past its angle and settles. The preview reset fades the arrow back to the dot.

icons.name: annotation-bounce
icons.label: Bouncing pointer
icons.intent: A bouncing arrow hops from its source dot to the target. Light: the stroke writes on in two hops, a big one and a smaller one, easing over each crest, then the head opens where it lands. Strong: the dot presses as the pen lands, the hops write fast and spring higher before settling back, and the head snaps open past its angle and settles. The preview reset fades the arrow back to the dot.

icons.name: annotation-emphasis
icons.label: Emphasis pointer
icons.intent: An arrow points at a spot and bursts emphasis marks around its tip: look here. Light: the stroke writes from the source dot, the head opens, and three short marks draw out around the tip one after another. Strong: the dot presses as the pen lands, the stroke writes fast and the head snaps open, then the marks burst out past their place and settle. The preview reset fades the arrow and marks back to the dot.

icons.name: annotation-numbered
icons.label: Numbered pointer
icons.intent: A numbered step badge sends an arrow to the detail it marks. Light: the leader writes out of the badge and curves down to the detail, then the head opens. Strong: the badge presses and pops as the pen leaves it, the leader writes fast while its curve swings out and back, and the head snaps open past its angle and settles. The preview reset fades the arrow back to the badge.

icons.name: annotation-circled
icons.label: Circled pointer
icons.intent: An arrow points at a spot and a hand-drawn circle rings it. Light: the stroke writes from the source dot, the head opens, then one loose loop circles the spot and overlaps its start. Strong: the dot presses as the pen lands, the stroke writes fast and the head snaps open, then the loop whips round the spot, swelling past its size and settling. The preview reset fades the arrow and circle back to the dot.

icons.name: invite-teammate
icons.label: Invite teammate
icons.intent: The invitation is sent and the teammate receives it. Light: the sealed envelope draws back, then darts toward the teammate nose-down and stops with a hit; the teammate perks up with a hop as it arrives, and the envelope glides back to its place. Strong: a deeper draw-back, a longer dart to a harder hit, the teammate hops twice, and the envelope swings back with a small overshoot.

icons.name: join-team
icons.label: Join team
icons.intent: A new member takes their seat at the team's table and the team welcomes them. Light: the fourth seat slides in to the round table, docks with a hit and a small rebound, and the table pulses once as it lands. Strong: the seat draws back first, drives in harder with two settling swings, the table pulses bigger, and the welcome ripples round the circle: the neighbouring seats open out and back, then the far seat. Ends with the new seat in the ring, as in v1; the preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose.

icons.name: team-directory
icons.label: Team directory
icons.intent: Flipping through the team directory to the next member. Light: the front member card flips up into the file about its top edge and the next card drops down in its place, landing with a small rebound. Strong: two cards flip over in quick succession, the second landing with a settle. The card behind never moves.

icons.name: team-roles
icons.label: Team roles
icons.intent: A role is assigned and its badge is put on. Light: the role title clears, the badge is tugged out on its clip and swings back, and the role title writes itself in under the avatar as the swing settles. Strong: a small wind-up, a wider tug, two decaying swings, and the role title writes in as the badge comes to rest.

icons.name: team-presence
icons.label: Team presence
icons.intent: Two presence arcs sweep open beside the teammate and stay lit; Strong over-sweeps and settles

icons.name: assign-task
icons.label: Assign task
icons.intent: The assignee drops onto the task tile; the check confirms ownership. Strong lands with a hit and recoil.

icons.name: delegate-task
icons.label: Delegate task
icons.intent: The owner pushes the task tile away; the arrow trails behind and its head lands when the stem reaches the tip. Strong anticipates then pushes decisively.

icons.name: task-handoff
icons.label: Task handoff
icons.intent: The giver releases and the baton slides into the receiver, who nods on receipt. Strong launches faster and the receiver recoils on contact.

icons.name: task-dependency
icons.label: Task dependency
icons.intent: The dependency link draws from task A down and across; its head points at waiting task B. Strong draws it as one decisive stroke and B registers the contact.

icons.name: shared-goal
icons.label: Shared goal
icons.intent: Two teammates aim at the same goal ring; both arrows arrive and the centre lights. Strong arrives together with a ring recoil.

icons.name: kanban-board
icons.label: Kanban board
icons.intent: A card is dragged from the first column into the next. Strong lifts it higher, slides faster with one small overshoot and drops it in place.

icons.name: sprint-cycle
icons.label: Sprint cycle
icons.intent: Three iteration laps index around the sprint goal. Light advances one quiet 120° step to the next equivalent pose; Strong winds back and drives one full decisive turn.

icons.name: team-roadmap
icons.label: Team roadmap
icons.intent: A rounded route draws upward from the first stop; each next stop appears as the route reaches it. Strong draws the whole route in one decisive stroke.

icons.name: milestone
icons.label: Milestone
icons.intent: A planted flag marks the milestone. A travelling wave runs out along the banner and settles; Strong flaps with a larger, faster wave.

icons.name: team-workload
icons.label: Team workload
icons.intent: Work moves off the overloaded member onto the lightest. Light: the end of the top bar breaks off as the bar shortens, drops past the middle bar to the bottom row with a hit, slides in against the bottom bar, and the bottom bar grows to take it. Strong: the piece drops faster and bounces on landing, slides in harder, the bottom member dips as the load arrives and the top member lifts, relieved. Bar lengths only ever shrink or grow, with no overshoot. Ends with the rebalanced bars, as in v1; the preview reset fades them back.

icons.name: shared-document
icons.label: Shared document
icons.intent: A collaborator joins the page: the person shifts aside, the shared shoulder line opens, and a second head appears; the pair stays.

icons.name: co-edit
icons.label: Co-edit
icons.intent: Two carets type toward each other on the same document; both written lines remain.

icons.name: live-cursors
icons.label: Live cursors
icons.intent: Two collaborators act on the canvas at once. Light: the first cursor glides out to a spot and clicks, pressing in on its tip as three click rays burst from it; 100 ms later the second cursor glides the other way and clicks too; both glide home. Strong: the cursors travel further and overshoot as they arrive, the first clicks once and the second double-clicks, each click with its own burst, and they glide home with a small settle.

icons.name: follow-collaborator
icons.label: Follow collaborator
icons.intent: The followed person moves; your viewport brackets catch up and hold on them.

icons.name: suggested-edit
icons.label: Suggested edit
icons.intent: A suggestion pill opens after the existing text and the proposed insertion writes inside it; the suggestion stays pending.

icons.name: add-comment
icons.label: Add comment
icons.intent: An insertion stem inside a comment bubble; the crossbar draws outward to complete a plus. Strong presses the bubble down while the bar fires.

icons.name: reply-thread
icons.label: Reply thread
icons.intent: A reply arrow draws from beneath the parent message, curves down and hooks left; the head opens on arrival. Strong dips the card, fires the draw past the tip and settles.

icons.name: mention-teammate
icons.label: Mention teammate
icons.intent: The @ is typed and the teammate answers the call. Light: the @ writes itself, its tail running round the ring, and pops as it closes; the teammate perks up with a hop and two ping marks flash beside their head, then they land with a small rebound. Strong: the @ writes in and pops harder with a settle, and the teammate jumps higher, turning toward the @, with the ping marks, then lands with a hit and a second smaller hop.

icons.name: resolve-thread
icons.label: Resolve thread
icons.intent: A check draws across the discussion thread and is retained. Strong gathers the rows, fires a decisive stroke past the tip and settles.

icons.name: reopen-thread
icons.label: Reopen thread
icons.intent: A return arrow draws from the bottom of the thread up and back into the first comment. Strong winds up a stub, fires the full draw and snaps the head open.

icons.name: request-review
icons.label: Request review
icons.intent: A sheet is offered up; the reviewer's closed eye opens on it and stays open.

icons.name: approve-change
icons.label: Approve change
icons.intent: The stamp presses the change card; a check is traced and holds.

icons.name: request-changes
icons.label: Request changes
icons.intent: The pencil taps; a return arrow draws back and its head lands. Arrow holds.

icons.name: compare-revisions
icons.label: Compare revisions
icons.intent: The compare slider is grabbed and scrubbed across the revisions, and the change shows. Light: the knob swells as it is grabbed, the slider scrubs right, then snaps back to the middle with a hit and a small rebound as the knob lets go, and the changed line on the right writes itself in. Strong: a small pull left, a longer scrub right to a hit, a snap back past the middle that settles, and both right-hand lines rewrite in turn. The frame and the left line never move.

icons.name: version-history
icons.label: Version history
icons.intent: The spine extends up, a new version dot commits and its entry bar draws. Entry holds.

icons.name: share-workspace
icons.label: Share workspace
icons.intent: The workspace is sent out to others. Light: the share arrow shoots off to the right and fades as the panel recoils, then a fresh arrow slides out of the panel's edge and stops in place with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: the arrow draws back into the panel first, shoots off harder as the panel kicks back, and the fresh arrow slides out past its place and settles.

icons.name: invite-link
icons.label: Invite link
icons.intent: The invite link is forged, then the invite is created. Light: the plus clears, the two chain loops pull apart and snap back into each other with a hit and a small rebound, and the plus writes itself in, bar then post, and pops once. Strong: the loops pull further apart and snap harder with two rebounds, and the plus writes in and pops bigger with a settle.

icons.name: guest-access
icons.label: Guest access
icons.intent: The gate bar lifts from its post to admit the waiting visitor and closes again; Strong dips, swings 55 degrees to a hit and settles before closing.

icons.name: view-access
icons.label: View access
icons.intent: The eye is given access and the shared content comes into view. Light: the content clears and the eye blinks shut, springs open with a small overshoot, glances down, and the two lines of content write themselves in, top then bottom. Strong: a double blink, then the pupil reads along the content, sweeping from left to right as the lines write in, and returns to the middle with a hit and a settle.

icons.name: edit-access
icons.label: Edit access
icons.intent: The pencil draws a real mark along the field and keeps it; Strong lifts, lands and draws the full stroke fast with a short recoil. Reset withdraws the mark and slides the pencil back.

icons.name: standup
icons.label: Standup
icons.intent: The middle teammate stands up to give the daily update, then sits back.

icons.name: raise-hand
icons.label: Raise hand
icons.intent: A teammate puts their hand up to ask for the floor. Light: the arm shoots up from the shoulder until the hand is above the shoulder beside the head, stops with a hit and a small rebound, holds, then drops back down with a hit. Strong: a short wind-up, the arm shoots up harder as the body straightens, the hand waves twice at the top ('pick me'), then drops back with a hit and a small bounce.

icons.name: team-poll
icons.label: Team poll
icons.intent: Votes arrive and the option bars fill to the team result, which holds.

icons.name: decision-log
icons.label: Decision log
icons.intent: The stamp strikes the log entry; the recorded check stays.

icons.name: team-celebration
icons.label: Team celebration
icons.intent: The team raises a toast and the glasses clink. Light: both glasses lift and tip in toward each other, meet at the rims with a hit as three sparks flash up from the clink, bounce apart a little and come back upright. Strong: the glasses tip back first, swing in harder to the clink with bigger sparks, bounce apart and clink a second, smaller time with a second flash, then settle upright.

icons.name: support-agent
icons.label: Support agent
icons.intent: A call comes in and the agent takes it. Light: the caller's voice arrives as an arc at each ear cup, travelling in and fading as it lands, and the agent nods once in answer, rebounds and settles. Strong: two calls of voice arrive in turn and the agent nods twice, the second deeper, with the boom mic swinging on its hinge a beat behind. The shoulders never move.

icons.name: help-center
icons.label: Help center
icons.intent: Help is thrown in. Light: the lifebuoy is tossed up spinning a whole turn, splashes down, bobs once and settles; a ripple draws out on each side of it at the waterline as it lands and fades. Strong: a wind-up, a higher toss, a deeper splash with two bobs, and the ripples spread wider. The end pose is the rest pose.

icons.name: support-ticket
icons.label: Support ticket
icons.intent: The ticket is torn off. Light: the stub peels away from the top of the seam, a fleck flying off there, strains a beat, then the bottom gives with a second fleck and the stub jerks free to the right, swings past its tilt and settles torn away, where it stays. Strong: a deeper peel that strains twice, a harder rip that overshoots further and settles in two beats. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared ticket.

icons.name: live-support
icons.label: Live support
icons.intent: An agent answers live. Light: the typing dots in the agent's bubble hop in a wave, left to right, then the reply bubble posts: it nudges up toward the customer, rebounds and settles. Strong: the customer's message pops in first, the dots type two waves, and the reply nudges up further and settles in two beats.

icons.name: callback
icons.label: Callback
icons.intent: A return arrow draws back from the right and lands on the handset; the head grows at arrival and the receiver rocks in response. The drawn arrow is retained.

icons.name: ask-question
icons.label: Ask a question
icons.intent: A question is posted in a speech bubble. Light: the bubble ducks into its tail and pops out as the question posts, and the question mark inside tilts quizzically and swings back upright. Strong: a deeper duck and a bigger pop with a rebound, and the question mark tilts one way, then the other, settling in smaller swings.

icons.name: report-problem
icons.label: Report a problem
icons.intent: A problem is reported in a speech bubble. Light: the exclamation stem strikes down onto its dot and the bubble buzzes with alarm in a quick shake that dies away. Strong: the bubble rears back as the stem winds up, the strike lands harder and the bubble buzzes wider, in more beats, before it settles.

icons.name: help-search
icons.label: Search help
icons.intent: The help center is searched for an answer: a magnifier with a question mark in its lens. Light: the magnifier glides out to the left, scanning, with the question mark tilting as it looks, then lands back on its spot with a hit; the question sits upright and the lens pops as the answer is found. Strong: it scans left and then right with the question tilting each way, lands harder, and the lens pops bigger with a rebound.

icons.name: faq
icons.label: FAQ
icons.intent: A frequently asked question gets its answer: a question bubble and an answer bubble. Light: the question mark tilts as the question is asked, then the answer bubble pops out of its tail in reply and its two lines of answer write on. Strong: the question mark tilts one way and the other, the answer bubble ducks deeper and pops bigger with a rebound, and the answer writes on as it lands.

icons.name: help-desk
icons.label: Help desk
icons.intent: The service bell on the help desk is rung for assistance. Light: the plunger is pressed down with a hit and springs back, the dome gives under the strike, and a ding mark flicks out from each shoulder of the bell and fades. Strong: ding-ding: two presses, the second harder, each ringing out its own pair of ding marks, and the dome gives more on the second.

icons.name: emergency-sos
icons.label: Emergency SOS
icons.intent: The emergency siren light goes off to call for help. Light: the beacon turns once, its beam sweeping from left to right: each ray flashes out from the dome in turn and the glint inside the dome flashes as the beam passes the front. Strong: the beacon turns twice, sweeping across two times in quick succession.

icons.name: chat-widget
icons.label: Chat widget
icons.intent: The support chat launcher is clicked open. Light: the round launcher presses in and springs back, its chat bubble turns away and fades, and the close cross spins in a quarter turn in its place, overshoots and settles; the cross stays while the chat is open. Strong: a deeper press with a rebound, and the cross spins in a half turn with a bigger overshoot. The reverse spins the cross out and the bubble pops back in.

icons.name: response-time
icons.label: Response time
icons.intent: The wait for a reply is timed: a round chat bubble with clock hands. Light: the minute hand sweeps one full turn at a steady pace and stops dead on the hour, and the bubble hops as the reply lands, then settles. Strong: the hand winds back first, sweeps round faster and stops dead, and the bubble hops higher and lands with two bounces.

icons.name: saved-replies
icons.label: Saved replies
icons.intent: A saved reply is sent in one click: a speech bubble with a lightning bolt. Light: the bolt zaps on, flashing in from small and swelling past full size, and the bubble hops as the reply posts, lands with a hit and settles. Strong: the bolt flickers on twice and swells bigger, and the bubble hops higher and lands with two bounces.

icons.name: help-article
icons.label: Help article
icons.intent: A help article is pulled up to answer a question: a page with a folded corner and a question mark. Light: the page lifts as it is opened, the question mark writes itself on across it, and the page lands with a hit and one small bounce. Strong: the page lifts higher with a slight tilt, the question writes on faster, and the page lands harder and bounces twice.

icons.name: tech-support
icons.label: Tech support
icons.intent: Tech support fixes the computer: a monitor with a spanner on its screen. Light: the spanner cranks clockwise round the bolt in its head and stops dead as it tightens, holds a beat, then swings back and settles. Strong: the spanner winds back first, then cranks the bolt twice, each crank stopping dead, before it swings back and settles.

icons.name: customer-care
icons.label: Customer care
icons.intent: Care is offered: an open hand holds up a heart. Light: the hand lifts and the heart rises off the palm with one beat, swelling and easing back, then settles onto the palm with a small bounce. Strong: the hand lifts higher and the heart beats twice as it rises, the second beat smaller, before it lands back on the palm.

icons.name: submit-request
icons.label: Submit a request
icons.intent: A new support request is opened: a support ticket with a plus on it. Light: the plus draws on, the upright stroke first and the crossbar after it, then pops once as the request is created and settles. Strong: the ticket thumps down as the plus draws on faster, the plus pops bigger with a hit and a rebound, and the ticket bounces once.

icons.name: schedule-call
icons.label: Schedule a call
icons.intent: A support call booked on the calendar comes due: a calendar page with a phone handset on it. Light: the handset rings, rattling about its centre in beats that die away, and the calendar jolts as the first ring hits. Strong: it rings twice, ring, pause, ring, each ring jolting the calendar, the second rattle wider.

icons.name: context-help
icons.label: Context help
icons.intent: What's this? The help pointer clicks on something to explain it: a pointer arrow with a question mark beside it. Light: the pointer presses in on its tip as it clicks, and the question mark pops out beside it past full size, then tilts quizzically and settles. Strong: the pointer double-clicks, and the question mark pops bigger and tilts one way, then the other, before it settles.

icons.name: file-upload
icons.label: File upload
icons.intent: The file goes up. Light: the arrow sinks toward the port to load, and the port gives under it, dipping and spreading; then the arrow launches up beside the sheet, overshoots and settles 4.5 units higher, where it stays, while the port springs back. Strong: a deeper load, a harder launch that settles in two beats, and a bigger give that settles in two beats. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared arrow.

icons.name: file-download
icons.label: File download
icons.intent: The download lands. Light: the arrow drops down beside the sheet and stops dead past its mark; the port below takes the knock, dipping and spreading, then springs back while the arrow rebounds and settles at its new depth, where it stays. Strong: the arrow lifts first, drops harder and settles in two beats, and the port takes a bigger knock that settles in two beats. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared arrow.

icons.name: attach-file
icons.label: Attach file
icons.intent: The clip bites onto the sheet. Light: the clip drops in through the sheet's open top and drives into it; the sheet takes the knock, squashing down from the top as the clip rides it, then springs back and the clip settles seated, where it stays. Strong: the clip lifts first, drives in harder, and the sheet squashes deeper and settles in two beats. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared clip.

icons.name: detach-file
icons.label: Detach file
icons.intent: The clip is pulled off the sheet. Light: the clip tugs and the sheet comes up with it, stretching from the top; then the clip snaps free, springs up past its mark and settles above the sheet, where it stays, while the sheet drops back, overshoots and settles. Strong: the clip sticks and tugs twice before it snaps free, springs higher and settles in two beats, and the sheet drops back harder. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared clip.

icons.name: cloud-upload
icons.label: Cloud upload
icons.intent: The file goes up into the cloud. Light: the arrow sinks to load, launches up through the opening, overshoots and settles 6 units higher inside the cloud, where it stays; the cloud takes it, bumping up as it arrives, rebounding and settling. Strong: a deeper load, a harder launch that settles in two beats, and a bigger bump that settles in two beats. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared arrow.

icons.name: cloud-download
icons.label: Cloud download
icons.intent: The file comes down out of the cloud. Light: the arrow shoots down, its shaft stretching out of the cloud, stops dead past its mark, springs back and settles at full length, where it stays; the cloud lifts as it lets go and settles. Strong: the arrow draws up into the cloud first, then drops harder and settles in two beats, and the cloud recoils further and settles in two beats. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared arrow.

icons.name: drag-and-drop
icons.label: Drag and drop
icons.intent: The card lifts, glides right and drops into the tray; Strong picks up sharply, flies straight in and lands with one damped settle.

icons.name: batch-upload
icons.label: Batch upload
icons.intent: Light sends three arrows upward in a quiet short stagger. Strong preloads, launches decisively and settles once; the open tray recoils. Both hold the same advanced arrows until preview reset.

icons.name: compress-files
icons.label: Compress files
icons.intent: The press plate descends into the archive and the three sheets close their gaps in sequence; Strong winds up, strikes, and settles once.

icons.name: extract-files
icons.label: Extract files
icons.intent: Both lid flaps swing open on the box corners, then the card rises clear of the rim and holds; Strong flings the flaps past open and lifts the card with one overshoot.

icons.name: upload-failed
icons.label: Upload failed
icons.intent: An upload into the cloud fails and falls back. Light: an arrowhead grows on the alert's stem, the arrow sinks to load and launches up into the cloud, hits its ceiling and stops dead while the cloud takes the knock; then it drops back, the arrowhead fades, and the stem lands on its spot as an exclamation mark again, knocking the dot down, which settles. Strong: two tries: the first falls short and drops back, the second launches harder, hits the ceiling, and the cloud shakes its refusal side to side while the arrow drops and the exclamation lands in two beats.

icons.name: send-to-device
icons.label: Send to device
icons.intent: A file is sent to the phone. Light: the arrow winds back, shoots right into the phone and fades as it reaches the screen; the phone takes the delivery, recoiling and settling, a check draws on inside its screen and fades, and a fresh arrow slides back into place. Strong: a deeper wind-up and a faster send; the phone buzzes side to side as the check snaps on.

icons.name: save-offline
icons.label: Save offline
icons.intent: A file is kept on the device for offline use. Light: the arrow in the badge drops onto its base, its shaft shortening as it lands, and the arrowhead folds into a check; the badge dips under the landing and settles, and the check stays. Strong: a faster, harder landing; the badge dips deeper and settles in two beats. The reverse lifts the check back up into the arrow: the offline copy is removed.

icons.name: merge-files
icons.label: Merge files
icons.intent: Two files are merged into one. Light: the two sheets slide together, the right one a beat behind the left, and meet in the middle, where one larger sheet takes their place with a pop and settles; its two content lines draw on, one for each file. Strong: the sheets pull apart first, then slam together; the merged sheet pops bigger and settles in two beats. The preview reset fades it back to the two sheets.

icons.name: split-file
icons.label: Split file
icons.intent: One file is split into two. Light: the sheet parts along its seam and the two halves pull apart, each growing into a whole sheet of its own; the left one gains its folded corner as it lands, and both rebound once and settle. Strong: the halves crack open from the top first, then snap apart harder and settle in two beats. The preview reset slides the two sheets back together into the single sheet.

icons.name: virus-scan
icons.label: Virus scan
icons.intent: A file is scanned for viruses and comes out safe. Light: a scan line sweeps down the sheet from top to bottom and fades, and as it finishes the shield beside the file stamps down, popping up from its point and settling. Strong: the scan line sweeps down and back up, and the shield stamps harder and settles in two beats.

icons.name: shred-file
icons.label: Shred file
icons.intent: A file is shredded. Light: the shredder pulls the sheet down into its slot, its top edge sinking until it is gone, while the body rattles and the cut strips push out longer underneath. Strong: the shredder grabs the sheet in two hard pulls with a pause between, rattling harder each time, and the strips lurch out in two steps. The preview reset draws the strips back up and fades the sheet back in, waiting at the slot.

icons.name: cloud-backup
icons.label: Cloud backup
icons.intent: Files are backed up to the cloud. Light: the backup arrow inside the cloud runs one full turn clockwise and comes to rest on its mark, and the cloud takes the copy, bumping up and settling. Strong: the arrow winds back first, then runs a fast turn that overshoots its mark and settles back, and the cloud bumps higher and settles in two beats.

icons.name: nearby-share
icons.label: Nearby share
icons.intent: A file is shared with nearby devices over the air. Light: the sheet dips to load, then the signal arcs above it pulse out one after the other, inner then outer, each swelling past its place and settling, while the sheet springs back up. Strong: two pulses, the second bigger, and the sheet lifts higher as it sends.

icons.name: blocked-file
icons.label: Blocked file
icons.intent: A file is blocked. Light: the slash strikes across the circle on the sheet, drawing on fast and stopping dead, and the sheet shakes its refusal side to side and settles. Strong: the slash strikes harder and the sheet shakes in more, wider swings.

icons.name: add-remove
icons.label: Add / remove
icons.intent: The vertical bar folds down onto the horizontal bar: plus becomes minus and holds; reverse stands it back up.

icons.name: close
icons.label: Close
icons.intent: The X strikes itself out. Light: both strokes vanish, the first slashes back on from top-left, the second follows 80 ms later from top-right, and the finished X pops once and settles. Strong: the X slashes on while turning into place, lands with a hit and pops harder with a rebound.

icons.name: undo-redo
icons.label: Undo / redo
icons.intent: The whole undo arrow winds back a few degrees, then swings a half turn about the canvas centre so its head points forward: undo becomes redo. Reverse swings it back.

icons.name: more-options
icons.label: More options
icons.intent: Tapping the button opens the overflow menu. Light: the centre dot is pressed down with a hit, and 70 ms later the outer dots are pushed apart, then spring back in and land with a hit and a small rebound while the centre dot rises back. Strong: a deeper press, the outer dots pushed farther apart, the centre dot rebounding above the row, and the outer dots landing with two decaying rebounds. The dots only translate: the filled-ellipsis contract fixes each dot's diameter to the outline weight in every key, so nothing scales, morphs or is added.

icons.name: external-link
icons.label: External link
icons.intent: The link leaves. Light: the arrow winds back a touch, shoots out through the open corner and fades before the edge, then a new arrow glides in from inside the window and settles at rest. Strong: it leaves farther with a speed trail that retracts into the corner behind it, and the returning arrow overshoots toward the corner and rebounds. The window never moves.

icons.name: share
icons.label: Share
icons.intent: The hand-off travels from the source to both branches. Light: the hub draws its connectors in as it gathers, then sends: the top connector draws out to its node and the bottom one follows, and each node pops as the connector reaches it. Strong: a deeper gather, a harder send, and each node is knocked out along its connector as it pops bigger, then swings back to rest. The rest pose is the v1 drawing.

icons.name: cut
icons.label: Cut
icons.intent: The scissors snip and the cut runs ahead of them. Light: the blades open and snap shut, a cut line draws out up between them as they close and fades, then a smaller second snip. Strong: three decaying snips, wider, and the cut extends further with each of the first two.

icons.name: paste
icons.label: Paste
icons.intent: Clipboard content drops onto the board and stays; Strong hangs, then slaps down with one settle.

icons.name: zoom-in-out
icons.label: Zoom in / out
icons.intent: The magnifier zooms in. Light: the lying bar swings up to stand across the other, minus becomes plus, lands upright with a hit and a small rebound, and a beat later the lens swells, magnifying the plus, and settles. Strong: the bar winds back first, swings past upright and settles in the same fold add-remove uses, and the lens dips, then swells harder and settles in two beats. The handle never moves. The reverse lays the bar back down while the lens shrinks: zooming out.

icons.name: select-all
icons.label: Select all
icons.intent: Everything is selected. Light: the selection boundary runs on from the corner bracket round the right side, the bottom and up the left until it closes, and each object pops as the boundary passes it, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, then the first one as the loop closes. Strong: the boundary accelerates round in one stroke and closes with a hit that makes the whole selection pulse, and the objects pop bigger with a rebound. The reverse retracts the boundary to the bracket without a pop.

icons.name: move-tool
icons.label: Move tool
icons.intent: The handle shows it moves every way. Light: each arm of the cross shoots out along its own direction in turn, clockwise from the top, its shaft stretching with it, and snaps back with a small rebound, so the push runs round the four directions. Strong: the whole cross gathers in first, then the arms shoot out farther in the same clockwise run, rebound and settle in two beats.

icons.name: grid-list-view
icons.label: Grid / list view
icons.intent: Four grid tiles puff, flatten into bars in place, then stretch across the window into four list rows. Reverse rebuilds the 2x2 grid.

icons.name: sidebar-toggle
icons.label: Sidebar toggle
icons.intent: The sidebar collapses to a rail. Light: the divider leans open a touch, then drives left, the sidebar's tint narrowing with it, and hits the rail with a small rebound; a beat later the chevron flips over to point back out and nudges that way. Strong: a bigger lean, a harder drive that hits the rail and rebounds twice, and the chevron flips and kicks out farther before it settles. The frame never moves. The reverse reopens the panel.

icons.name: split-view
icons.label: Split view
icons.intent: The window splits in two. Light: the divider vanishes and cuts down through the window from top to bottom, the grip pops in at its middle as the cut passes, overshoots and settles, and the left pane's tint fills in. Strong: the cut runs down faster and lands with a hit, and the grip drops down the divider from the top edge, lands on the middle with a hit and bounces twice before it settles. The frame never moves.

icons.name: tab-switcher
icons.label: Tab switcher
icons.intent: Inside the tab strip the active-tab bar pulls back, then drives across to the second slot; the slot markers swap so the neighbour becomes active.

icons.name: command-menu
icons.label: Command menu
icons.intent: The command key is pressed and the command fires. Light: the glyph pinches in and bottoms out with a hit (its square closes up and the four loops are drawn in with it, keeping their size) while the keycap's edge flashes up around it and spreads away, fading; the glyph springs back a little past its size and settles. Strong: a double press, a light tap then a deeper press that bottoms out harder with the keycap flash, and a bigger spring with two settling beats.

icons.name: drag-handle
icons.label: Drag handle
icons.intent: The gripped row is moved down one place. Light: the row is pulled out to the right, carried down one slot while the row below rises into its place and lands with a small rebound, then the moved row slides back into the list and seats with a hit and a rebound. Strong: the row is first pressed back and lifted, yanked out farther, carried down past its slot and back, and seated with a hit and two rebounds, while the displaced row lands and rebounds twice. The bottom row never moves. The reverse moves the row back up the same way.

icons.name: archive
icons.label: Archive
icons.intent: Something is filed. Light: the lid lifts, a document card slides out from under it and drops into the box (clipped at the rim), and the lid follows it down with a hit and a small bounce. Strong: the lid lifts with a tilt, two cards drop in turn, and the lid slams with a bounce and a settle. The box never moves.

icons.name: target
icons.label: Target
icons.intent: The reticle locks on. Light: the four ticks close in on the mark and stop with a hit, the ring tightens a beat after them and the centre dot pops as the lock lands, then the reticle releases back out with a small rebound. Strong: the ticks first swing a third of a quarter-turn off and open wide, searching, then snap back and close in harder, the ring tightens more, the dot pops bigger and everything settles in two beats.

icons.name: power
icons.label: Power
icons.intent: The bar rises out of the ring and locks into the top gap to switch on; reverse sinks it back to off.

icons.name: sign-in-out
icons.label: Sign in / out
icons.intent: Arrow enters the open doorway and stays inside; Sign out slides it back out.

icons.name: switch-account
icons.label: Switch account
icons.intent: The selection marker slides from the personal account to the work account; the chosen person nods.

icons.name: id-card
icons.label: ID card
icons.intent: The card is read and the holder's details fill in. Light: the photo pops as the identity is captured, then the first detail line writes out to full length and the second follows a beat later; the details stay. Strong: the card taps down onto a reader and springs back, the photo pops harder, and the two lines write out in turn, each stopping crisply at full length. The preview reset fades the details back to their stubs.

icons.name: password
icons.label: Password
icons.intent: Masked characters type into the field one by one and stay entered.

icons.name: passkey
icons.label: Passkey
icons.intent: The passkey lets the person in. Light: the key turns 30 degrees like a key in a lock and stops dead (the click), holds, and turns back quickly; the click sends one arc out of the bow towards the person, and a beat later the account holder hops up, signed in, and lands. Strong: the key winds back first, turns further and bounces on the click, and the person hops higher, then once more, smaller.

icons.name: fingerprint
icons.label: Fingerprint
icons.intent: The finger presses onto the sensor and its ridges light from the core outward.

icons.name: face-authentication
icons.label: Face authentication
icons.intent: The face is scanned and recognised. Light: a scan line appears at the top of the frame, sweeps down over the face and fades; as it finishes, the four corner brackets snap in onto the face (hit), rebound and settle. Strong: the scan sweeps down and back up, the brackets lock on harder with a bounce, and the face gives a small nod of acceptance.

icons.name: two-factor-code
icons.label: Two-factor code
icons.intent: Two cells receive a code: dots bloom in sequence in Light; in Strong each cell takes a key press and its dot pops in with one bounded settle.

icons.name: recovery-codes
icons.label: Recovery codes
icons.intent: A sheet of backup codes slides up out of its sleeve and stays out; reverse tucks it back.

icons.name: private-browsing
icons.label: Private browsing
icons.intent: Going incognito. Light: the glasses are pushed up and, a beat later, both lenses darken into shades with a highlight (left, then right), hold while the glasses drop back and settle, then clear. Strong: a dip, a higher push and a second sly lift (a double eyebrow raise) while the shades darken and stay dark longer before they clear. The highlight keeps each lens open, as the set's native-opening rule requires.

icons.name: cookie-preferences
icons.label: Cookie preferences
icons.intent: Preferences get set. Light: the cookie clicks round like a dial (12 degrees, stops dead) and its chips switch on one after another as it passes them, each popping and settling, before the sprung dial returns. Strong: the dial winds back first, clicks further round, and the chips pop larger in turn while the dial springs home in two swings.

icons.name: block-user
icons.label: Block user
icons.intent: A prohibition slash strikes across the badge and stays; the person flinches in Strong. Unblock retracts the slash.

icons.name: verified-badge
icons.label: Verified
icons.intent: The account is verified: the check is stamped into the badge. Light: the check clears, the scalloped badge dips and pops out with a small twist as the check writes in from its short stroke and stops dead, then the badge settles. Strong: a deeper dip with a counter-twist, a bigger pop and twist as the check writes in harder, and the badge stamps twice, each beat smaller, before it settles. The badge and the check keep their shape.

icons.name: account-settings
icons.label: Account settings
icons.intent: The account's settings are adjusted. Light: the gear beside the person presses in, turns one tooth clockwise and clicks into place with a hit and a small rebound, popping back out as it locks; a beat later the person nods. Strong: the gear winds back first, presses in harder and turns two teeth, clicks in with a two-beat settle, and the person nods deeper, then once more, smaller.

icons.name: edit-profile
icons.label: Edit profile
icons.intent: The profile is edited: the pencil writes. Light: the pencil beside the person lifts and slides back to the start of a line, touches down with a hit and writes a short scribble along the bottom back to where it rests; the scribble fades once the pencil stops. Strong: the pencil winds up first, stabs down harder and bounces on the line, writes the scribble, lifts off with a flick and lands, and the person perks up as the edit is saved.

icons.name: reset-password
icons.label: Reset password
icons.intent: The password is reset: the key is cut anew. Light: the arrow ring runs one turn counter-clockwise; as it goes the key's tooth and blade pull back into the bow, and as the ring comes round the blade shoots back out and stops dead, the tooth cuts in a beat behind and the key pops. Strong: the ring winds forward before it whips round, overshoots and settles, and the new blade lands harder with a two-beat pop. An invisible step returns the ring from -360 to 0.

icons.name: block-trackers
icons.label: Block trackers
icons.intent: Trackers are blocked: a slash strikes through the tracking reticle. Light: the reticle closes in to lock on, a slash strikes across it from top-left to bottom-right, and the reticle is thrown back open with a small rebound; the slash stays. Strong: the ticks swing off searching, snap back and close in harder, the slash strikes and snaps a little past its length, and the reticle is thrown wider and settles in two beats. Allow trackers retracts the slash to the top-left and the reticle locks on once again.

icons.name: vpn
icons.label: VPN
icons.intent: The VPN connects: the padlock clicks shut and the globe's traffic turns through it. Light: the shackle snaps open on its right leg and slams back shut with a hit, the padlock jolts, and a beat later the globe turns one meridian spacing, coasts a little past and settles. Strong: the shackle swings wider, slams and bounces once, the padlock jolts harder, and the globe spins two spacings, picking up speed through the first and settling after the second. The sphere outline and the equator never move.

icons.name: private-account
icons.label: Private account
icons.intent: The account is made private: the padlock beside the person locks. Light: the raised shackle swings shut and slams down into the padlock with a hit, the padlock jolts, and a beat later the person ducks and settles, out of public view. Strong: the shackle lifts and opens a little first, snaps shut and slams in, the padlock jolts harder, and the person ducks twice, each smaller. Make public pops the shackle up and swings it open with a small overshoot while the person perks up.

icons.name: delete-account
icons.label: Delete account
icons.intent: The account is deleted: it goes in the bin. Light: the bin's lid flips open on its left-hand hinge, the person tips toward the open bin, and the lid slams shut with a hit and a small rebound; the bin jolts and the person snaps back upright. Strong: the lid winds down, flips open wider and slams twice, the bin jolts on each slam, and the person tips further and rocks back in two beats before it settles.

icons.name: checkbox
icons.label: Checkbox
icons.intent: Box presses, check whips on; toggle retracts the check.

icons.name: radio-button
icons.label: Radio button
icons.intent: A nucleus appears then the dot bursts to size; toggle empties it.

icons.name: toggle-switch
icons.label: Toggle switch
icons.intent: Knob pulls back, snaps across the track, and settles; toggle returns it.

icons.name: text-field
icons.label: Text field
icons.intent: Caret blinks then advances as a line of text is entered.

icons.name: number-field
icons.label: Number field
icons.intent: Stepping the value up. Light: the up stepper kicks up as it is pressed and springs back; a beat later the value ticks over like a counter: the 1 rides up and fades out, then the 2 rises from below, fades in and lands, and the 2 stays. Strong: the stepper winds down before a harder kick, and the 2 lands with a small bounce. The preview reset fades the 1 back in.

icons.name: select-field
icons.label: Select field
icons.intent: The chevron flips over and the option panel drops open below the field; Strong winds the chevron back, whips it over and lands the panel with one short settle.

icons.name: multiple-choice
icons.label: Multiple choice
icons.intent: A second option is selected: its check appears while the first stays checked; Strong presses the box down, stamps the check in at contact, and the box releases with one rebound.

icons.name: signature
icons.label: Signature
icons.intent: The pen lowers, draws the signature stroke, and lifts; Strong taps down, drives the stroke fast, and flicks up before settling.

icons.name: form-builder
icons.label: Form builder
icons.intent: A new field is inserted below the existing text field and radio row; Strong shows the cursor, holds, then shoots the field out with one overshoot.

icons.name: qr-code
icons.label: QR code
icons.intent: Data modules drop into the code between the fixed finder squares; Strong drops them from higher and each lands with one rebound.

icons.name: barcode
icons.label: Barcode
icons.intent: A scanner line passes down across the bars and fades; Strong lifts, drives to the bottom, and sweeps back up before it clears.

icons.name: required-field
icons.label: Required field
icons.intent: A form field is flagged as required. Light: the asterisk beside the field's label pops up to a larger size with a quick twist and snaps back, and a beat later the empty field below dips under the flag and springs back. Strong: the asterisk crouches, pops bigger with a wider twist, snaps back and pops once more, smaller; the field dips with each pop. The label and asterisk keep their places.

icons.name: field-error
icons.label: Field error
icons.intent: A form field rejects its value. Light: the exclamation mark beside the field strikes down onto its dot, and a beat later the field shakes its head: it jolts left, swings back right and settles, carrying the typed value with it. Strong: the stem lifts first and strikes harder, the dot is knocked down and rebounds, and the field shakes three times, each smaller. The exclamation stays beside the field.

icons.name: password-strength
icons.label: Password strength
icons.intent: A password gets stronger. Light: one more masked character pops into the password field, then the strength meter under it fills from weak to strong: the second bar sweeps on and stops dead, then the third. Strong: the character snaps in bigger, each bar strikes on in a quick hit with a short pause between, and the field gives one small lift when the meter is full.
