The meter never overshoots; the reverse empties it and removes the character.

icons.name: range-slider
icons.label: Range slider
icons.intent: A range slider is widened. Light: both handles are pressed, drag apart along the track with the selected band stretching between them, stop dead on their new values and are released; the outer bars of the histogram above light up as the range takes them in. Strong: the handles drag apart in two clicks, stopping dead at a midpoint and again at the new values, the newly included bars hop as they light up, and the handles spring on release. The values never overshoot; the reverse drags the handles back together.

icons.name: wheel-picker
icons.label: Wheel picker
icons.intent: A scroll wheel picker moves to the next value. Light: the wheel rolls up one row: the selected value leaves the selection band and dims, the value below rises into the band and brightens, the top value rolls away and a new value fades in at the bottom. Strong: the wheel is pulled down first, then flicked up, runs a little past the detent and springs back into it. The reverse rolls the wheel back down one row.

icons.name: autofill
icons.label: Autofill
icons.intent: Saved details autofill a form. Light: the lightning bolt beside two empty fields kicks up and strikes down, and both fields fill at once: the top value writes in fast and the bottom one follows a beat behind. Strong: the bolt winds up higher and strikes harder with a rebound, each value snaps in and its field pops as it lands. The values stay filled; the reverse clears them bottom first.

icons.name: text-area
icons.label: Text area
icons.intent: A multi-line text area is resized taller. Light: the resize grip in the bottom corner is pulled down, the box's bottom edge follows it, and the line of text that was cut off writes in as the room opens. Strong: the grip is pressed, yanked down past the new size and springs back to it, and the hidden line snaps in. The top edge and the first two lines never move; the reverse pushes the grip back up and the third line is hidden again.

icons.name: captcha
icons.label: Captcha
icons.intent: A captcha check verifies that the person is human. Light: the empty checkbox on the captcha card gives way to a spinner that sweeps one turn while it verifies, then a check mark draws on in its place. Strong: the box is pressed in first, the spinner sweeps one and a half turns, and the check snaps on and pops. The verified check stays; the reverse erases it and the empty box returns. The refresh mark on the card never moves.

icons.name: character-count
icons.label: Character count
icons.intent: A text field counts characters toward its limit. Light: more text is typed into the field and the counter ring beside it fills in step with it, from a third of the way round to most of the way, and stops dead. Strong: the text is typed in two quick bursts, the ring clicks forward with each, and it pops once as it nears the limit. The count never overshoots; the reverse deletes the text and the ring empties back.

icons.name: sort-order
icons.label: Sort order
icons.intent: Direction arrow winds up and flips 180° beside the bars while the outer bars trade lengths; ascending and descending are retained states.

icons.name: show-columns
icons.label: Show columns
icons.intent: Existing content shifts over to make room, then the third column boundary and its content wipe down in one stroke; hiding retracts the wipe and the content spreads back.

icons.name: resize-column
icons.label: Resize column
icons.intent: The column boundary is dragged to a new width. Light: the resize handle (the double arrow under the boundary) pulls right, the boundary follows a beat later and stops dead at the wider column, then both ease home. Strong: a grab-tug left, a long drag right that stops dead, a smaller correction back past rest to the left that also clicks, then home. The frame never resizes.

icons.name: group-rows
icons.label: Group rows
icons.intent: Child rows push right under the header, then a section spine draws down to collect them; ungroup retracts the spine before the rows slide back.

icons.name: freeze-column
icons.label: Freeze column
icons.intent: The sheet scrolls under a frozen column. Light: the scrolling column is flicked left toward the frozen boundary, trailing two speed lines, slows against it like a rubber band and snaps back quickly, overshooting a little before it settles. Strong: the column is pulled right first, then flicked further left with the speed lines, snaps back past rest and settles with one more small swing. The frozen column and the divider never move.

icons.name: pivot-table
icons.label: Pivot table
icons.intent: The body value bar winds back and turns a quarter turn from row orientation to column orientation inside the headed table.

icons.name: formula
icons.label: Formula
icons.intent: The caret advances from f to the end of the line, then the x is typed into the cleared space behind it. Light: quiet glide, then two unhurried strokes. Strong: brief hold, fast launch with one bounded settle, then two fast strokes.

icons.name: sum
icons.label: Sum
icons.intent: The sum is worked out and the total is ruled off. Light: the sigma dims, a pen stroke writes it in one go (top bar, down to the apex, down to the foot) and stops dead at the end of the total bar; then a rule draws under the total and fades. Strong: the pen pauses at the apex before the second half, lands harder and knocks the sigma a step right, which settles, and the rule draws as it lands. The sigma keeps its shape.

icons.name: percentage
icons.label: Percentage
icons.intent: The percent is struck. Light: the slash pulls up into its top end and strikes down between the two counters, stopping dead at the bottom; the top counter pops as the stroke passes it and the bottom one pops on the hit. Strong: the slash pulls up and hangs, then strikes harder; each counter is knocked away from the stroke as it pops bigger, rebounds and settles, top first. The counters stay round and open.

icons.name: line-chart
icons.label: Line chart
icons.intent: The trend is plotted. Light: a pen draws the series from the origin left to right through its values, lifting the flat placeholder line off the baseline as it goes, and stops dead on the latest value, which flashes a data point. Strong: a quicker plot that marks every value in turn as the pen reaches it, the latest last. Values never overshoot; the axes never move; the plotted trend stays.

icons.name: pie-chart
icons.label: Pie chart
icons.intent: A share is singled out and slotted home. Light: the quarter wedge pops out along its bisector, hangs, and drops back into its slot with a hit and a small bounce; the pie takes the impact and gives a little. Strong: the wedge presses in first, pops far out, hangs, and slams home with two decaying bounces while the pie recoils harder and settles. Both pieces stay rigid.

icons.name: scatter-plot
icons.label: Scatter plot
icons.intent: Points plot onto fixed x/y axes, each dropping into its own column. Light lowers each point 1.5 units while it fades in. Strong drops each point 5 units with a 0.15 unit pull-up and a decisive landing exactly on its value, 0.1 s stagger, no overshoot. Reset retracts the same columns.

icons.name: heatmap
icons.label: Heatmap
icons.intent: A 3x3 value matrix: hot cells filled at three sizes, cool cells outlined. Light breathes only the hottest centre cell by 0.5 units. Strong runs a diagonal heat wave: each hot cell dips 0.6 then swells 0.6 and settles, 0.09 s apart.

icons.name: funnel-chart
icons.label: Funnel chart
icons.intent: Three centred stage bars narrow downward. Light: a soft downward pulse travels top to bottom. Strong: the top stage lifts, drives down 1.5 units in 0.1 s, rebounds 0.15 and settles; lower stages follow 30 ms later and smaller.

icons.name: radar-chart
icons.label: Radar chart
icons.intent: The scores are plotted. Light: the value triangle is pushed out along its three axes and stops dead on its values, and the three data points flash in turn around the chart (top, right, left). Strong: two readings: the triangle steps out halfway and stops, then out to its full values, and the data points flash bigger. Values never overshoot; the axes never move; the plotted triangle stays.

icons.name: dashboard
icons.label: Dashboard
icons.intent: A wide header widget stays; two data widgets arrive below it. Light: each rises 1.2 units while fading in. Strong: each starts 3.2 units below, dips 0.2 further, rises past by 0.4, and settles; the second widget follows 80 ms later.

icons.name: merge-cells
icons.label: Merge cells
icons.intent: Two table cells are merged into one. Light: the boundary between the two lower cells draws down, the merge arrows on either side push in toward it and squeeze it out, then ease back into the merged cell. Strong: the arrows pull back first, slam in harder so the boundary pops away, rebound and close in a second time before they settle. The table frame and the top row never move.

icons.name: insert-row
icons.label: Insert row
icons.intent: A new row is inserted into the table. Light: the plus pushes toward the rows, the rows part to open a slot above the middle row (the rows below drop, the top row lifts half as far) and an insertion line draws across the slot from the plus side; the line fades and the rows snap shut with a hit and a small rebound while the plus draws back. Strong: the plus pulls back first, then shoves harder; the rows part wider, and they slam shut with a bigger rebound and a settle.

icons.name: forecast
icons.label: Forecast
icons.intent: The trend is projected forward. Light: the dashed projection dims, then a pen redraws it from the latest value out into the future, dash by dash, and stops dead on the predicted value, which flashes a point. Strong: a new data point lands on the latest value first, then the projection is redrawn faster and the predicted point pops bigger with a rebound. The axes and the history line never move; values never overshoot.

icons.name: candlestick-chart
icons.label: Candlestick chart
icons.intent: The latest price candle trades. Light: the right candle falls back to its open, then rallies: its body and high wick grow up from the open and stop dead on the close. Strong: the left candle trades first, then the right one falls back and rallies in two moves, a pause halfway and a second push that stops dead on the close. The axes and the low wicks never move; prices never overshoot.

icons.name: bold
icons.label: Bold
icons.intent: The text is made bold: the B is stamped down and its weight goes on. Light: the B lifts, stamps onto its baseline with a hit, and at the impact a double strike spreads its strokes heavy (two hidden copies of the B push out 0.7 to each side), holds a beat and draws back in as it settles. Strong: a higher lift, a harder stamp with a rebound and a second smaller stamp; the strike spreads 1.0 each way and pushes again on the second stamp before it draws back in.

icons.name: italic
icons.label: Italic
icons.intent: Toggle slanted text emphasis: the I leans from upright to italic; reverse stands it back up.

icons.name: underline
icons.label: Underline
icons.intent: Add or remove an underline: a rule is drawn beneath the U; reverse retracts it.

icons.name: strikethrough
icons.label: Strikethrough
icons.intent: Mark text as struck out: a line slashes through the S; reverse withdraws it.

icons.name: heading
icons.label: Heading
icons.intent: The block becomes a level-1 heading: the H grows to heading size and the level is written beside it. Light: the H swells up from its baseline to 1.16x, stops dead, dips back a touch under and settles, and a beat later the 1 writes itself in, flag first, then down its stem to the baseline. Strong: the H gathers first (a small dip), swells to 1.2x with a rebound and a second smaller swell; the 1 writes itself in and pops as its stem lands.

icons.name: paragraph
icons.label: Paragraph
icons.intent: A paragraph break is set, like a carriage return: the pilcrow's two stems run down from the foot of the bowl to the baseline in turn, and the mark takes their landing. Light: both stems are pulled up to the foot of the bowl (the bowl's counter stays closed), then drop one after the other and stop dead on the baseline; the mark squashes onto the baseline as the second lands and springs back. Strong: the stems visibly roll up to the bowl first, then drop harder in turn; the mark squashes deeper, rebounds and settles.

icons.name: text-alignment
icons.label: Text alignment
icons.intent: Short lines slide from the left edge to the right edge; Strong pulls back first and lands with a checked overshoot.

icons.name: bulleted-list
icons.label: Bulleted list
icons.intent: Bullets enter from the left in order and hold; Strong pops each dot with a single overshoot.

icons.name: numbered-list
icons.label: Numbered list
icons.intent: Numerals 1 then 2 drop into their rows and hold; Strong lands each with a brief rebound.

icons.name: indent-outdent
icons.label: Indent / outdent
icons.intent: The guide arrow turns back and steps aside, then the indented lines slide out to the margin; reverse restores the indent.

icons.name: horizontal-rule
icons.label: Horizontal rule
icons.intent: A divider is drawn between two content blocks. Light: the rule draws quietly. Strong: the blocks press toward the gap, the rule sweeps across in one stroke, and the blocks spring back to rest.

icons.name: text-color
icons.label: Text color
icons.intent: The chosen colour is applied to the text. Light: the swatch is pressed and springs back; the old colour washes out of the A (it dims to 0.3), and the new colour paints it back from the foot nearest the swatch: up the left leg, over the apex, down the right leg, then across the crossbar. Strong: a deeper press with a rebound, the same repaint, and the A takes the colour with a hop that lands with a hit and a small rebound. The dimmed A keeps its counter closed throughout.

icons.name: text-highlight
icons.label: Text highlight
icons.intent: A highlighter draws a band under the passage that stays. Light: one smooth pass with the tip riding the ink. Strong: the marker draws back, strikes across in one decisive stroke, and flicks up before resting on the band end.

icons.name: clear-formatting
icons.label: Clear formatting
icons.intent: Styling is removed while the text stays. The underline beneath the T retracts and does not return. Light: quiet retraction. Strong: the clear badge presses, the underline snaps away, the badge rebounds once.

icons.name: spell-check
icons.label: Spell check
icons.intent: The misspelling underline is inspected and the correction accepted: the squiggle flattens into a plain underline and a check draws beside it. Light: quiet flatten then check. Strong: the squiggle tenses higher, snaps flat, and the check is struck in one stroke.

icons.name: find-and-replace
icons.label: Find and replace
icons.intent: The matched fragment kicks down out of the row and fades; the replacement drops into the same channel and lands as a longer bar. Reset retracts geometrically.

icons.name: page-break
icons.label: Page break
icons.intent: The following line is pushed down to the next page position; the dashed break then draws outward across the gap. Result holds.

icons.name: word-wrap
icons.label: Word wrap
icons.intent: The text wraps at the margin. Light: the return route draws itself from the margin, down and round the bend toward the next line at full speed, and the head is carried in at its end, stops dead just past its place and springs back. Strong: the top line first runs into the margin and springs back as the overflow wraps; the route draws faster, and the head lands harder with two decaying recoils. The two short lines never move.

icons.name: letter-case
icons.label: Letter case
icons.intent: Lowercase a morphs into uppercase A: the bowl rises into the triangular counter, the stem leans into the right leg and the left leg unfolds. Reverse returns the lowercase form.

icons.name: line-spacing
icons.label: Line spacing
icons.intent: The line spacing opens up, driven by the double arrow. Light: the arrow stretches, its heads pushing out 2.2 and stopping dead, and 60 ms later the outer rows are pushed apart from the middle row the same distance; the spread rebounds a touch, then everything closes back quicker with a small settle. Strong: the arrow and rows squeeze in first, then the arrow throws its heads out 3.2 and the rows follow to a hit, rebound twice and close back with a settle. The middle row never moves.

icons.name: accessibility
icons.label: Accessibility
icons.intent: Everyone is welcome. Light: the figure dips, springs up 1.5 inside the ring and throws both arms up into an open V, lands with a hit and the arms drop back with a small rebound; the head trails the body by a beat. Strong: a deeper dip, a higher jump with the arms flung wider, a harder landing with two decaying bounces while the arms settle. The ring never moves.

icons.name: wheelchair-access
icons.label: Wheelchair access
icons.intent: The chair pushes off and goes. Light: the rider leans into a push, two speed lines stream out behind, and the chair pops a small wheelie back on its big wheel, then drops its front down with a hit and a small bounce; the head trails the chair by a beat. Strong: a harder push and a higher wheelie, a heavier landing with two decaying bounces. The chair stays rigid and ends exactly at rest; the speed lines are gone again.

icons.name: hearing-assistance
icons.label: Hearing assistance
icons.intent: Sound is carried into the ear. Light: the waves roll forward one step: the large arc travels on into the ear and fades as it arrives, the small arc swells into the large arc's place and a new small arc grows in from the source; the ear takes the arriving wave with a small hit and settles. Strong: two waves roll in, one after the other, and the ear takes two decaying hits. The waves end exactly where they started.

icons.name: high-contrast
icons.label: High contrast
icons.intent: The contrast dial flips. Light: the dark half winds back a touch, then sweeps one full clockwise turn through the inverted split and locks home with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: a deeper wind-up, the half snaps over to the inverted side and holds there a beat (light and dark swapped), then completes the turn, overshoots and settles. The ring never moves; the turn ends on the starting angle.

icons.name: reduced-motion
icons.label: Reduced motion
icons.intent: The ball brakes and its motion trails die down. Light: the ball lurches forward as it brakes and rocks back into place, while the three trails behind it retract to short stubs one after another, top to bottom, each snapping a little short and settling. Strong: the ball pumps the brakes twice, and the trails shrink in two steps, half way, then down to the stubs. The stubs hold; the reverse lets the trails stream out again.

icons.name: text-size
icons.label: Text size
icons.intent: One rounded letter A grows from reading size to large size on a fixed baseline and holds; reverse shrinks it.

icons.name: keyboard
icons.label: Keyboard
icons.intent: Typing makes text. Light: the three top keys tap down in turn, left to right, and with each tap a line of text above the keyboard writes on one more step; the line fades once the word is typed. Strong: deeper, quicker taps, then the space bar thumps down with a bounce, and the typed line lifts away as it fades. The keyboard body never moves.

icons.name: keyboard-shortcuts
icons.label: Keyboard shortcuts
icons.intent: A key combination fires a command. Light: the modifier keycap goes down and holds, the letter keycap strikes down after it, and three short sparks burst from the letter key as the shortcut fires; the letter key lets go first, then the modifier, each popping back up with a small rebound. Strong: both keys strike deeper with a bounce, the burst is bigger, and the release rebounds and settles.

icons.name: focus-indicator
icons.label: Focus indicator
icons.intent: A visible keyboard focus indicator, a pair of open brackets, moves from the first control to the next and holds there; reverse moves it back.

icons.name: reading-mode
icons.label: Reading mode
icons.intent: A page simplifies into a reading view: the body lines settle into a centered reading column and hold; reverse restores full width.

icons.name: braille
icons.label: Braille
icons.intent: A braille display refreshes two cells of raised dots. Light: a reading wave runs left to right, column by column: each raised dot pushes up (swells) and drops back into place with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: each dot pushes up higher, drops back, then pops a second, smaller time before it settles. Every dot ends exactly where it started.

icons.name: audio-description
icons.label: Audio description
icons.intent: Audio description turns on: a narration waveform opens beneath the AD letters on the caption plate. Light: the wave draws in from left to right as its swing grows, overshoots a touch and settles on. Strong: the wave writes faster, swings wider and rings twice before it settles. The plate and letters never move; the reverse flattens the wave and draws it away.

icons.name: eye-tracking
icons.label: Eye tracking
icons.intent: The tracker follows the eye's gaze. Light: the pupil darts right and stops dead; a beat later the corner brackets slide after it and lock on with a small squeeze, then gaze and brackets return to centre. Strong: the pupil darts right, then across to the left, and the brackets chase and lock on each time before everything returns to centre with a small settle. The eye never moves; only the gaze does.

icons.name: letter-spacing
icons.label: Letter spacing
icons.intent: The letter spacing opens up, driven by the double arrow. Light: the arrow stretches, its heads pushing out 2.2 and stopping dead, and 60 ms later the letters A and V are pushed apart the same distance; the spread rebounds a touch, then everything closes back quicker with a small settle. Strong: the arrow and letters squeeze in first, then the arrow throws its heads out 3.2 and the letters follow to a hit, rebound twice and close back with a settle.

icons.name: audiobook
icons.label: Audiobook
icons.intent: The open book reads itself aloud. Light: the book lifts a touch and drops back with a hit as it sends one wave up: the large sound arc travels on upward and fades, the small arc swells into its place and a new small arc grows in from the spine. Strong: the book pushes out two waves, one after the other, with two decaying bumps. The arcs end exactly where they started.

icons.name: dwell-click
icons.label: Dwell click
icons.intent: The pointer clicks by itself after resting still. Light: the ring around the pointer's tip dims and a timer arc sweeps once around it from the top; as it closes the pointer presses in with a hit and the ring pops out and snaps back, the click; then the timer fades and the ring returns. Strong: the timer sweeps faster and the pointer double-clicks: two presses, each popping the ring, the second smaller. The pointer ends exactly at rest.

icons.name: pointer-size
icons.label: Pointer size
icons.intent: The pointer grows from its default size to a large size and holds, anchored at its tip. Light: it gathers in a touch, swells out toward the size corner, overshoots a little and settles large; the corner flinches out as the pointer arrives and springs back. Strong: a deeper gather, a bigger overshoot with two settling swings, and a harder flinch of the corner. The reverse shrinks it back to the default size.

icons.name: low-vision
icons.label: Low vision
icons.intent: A person who is blind or has low vision walks with a white cane and taps the way ahead. Light: the cane swings its tip up and forward, then taps down on the ground with a hit and a small rebound, and two tap marks flash out from the tip; the head nods a beat later. Strong: tap-tap: two sweeps and two taps, each with its marks, while the walker leans into the step and settles back. The walker and cane end exactly at rest; the marks are gone again.

icons.name: color-filters
icons.label: Color filters
icons.intent: Three overlapping color filters separate and blend again, the colour-vision filter setting. Light: the top filter pulls away from the centre, the lower two follow a beat apart, then all three slide back together and land overlapped with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: they squeeze in first, then spread further, hold apart for a beat and snap back together with a harder hit and two settling swings. They end exactly where they started.

icons.name: glasses
icons.label: Glasses
icons.intent: Reading glasses settle on and the lenses catch the light, for vision and reading settings. Light: the glasses hop up and land with a hit and a small rebound, and a glint sweeps across the left lens, then the right. Strong: a higher hop, a landing that rocks the frame side to side before it settles, and a brighter glint in each lens. The glints are gone again and the frame ends exactly at rest.

icons.name: repository
icons.label: Repository
icons.intent: The repository is opened and leafed through. Light: a page edge flips across from the fore-edge toward the spine, accelerating, and fades into the spine; the bookmark ribbon is swept aside as it passes, swings back past its rest and settles. Strong: three pages riffle across in quick succession, the ribbon is swept further and held aside until the last page passes, then falls back and settles in two swings. The book itself never moves.

icons.name: git-branch
icons.label: Git branch
icons.intent: A new lane draws out of the trunk and its tip ring draws closed at the arrival point; Strong drives the same stroke decisively.

icons.name: git-commit
icons.label: Git commit
icons.intent: A commit lands on the history line. Light: the point drops in from above, falls through the top of the empty ring and lands in its centre with a hit; the line takes the weight, dips, springs back and settles, and the point stays. Strong: the point hangs higher and rises a little before it drops, lands harder, a ripple runs out from the ring on impact, and the line settles in two beats. The preview reset fades the point back out.

icons.name: git-merge
icons.label: Git merge
icons.intent: The incoming lane draws from its source ring into the junction where history continues to the target; Strong joins with a faster decisive draw.

icons.name: pull-request
icons.label: Pull request
icons.intent: A pull request is opened from the branch. Light: the request route pulls back into the branch commit, which swells as it gathers it, then the route draws out again down and across toward the trunk; the arrowhead rides in on its tip, lands with a hit, thrusts toward the trunk without joining it, recoils and settles. Strong: the branch gathers longer, the route shoots out faster, the arrowhead thrusts further, the trunk flinches from the knock, and both settle in two beats. The commits never shrink.

icons.name: repository-fork
icons.label: Repository fork
icons.intent: The repository is forked into copies. Light: the source swells and sends its contents down the trunk as a bead; the bead splits at the junction, a bead runs down each lane, and each copy pops as its bead docks against it and bounces once back onto its size, left first. Strong: the source swells harder, the beads run faster, and each copy pops bigger and bounces twice onto its size, the right a beat after the left. The trunk and lanes never move.

icons.name: merge-conflict
icons.label: Merge conflict
icons.intent: The merge conflict is resolved. Light: the blocking slash at the junction retracts, a check draws on in its place, and the junction pops as the check lands, then settles. Strong: the branches and junction first shake against each other (the conflict), then the slash retracts, the check snaps on with a hit and the junction pops bigger and settles in two beats. The check holds until the preview reset.

icons.name: git-stash
icons.label: Git stash
icons.intent: Local change card drops into the stash tray and stays there. Strong lifts first, drops fast, lands with one bounce.

icons.name: debug
icons.label: Debug
icons.intent: The bug is caught. Light: it scurries, legs paddling in a diagonal gait while its body wiggles, then it is pinned: the body drops with a hit and all four legs splay flat, then it relaxes back to its pose. Strong: it scurries forward through two full gait cycles, is slammed down harder, its splayed legs twitch once while pinned, and it relaxes in two beats. The body stays rigid; only the legs pivot at the body.

icons.name: breakpoint
icons.label: Breakpoint
icons.intent: A stop marker pops into the gutter beside the active line and holds; clearing shrinks it away.

icons.name: debug-step
icons.label: Debug step
icons.intent: The execution pointer steps over the current line to the next one and holds there. Strong winds up and leaps in an outward arc, landing with a short settle.

icons.name: regular-expression
icons.label: Regular expression
icons.intent: The pattern matches and repeats: the dot (any character) hops, and as it lands the star (repeat) clicks round one step like a ratchet counting the match. Light: one hop, one 60-degree click with a small overshoot. Strong: the star winds back as the dot rises, then two hops in decaying height, each landing clicking the star round another step, settling on the second. The star always ends on its drawn angle.

icons.name: webhook
icons.label: Webhook
icons.intent: An event payload leaves the source node, runs the hooked callback route and is caught at the hook tip. Strong cocks the hook back, fires the payload fast and the hook swings once on catch.

icons.name: cherry-pick
icons.label: Cherry-pick
icons.intent: A commit is cherry-picked from one branch onto another. Light: a copy of the source commit's point lifts out of its ring, arcs down across to the other branch and lands in the empty tip ring with a hit; that branch dips under the weight, springs back and settles, and the picked commit stays. Strong: the source ring swells as it gives up the copy, the copy flies higher and lands harder, the tip ring pops bigger and the branch settles in two beats. The preview reset fades the copy back out.

icons.name: git-rebase
icons.label: Git rebase
icons.intent: A branch is rebased onto the latest commit. Light: the newest commit at the top of the trunk pops, then the branch lifts off its old base and slides up the trunk, its fork running along the line, and lands higher with a hit and a small rebound; a faint copy of the old branch is left behind and fades. Strong: the top commit pops harder, the branch dips first to wind up, shoots up past its new base and settles onto it in damped swings while the old copy fades. The branch stays rebased until the preview reset.

icons.name: git-compare
icons.label: Git compare
icons.intent: Two branches are compared, each route reaching across to the other. Light: the top branch's route pulls back toward its commit, which swells as it gathers it, then draws out again down and across; its arrowhead rides in on the tip, lands with a hit, thrusts toward the other branch, recoils and settles; the bottom branch answers a beat later the opposite way, up and across. Strong: both commits gather longer, the routes shoot out faster and the arrowheads thrust further and settle in two beats. The commits never shrink.

icons.name: code-diff
icons.label: Code diff
icons.intent: A code diff is applied: a removed line is deleted and an added line is confirmed. Light: the line marked minus erases back into its minus like a backspace, the minus kicks as it empties, then the plus pops and settles; the deleted line stays gone. Strong: the minus line erases faster after a short hold, the minus kicks harder, a highlight flashes up behind the added line and fades, and the plus pops bigger and settles in two beats. The preview reset fades the deleted line back in.

icons.name: logs
icons.label: Logs
icons.intent: A new entry streams into the log. Light: the log lines scroll up one row, the oldest line fading out at the top, and the new entry's timestamp pops in at the bottom while its message types out after it. Strong: the lines scroll up with a hit and a small rebound, the new timestamp blinks twice like a live indicator and the message types out faster. The new entry stays until the preview reset.

icons.name: feature-flag
icons.label: Feature flag
icons.intent: A feature flag is switched on. Light: the knob in the flag's toggle-shaped banner draws back a little, snaps across to the far end and stops with a hit, and the banner dips on the pole from the knock and springs back. Strong: the knob draws back further and slams across, rebounding off the end, and the banner swings and settles in two beats. Turning it off snaps the knob back to the pole end, and the banner lifts and settles.

icons.name: build
icons.label: Build
icons.intent: A build runs: the hammer strikes. Light: the claw hammer swings back about its grip, then strikes forward and stops dead with a hit, sparks burst off its face and fade, and it rebounds a little and settles. Strong: the hammer winds back further and holds, strikes harder with a bigger burst of sparks, rebounds and strikes a second, smaller blow with a smaller burst, then settles.

icons.name: server
icons.label: Server
icons.intent: The server handles a request: its activity lights flash in turn. Light: the top unit's light flares and settles, and the bottom unit's light answers a beat later. Strong: both lights flash twice, top then bottom, the second flash bigger. The lights never go out (in Solid they are windows that must stay open), and the rack units never move.

icons.name: database
icons.label: Database
icons.intent: A record is written. Light: a data packet drops into the open top of the cylinder and fades as it lands; the seam band takes the weight, dips, rebounds and settles. Strong: two packets land in turn and the band takes two hits, the second deeper. The drum and lid never move.

icons.name: processor
icons.label: Processor
icons.intent: The processor runs a clock cycle. Light: the core gathers, then fires; a pulse ring spreads from the core to the package edge and fades, and as it arrives the pins on all four sides kick outward and settle. Strong: two clock beats, tick then a bigger tock, each with its own ring and pin kick. The package never moves.

icons.name: memory-chip
icons.label: Memory chip
icons.intent: The RAM module seats in its slot. Light: the module drives down until its contacts meet the slot and stops dead; the slot takes the hit, dips and settles while the module holds seated a beat, then it springs back up and settles. Strong: a short lift first, a harder drive that buries the contacts in the slot, a deeper slot dip with a rebound, then the release. The module stays rigid.

icons.name: hard-drive
icons.label: Hard drive
icons.intent: The platter spins one turn and stops. Light: one smooth revolution. Strong: short reverse wind, a fast full turn that overruns and settles back to the same index.

icons.name: ethernet
icons.label: Ethernet
icons.intent: The plug clicks home in its port. The drawing is the seated plug. Light: it eases back, drives up and stops dead on its seat; two click ticks flick out from the shoulders where it meets the port, and it rebounds once and settles. Strong: a deeper pull back, a harder drive, a bigger click, then a second smaller re-seat. The plug, contacts and cable move as one rigid piece.

icons.name: router
icons.label: Router
icons.intent: The router broadcasts. Light: the status light blinks, then a signal arc leaves the tip of each antenna, travels outward and fades. Strong: two blinks and two waves in turn, the second wave travelling further. The box and the antennas never move.

icons.name: load-balancer
icons.label: Load balancer
icons.intent: The hub dispatches a packet down the shared trunk and left branch into a server slot; Strong lifts it briefly, fires it faster, and the receiving server absorbs the hit with the packet seated.

icons.name: firewall
icons.label: Firewall
icons.intent: Traffic is blocked. Light: the arrow drives into the wall and stops dead; an impact burst flicks off the wall's face above and below it, and the arrow is knocked back, overshoots and settles. Strong: the arrow winds back first and strikes harder, the bigger burst flies further, and the wall shudders once and holds.

icons.name: usb-drive
icons.label: USB drive
icons.intent: The drive clicks home in its port. The drawing is the plugged-in drive, connector to the left. Light: it eases back out, drives in and stops dead on its seat; two click ticks flick off the body's front corners where it meets the port, and it rebounds once and settles. Strong: a longer pull out, a harder drive, a bigger click, then a second smaller re-seat. The drive moves as one rigid piece.

icons.name: network-switch
icons.label: Network switch
icons.intent: The network switch forwards a packet from one port to another. Light: a data packet drops onto the switch above the first port and fades as it lands, the port lights flash across the row in turn, and the packet rises out above the last port and fades. Strong: two transfers, one each way: a packet comes in over the first port and leaves over the last, then a second comes in over the middle port, flashes back across and leaves over the first, travelling further. The case never moves.

icons.name: cooling-fan
icons.label: Cooling fan
icons.intent: The cooling fan spins up. Light: the rotor sweeps through one full turn with a blur of blades trailing behind it, overruns a little and settles back. Strong: a short wind-back, then two fast turns with a heavier blur, a bigger overrun and a damped settle. The square frame never moves.

icons.name: sd-card
icons.label: SD card
icons.intent: Data is written to the SD card. Light: a data packet drops onto the top of the card and fades as it lands; the contacts take it, dip, rebound and settle. Strong: two packets land in turn and the contacts take two hits, the second deeper. The card never moves.

icons.name: satellite-dish
icons.label: Satellite dish
icons.intent: The satellite dish receives a signal. Light: a signal wave arrives from the sky, closes in on the receiver at the tip of the feed arm and fades, and the receiver flashes as it lands. Strong: the dish swings up to lock on first, two waves arrive in turn and the receiver flashes twice, the second time bigger, then the dish swings back and settles. The dish stays rigid.

icons.name: smartwatch
icons.label: Smartwatch
icons.intent: The smartwatch buzzes with a notification. Light: the rigid watch rattles side to side in a quick decaying buzz, and a ripple of vibration leaves each side and fades as it spreads. Strong: two bursts, buzz, pause, buzz, with a twist in the rattle and a ripple on each burst. The watch never bends.

icons.name: tablet
icons.label: Tablet
icons.intent: A tap wakes the tablet. Light: a fingertip taps the screen and a touch ripple spreads from it and fades, then a glint draws across the glass as the screen comes on and fades. Strong: a double tap, two ripples, the second wider, then a longer glint. The tablet never moves.

icons.name: projector
icons.label: Projector
icons.intent: The projector switches on and throws its light. Light: the lens gathers, then flares, and a burst of three light rays shoots out above it and fades. Strong: two flashes, a small one then a big one, each with its burst, the second thrown further. The case, vents and feet never move.

icons.name: drone
icons.label: Drone
icons.intent: The drone takes off and lands. Light: the rotors spin up into a blur, the drone lifts off, hovers a moment and drops back onto its legs with a small bounce as the rotors stop. Strong: a higher climb, a bank to one side and back while it hovers, then a firmer landing with a bounce. The frame stays rigid.

icons.name: remote-control
icons.label: Remote control
icons.intent: A button press on the remote control sends a signal. Light: the power button at the top presses in and springs back, and an infrared signal of two arcs leaves the top of the remote, travels outward and fades. Strong: the remote tips forward to aim, the button is pressed twice, each press sends a signal, the second further, and the remote tips back and settles. The remote stays rigid.

icons.name: circuit-board
icons.label: Circuit board
icons.intent: Current runs through the circuit board. Light: the current enters each trace at the board's edge and runs along it to its pad, one trace after another, and each pad flashes as the current reaches it. Strong: two pulses run through the traces in turn, the second faster, and the pads flash twice, the second time bigger. The board never moves.

icons.name: inbox
icons.label: Inbox
icons.intent: A message arrives. Light: the incoming card lifts a touch, drops into the tray and lands with a hit and one small bounce, and stays received; the tray takes the knock, dipping and springing back. Strong: a higher lift, a harder drop that bounces twice, and a deeper give in the tray. The card and tray stay rigid. The reset fades back to the card waiting above the tray.

icons.name: address-book
icons.label: Address book
icons.intent: The contact card slides up and fades inside the book window while the next contact rises in from below; Strong dips first, flicks the card away faster and lands the next contact with a small overshoot, all inside the window.

icons.name: voicemail
icons.label: Voicemail
icons.intent: The message plays back. Light: the take-up reel on the left starts the tape, the right reel follows a beat behind, and both run one full turn, stop dead just past their marks and tick back into place. Strong: the reels wind back first, then run two fast turns, stop harder and settle in two ticks. The tape and the rims never move; the index marks show the turn.

icons.name: transfer-call
icons.label: Transfer call
icons.intent: The call leaves the handset as a dot, follows the route, turns up the bend and lands on the recipient arrow tip before retiring; Strong tips the handset first, then sends the call in one fast decisive run.

icons.name: dial-pad
icons.label: Dial pad
icons.intent: One key presses in and a halo spreads from it; Strong presses harder and dials three keys down the middle column in sequence.

icons.name: emoji-picker
icons.label: Emoji picker
icons.intent: The face reacts: it winks and grins. Light: the head tips toward its right eye, the eye snaps shut and opens again, and the smile widens into a grin a beat later; the head comes back past rest and settles as the grin relaxes. Strong: the head cocks the other way first, then tips further, winks, and breaks into a broad grin that holds, then swings back with two small settling beats. In Solid the wink stays open (a closed slit would close the eye's opening); the grin and the tilt carry it.

icons.name: thumbs-up-down
icons.label: Thumbs up / down
icons.intent: Thumbs up turns 180 degrees into thumbs down and holds. Light: one smooth turn. Strong: a 14-degree wind-up, a fast turn that overshoots 12 degrees, then settles on the exact down pose. Reverse turns back to up.

icons.name: rss-feed
icons.label: RSS feed
icons.intent: The feed publishes. Light: the dot fires with a pop; the outer wave travels out and fades, the inner wave travels out to take its place, and a fresh inner wave is born at the dot and swells out to its spot, overshooting a touch and settling. Strong: the dot draws in and the waves pull back first, then a bigger pop sends the outer wave further and the fresh wave lands with two settling beats. The dot never leaves its spot.

icons.name: announcement
icons.label: Announcement
icons.intent: The announcement blasts out. Light: the megaphone kicks, its bell lifting as the horn recoils, and both sound waves travel out from the bell and fade; fresh waves swell back out of the mouth, inner first, as the horn settles. Strong: the horn leans in first, then blasts twice, two syllables: each kick sends both waves out, and the horn settles after the second. The horn stays rigid.

icons.name: repost
icons.label: Repost
icons.intent: The post is reshared: the two repost arrows fire round their loop. Light: both arrows pull back along their legs and fire forward, the left arrow up and the right arrow down a beat behind, each head landing on its mark with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: a deeper pull-back, a harder fire and two rebounds.

icons.name: follow-user
icons.label: Follow
icons.intent: You follow the person: the plus beside them becomes a check and they perk up. Light: the plus twists an eighth of a turn and shrinks away, a check draws in where it was and pops, and the person hops once and lands with a small bounce. Strong: the plus winds back before it twists away, the check snaps in and pops bigger with a settle, and the person hops higher, then once more, smaller. Reverse (unfollow): the check undraws, the plus spins back in with a small pop, and the person sinks a little and recovers.

icons.name: newspaper
icons.label: Newspaper
icons.intent: The latest news prints on the newspaper. Light: the old copy clears, the headline block stamps down onto the page with a hit that knocks the paper down a touch, and the two lines of text write themselves out under it, top then bottom. Strong: the paper lifts as the old copy clears, the headline stamps down harder and bounces, the paper takes the knock and rebounds, and the lines write in quicker.

icons.name: missed-call
icons.label: Missed call
icons.intent: A call rings unanswered and is marked missed. Light: the missed-call arrow clears, the handset rattles as two ring arcs flick out of its open corner and fade, then the arrow draws its dip and climbs back out, and its head pops on at the end. Strong: the phone rings twice, ring, pause, ring, then the arrow snaps in and its head pops bigger and settles.

icons.name: end-call
icons.label: End call
icons.intent: The call is ended: the receiver is hung up. Light: the receiver lifts and tips, then slams back down flat with a hit, two impact marks flash out from under its ends, and it gives one small bounce. Strong: the receiver dips before it lifts higher and tips further, slams down harder, bounces twice, and the impact marks flash on each landing.

icons.name: call-history
icons.label: Call history
icons.intent: The call log winds back to the last call. Light: the clock's minute hand winds back one full turn, stops dead on the hour with a hit and a small recoil, and the handset rings once in answer, rattling in two decaying beats. Strong: the clock pops as the hand winds back two fast turns, stops harder and recoils twice, and the handset rattles longer.

icons.name: add-call
icons.label: Add call
icons.intent: Another call is added to the line. Light: the plus beside the handset clears and grows back out of its centre, bar then post, and pops; the handset answers with a short rattle as the new call joins. Strong: the handset tips back first, the plus writes in quicker and pops bigger with a settle, and the handset rattles harder in three decaying beats.

icons.name: outbox
icons.label: Outbox
icons.intent: A message leaves the outbox. Light: the arrow launches up out of the tray and flies off the top, fading, while the tray kicks down from the push; a fresh arrow then grows up out of the tray, its head riding the end of the shaft, and stops dead on its mark with a small rebound. Strong: the arrow sinks into the tray first, launches harder, the tray kicks deeper and springs back twice, and the fresh arrow lands with two rebounds.

icons.name: report-spam
icons.label: Report spam
icons.intent: The email is reported as spam. Light: the exclamation mark in the envelope's open corner lifts and strikes down above its dot, which pops on the impact, and the strike buzzes the envelope in a quick, decaying side-to-side shake. Strong: the stem lifts higher and strikes twice, the dot pops on each strike, and the envelope buzzes harder and longer.

icons.name: reply-all
icons.label: Reply all
icons.intent: The reply goes to everyone. Light: the reply arrow pulls back to the right, then fires left and stops with a hit; a beat later the outer chevron is knocked on ahead of it, and both spring back into place. Strong: a deeper pull-back, a harder fire, and the outer chevron is knocked further and settles in two beats.

icons.name: encrypted-message
icons.label: Encrypted message
icons.intent: The message is sealed with a lock. Light: the padlock's shackle inside the speech bubble swings open about its right leg, then snaps shut with a hit and a small click back, and the bubble dips under the snap. Strong: the shackle swings open wider, slams shut and clicks twice, and the bubble takes two decaying dips. The lock body never moves on the bubble.

icons.name: date-range
icons.label: Date range
icons.intent: A range bar sweeps from the fixed start date to the end date and stays. Strong: the end dot backs off, the bar drives fast, knocks it 0.7 past the date, and both settle together.

icons.name: calendar-view
icons.label: Calendar view
icons.intent: Week columns contract into three squares, each already in its own row lane, then slide left and extend into month rows. Strong: a snappier contraction with a slight squash, then a fast extension with a bounded width overshoot. Reverse runs the same route backwards.

icons.name: reschedule
icons.label: Reschedule
icons.intent: The event moves to a new date. Light: the marked date pops as it is picked; a beat later the event chip hops out of its tray, arcs across the page and lands on the date with a hit and one small bounce, covering it; the empty tray stays behind. Strong: the date pops harder, the chip dips into its tray first, then hops higher and lands with two bounces. The calendar never moves. The reset fades the chip back into its tray.

icons.name: alarm-clock
icons.label: Alarm clock
icons.intent: Light: one restrained outward strike of both bells. Strong: a small inward wind-up, a hard outward strike, and the whole clock tips 5.5° on its foot with the hit, undershoots once on the other foot and settles while the bells ring down.

icons.name: stopwatch
icons.label: Stopwatch
icons.intent: The stopwatch is started and times a lap. Light: the plunger is pressed in with a click and springs back; on the click the sweep hand runs at a steady pace from 12 to 20 seconds, stops dead and ticks back into place; the time stays. Strong: the thumb lifts first and presses harder, the hand runs, and a second press stops it dead; the hand shudders twice and settles. The case never moves. The reset fades the hand back to 12.

icons.name: countdown-timer
icons.label: Countdown timer
icons.intent: The countdown is started. Light: the marker at 12 is pressed in with a click and springs back; on the click the remaining-time arc drains steadily from its tail toward 12, stops dead at the new time and catches; the time left stays. Strong: the marker lifts first and is pressed harder, and the arc counts down in three ticks, each a hit with a small catch, the last settling in two beats. The remaining time never drops below its new value. The reset fades the arc back to full.

icons.name: world-clock
icons.label: World clock
icons.intent: The clock switches to the other side of the world. Light: the globe turns half a turn, and a beat behind it the zone dial's minute hand swings half a turn to the new time, stops dead, ticks back and settles, the hour hand following it geared 12:1; the new time stays. Strong: the globe and the minute hand wind back first, the globe spins faster, and the hand lands harder with two ticks back. Neither hand passes the new time. The reset fades the hands back.

icons.name: availability
icons.label: Availability
icons.intent: The open slot is pulled out to be picked. Light: the free slot slides out to the right, hits its stop, recoils a little and settles, and stays open; the two busy slots never move. Strong: the slot is pushed in first, then pulled out hard to its stop and settles in two beats. The reverse pushes it home against its stop.

icons.name: booking-confirmed
icons.label: Booking confirmed
icons.intent: A check is written onto the calendar to confirm the booking. Light: the short stroke of the check draws down to the corner, the long stroke draws up a beat later, and the check pops once as the booking is set. Strong: both strokes snap on with hard stops at the corner and the tip, the check pops harder, and the calendar takes it with a thump, a rebound and a settle. The leaf stays rigid.

icons.name: event-cancelled
icons.label: Cancel event
icons.intent: An X is struck across the calendar to cancel the event. Light: the first stroke slashes down from the top left, the second crosses it a beat later from the top right, and the X pops once. Strong: both strokes slash on fast with hard stops, the X pops harder, and the calendar shakes side to side, no, in smaller swings until it settles. The leaf stays rigid.

icons.name: deadline
icons.label: Deadline
icons.intent: A deadline flag is planted on the calendar. Light: the pole shoots up from the date, then the pennant unfurls from the top of the pole, overshoots a little as it catches the wind and settles. Strong: the pole strikes up with a dead stop and the calendar takes the hit with a thump and a rebound; the pennant snaps out harder and flutters twice before it settles. The leaf stays rigid.

icons.name: recurring-event
icons.label: Recurring event
icons.intent: The event repeats: the loop arrow on the calendar runs one full lap. Light: the arrow runs once round clockwise, lands with a stop at its start and settles. Strong: the arrow winds back first, then drives the lap hard, stops dead with a tick back, and the calendar takes the landing with a thump, a rebound and a settle. The leaf stays rigid.

icons.name: calendar-sync
icons.label: Calendar sync
icons.intent: The calendar syncs: the two sync arrows on it chase each other round. Light: the arrows turn half a turn clockwise, each taking the other's place, stop with a hit and settle. Strong: the arrows wind back first, then drive a full turn fast, stop hard, and the calendar takes the stop with a thump, a rebound and a settle. The leaf stays rigid.

icons.name: gantt-chart
icons.label: Gantt chart
icons.intent: The project schedule is laid out on the Gantt chart: each task bar extends from its start date to its end date, in order. Light: the three bars grow out one after another, each starting while the one above is still running, and stop dead on their end dates. Strong: the bars run as a dependency chain: each one shoots out and stops with a hit, and the next starts only when the one above lands. The axis never moves.

icons.name: time-block
icons.label: Time block
icons.intent: A block of time is drawn on the day: the event block is pulled down from its start hour to its end hour. Light: the block starts as a thin slab at the start hour, and its bottom edge is dragged down in one move and stops dead on the end hour. Strong: the edge is dragged in two snaps, stopping dead on the middle hour first, then on the end hour, and the calendar takes the last snap with a small thump. The hour marks and the leaf stay put.

icons.name: timesheet
icons.label: Timesheet
icons.intent: Hours are logged on the timesheet. Light: the clock's minute hand runs one full hour, and as it lands the new entry is written on the sheet, its line drawing out from the left. Strong: the hand runs two hours: the first lap lands and writes one entry with a hard stop, the second lap writes the next, and the clock takes the last entry with a thump. The sheet stays rigid.

icons.name: overdue
icons.label: Overdue
icons.intent: The due time passes and the alert goes up: the item is overdue. Light: the clock's minute hand runs past twelve once round, and as it lands the exclamation mark strikes down beside the clock and its dot pops in. Strong: the hand winds back, runs round hard and stops dead; the mark slams down, the dot pops bigger, and the clock shudders side to side in smaller swings. The mark stays upright.

icons.name: schedule-send
icons.label: Schedule send
icons.intent: The message is sent at its scheduled time. Light: the clock's minute hand runs round to the send time, and as it lands the paper plane draws back and launches a short way along its nose, shrinking a little as it pulls away, while three speed lines streak out behind it; it springs back to rest with a small overshoot. Strong: the hand winds back and runs round hard, the clock jolts as the time hits, and the plane draws back deeper, shoots farther and smaller, and springs back in two beats.

icons.name: extend-time
icons.label: Extend time
icons.intent: More time is added to the clock. Light: the plus is written beside the clock, upright stroke first and crossbar a beat later, and pops as it lands; on the pop the clock's minute hand is pushed round one full extra hour. Strong: the plus strokes snap on with hard stops and it pops harder, the hand winds back, then drives the extra hour round hard, stops dead with a tick back, and the clock takes the stop with a thump and a rebound.

icons.name: clock-in
icons.label: Clock in
icons.intent: The time card is punched into the time clock to clock in, and pops back out to clock out. Light: the card is pushed down into the slot on top of the time clock and stops dead, and the clock dips with the punch and settles. Strong: the card lifts a little first, then is slammed into the slot; the clock thumps, rebounds and settles. The reverse clocks out: the clock gives a small kick and the card springs back up out of the slot, overshoots a little and settles.

icons.name: partly-cloudy
icons.label: Partly cloudy
icons.intent: The sun breaks through the cloud. Light: a wave of light sweeps clockwise from the lowest ray toward the cloud: each ray pulls back into the disc and shines out again in turn while the disc swells once; as the last rays reach the cloud it is pushed aside, away from the sun, and drifts back with one small rebound. Strong: the rays shoot out past their length and spring back in turn while the crown turns a little with the light, the disc swells harder, and the cloud is pushed further and settles in two beats.

icons.name: rain
icons.label: Rain
icons.intent: Light: three streaks fall 2.6 units in a short stagger and fade, then reappear under the cloud. Strong: the cloud lifts as it wrings, the streaks shoot 4.4 units in a tight burst, and the cloud settles back.

icons.name: snow
icons.label: Snow
icons.intent: Light: five flakes drift 2.2 units down with a small sway, fade and reappear under the cloud. Strong: they fall farther (3.2 units) with a wider, faster sway.

icons.name: hail
icons.label: Hail
icons.intent: Light: three pellets drop to the ground line, rebound one unit, fade and reappear under the cloud. Strong: a harder drop in 0.14 s and a 2.7-unit rebound.

icons.name: thunderstorm
icons.label: Thunderstorm
icons.intent: Light: the bolt flickers twice and dips half a unit. Strong: the bolt strikes down 1.1 units with a hard double flash while the cloud recoils upward, then both settle.

icons.name: snowflake
icons.label: Snowflake
icons.intent: Snow falls. Light: the flake drops and drifts a little as it turns a sixth, while snow dots fall past it in the corners, faster than it; the air catches it, lifts it back into its place and it settles, a sixth turned (the same drawing). Strong: a gust: the flake lifts first, then drops further and drifts further as it turns two sixths, more snow falls past it, and it is caught and settles in two beats. The flake stays rigid.

icons.name: wind
icons.label: Wind
icons.intent: Light: the three gust lines push 1.1 units right in a short stagger and return. Strong: each line draws back 0.6, is driven 3 units right with one damped return.

icons.name: fog
icons.label: Fog
icons.intent: Light: the three fog layers drift 0.8 units in alternating directions and return. Strong: each layer is pulled back, slides 2 units in its direction and eases home.

icons.name: tornado
icons.label: Tornado
icons.intent: Light: one sway travels down the funnel, the tip moving 1 unit. Strong: a wider wave with a second half-swing travels down; the tip swings 2.5 units before settling.

icons.name: hurricane
icons.label: Hurricane
icons.intent: Light: the storm makes a calm counterclockwise half turn to its next equivalent pose. Strong: it winds 14° the other way, whips through a full counterclockwise turn and settles.

icons.name: rainbow
icons.label: Rainbow
icons.intent: Light: three arcs draw over the horizon from the left base, outer first, in a calm stagger. Strong: they sweep over in a tight burst and the finished bands pop outward half a unit and settle. The rainbow is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: sunrise
icons.label: Sunrise
icons.intent: Light: the sun rises from below the horizon to a half disc and its rays grow in a stagger; the up chevron nudges up. Strong: the sun overshoots 1.1 units above the half position and settles, and the rays flare past full length and settle. Result retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: sunset
icons.label: Sunset
icons.intent: Light: the sun sinks from high in the sky to a half disc on the horizon while its long rays shorten; the down chevron nudges down. Strong: the sun lifts slightly first, drops 0.9 units past the half disc and settles. Result retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: moon-phase
icons.label: Moon phase
icons.intent: Light: the terminator sweeps from a waxing crescent through the half moon to a waxing gibbous. Strong: the moon tips back, the terminator sweeps in 0.28 s as the moon swings through 9° and settles. The phase is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: temperature
icons.label: Temperature
icons.intent: Heat arrives and the reading climbs. Light: the bulb swells as it takes the heat, then the mercury climbs from low to high in one decisive rise, and each scale mark flicks out in turn as the column passes it, the top one as the column arrives. Strong: the bulb pumps twice and the column climbs in two surges, stopping dead at the middle mark and then at the top, with bigger flicks. The column never overshoots; the glass never moves.

icons.name: humidity
icons.label: Humidity
icons.intent: Moisture gathers and the humidity rises. Light: a droplet forms under the tip of the drop, falls through it and lands in the water; on contact the level rises from low to just above the middle in one decisive fill while the surface sloshes and settles level. Strong: two droplets land in turn and the level climbs in two ticks, each landing sloshing the surface harder. The level never overshoots; the drop never moves.

icons.name: uv-index
icons.label: UV index
icons.intent: Light: the three meter dashes fill left to right while the sun's rays lengthen with the reading. Strong: the sun pulses first, the dashes fill in a quick sequence and the rays flare past their final length and settle. The reading is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: umbrella
icons.label: Umbrella
icons.intent: Rain lands on the umbrella and it shields. Light: a raindrop falls onto the left shoulder of the canopy, then one onto the right; each vanishes on contact and the rigid umbrella takes the hit, dipping and tipping toward that side, then rocks back and settles. Strong: a heavier shower: two drops land on each side in turn and the umbrella rocks under four decaying hits before it settles.

icons.name: windsock
icons.label: Windsock
icons.intent: A gust fills the windsock. Light: two wind lines streak in under the sock from the pole, one after the other; the gust snaps the drooping sock out nearly level, it flutters once in the wind and sags back to its droop with a small swing. Strong: two gusts in turn: the sock is blown out past level, flutters, is held up by the second gust, then drops and swings twice before it hangs still. The pole never moves.

icons.name: weather-radar
icons.label: Weather radar
icons.intent: Light: the sweep makes one clockwise turn and a storm cell appears as the arm passes it. Strong: the arm kicks back, sweeps faster with a small overrun, and the cell pops in with a ripple ring. The cell is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: heart-rate
icons.label: Heart rate
icons.intent: Light: the pulse trace draws across in 0.64 s and the heart gives one beat as the pen crosses the spike. Strong: the trace draws in 0.34 s and the heart double-beats (lub-dub) to 114%. The trace is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: step-counter
icons.label: Step counter
icons.intent: Steps land and are counted. Light: one stride: the back foot lifts toward the viewer with a toe-off twist and stamps down with a hit and a contact dip, its toes landing a beat after the sole; then the front foot does the same. Strong: two strides, four footfalls in turn, each lifted higher and stamped harder.

icons.name: dumbbell
icons.label: Dumbbell
icons.intent: Light: the dumbbell is curled up 1.6 units with a 4° tilt and lowered. Strong: it dips as the lifter braces, is driven up 4 units tilting 8°, counter-swings and is set down.

icons.name: running
icons.label: Running
icons.intent: Light: one easy stride. Legs and arms swing through and back while the body bobs 0.5. Strong: the runner leans 6° into two quick strides with a 1-unit bob.

icons.name: water-intake
icons.label: Water intake
icons.intent: Light: the water in the glass rises from a quarter to near the rim with a small slosh. Strong: a droplet falls in, and on impact the level rises in 0.32 s with a hard slosh that settles. The level is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: sleep-tracking
icons.label: Sleep tracking
icons.intent: Light: the two Z marks shrink and breathe back in sequence beside the moon. Strong: the moon rocks like a cradle while each Z pops out of nothing, overshoots to 116% and settles.

icons.name: calories
icons.label: Calories
icons.intent: Calories burn: the flame flares. Light: the flame ducks, then flares up tall and narrow from its base with the inner flame rising a beat behind, an ember flies off beside the tip and fades, and the flame settles. Strong: a deeper duck, a bigger flare with two embers flying off in turn, and two settling swells.

icons.name: stethoscope
icons.label: Stethoscope
icons.intent: The stethoscope picks up a heartbeat. Light: one lub-dub: a pair of beat arcs flashes out on either side of the chest piece, strong then weaker, and fades while the chest piece thumps with each beat. Strong: two lub-dubs, the second harder. The binaural and tubing never move.

icons.name: pill
icons.label: Pill
icons.intent: The capsule releases its dose. Light: the halves pull apart along the axis, a granule spills out of the gap on each side and fades, and the halves snap shut with a hit and a tiny click rebound. Strong: the capsule twists as it pulls further apart, two granules spill out of each side in turn, and it snaps shut, rebounds and untwists with a settle.

icons.name: syringe
icons.label: Syringe
icons.intent: Light: the plunger pushes 3 units in and the dose empties. Strong: it draws back slightly, is driven home in 0.16 s with a hit and a small rebound, and a drop leaves the needle. The dose is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: first-aid-kit
icons.label: First aid kit
icons.intent: The kit is grabbed and set down, ready to help. Light: it is snatched up by its handle with a swing, lands with a thud and one small bounce, and the cross pops a beat after the landing. Strong: a dip before a harder snatch, a wider swing, a landing with two decaying bounces, and the cross pops bigger and rings down. The case stays rigid.

icons.name: bandage
icons.label: Bandage
icons.intent: The bandage is pressed on. Light: the strip peels up toward the viewer with a small twist, slaps down flat with a hit and a little press below rest, and press marks flash out along both long sides. Strong: a higher peel with more twist, a harder slap with the press marks, then a second, smaller press as it is smoothed down.

icons.name: weight-scale
icons.label: Weight scale
icons.intent: Light: the needle sweeps from −55° to the reading at 20°. Strong: the scale body compresses 5% as weight lands, then the needle overshoots to 38° and rings down to 20°. The reading is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: blood-pressure
icons.label: Blood pressure
icons.intent: Light: one squeeze of the bulb and the gauge needle rises to the reading. Strong: two hard squeezes step the needle up, then it overshoots 8° and settles. The reading is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: yoga
icons.label: Yoga
icons.intent: Light: the rolled mat travels right, paying out the mat, and settles partly unrolled. Strong: it is drawn back, pushed, rolls out fast past its mark and rocks back once. The unrolled mat is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: meditation
icons.label: Meditation
icons.intent: A calm breath makes the lotus bloom. Light: on the in-breath the side petals open wide about the base and the centre petal rises a beat behind, a soft glow arches up over the tip and fades, and the petals close with a small, slower settle. Strong: the petals draw in first, bloom wider, two glows arch up in turn, and the petals settle through two gentle swings. The water line never moves.

icons.name: nutrition
icons.label: Nutrition
icons.intent: A fresh apple, picked and shining. Light: the apple dips and pops up, the leaf trails a beat behind and whips as it lands with a hit and a small bounce, and a sparkle glints off its shoulder. Strong: a deeper dip and a higher pop, two decaying bounces with the leaf fluttering, and two sparkles glint in turn. The apple stays rigid.

icons.name: jump-rope
icons.label: Jump rope
icons.intent: Light: the rope makes one turn, over the top and back under. Strong: it winds back, then whips through two fast turns while the handles jerk with each pass.

icons.name: hospital
icons.label: Hospital
icons.intent: The hospital admits you. Light: the sliding doors part all the way into the jambs, leaving the doorway open, the cross sign pops a beat later, and the doors slide shut with a hit and one small rebound. Strong: the doors jolt, then slide fully open while the cross pulses twice like a beacon, and they shut with a hit and two decaying rebounds. The building never moves.

icons.name: dna
icons.label: DNA
icons.intent: Light: the helix makes one full calm twist; rungs fade out wherever the strands close in. Strong: it winds back 24°, twists through two turns with a short overrun and settles.

icons.name: smart-bulb
icons.label: Smart bulb
icons.intent: Light: the bulb switches on and four rays grow out in a calm stagger. Strong: the glass swells as the power arrives, the rays burst out past full length and settle. The lit state is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: thermostat
icons.label: Thermostat
icons.intent: The heat is turned up and the heating engages. Light: the knob is turned clockwise round the dial in one sweep, the setpoint arc growing behind it to the higher temperature, and the hub glows once as the heating comes on. Strong: the setting is clicked up in three detents, each step smaller, then the hub glows hard as the heating engages, rebounds and settles. The setpoint never overshoots and is kept; the preview reset fades the new setting away and rearms.

icons.name: smart-lock
icons.label: Smart lock
icons.intent: Light: the lever handle is pressed 30° down and springs back, and the status light above the keypad comes on. Strong: it is yanked 45° down with a hard hit, rebounds and settles, and the status light pops on. The unlocked state is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: door-sensor
icons.label: Door sensor
icons.intent: Light: the magnet slides 4.5 units away from the sensor as the door opens, then two alert arcs appear. Strong: the magnet is yanked 5.5 units and settles while the arcs snap in quickly. The open state is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: garage-door
icons.label: Garage door
icons.intent: Light: the three door panels roll up one after another into the header, leaving the doorway open. Strong: the door dips, then rolls up in a third of a second and knocks against its stop. The open state is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: ceiling-fan
icons.label: Ceiling fan
icons.intent: Light: the blades turn half a revolution, foreshortening to edge-on and swinging back out. Strong: they wind back, spin a turn and a half, and the fan wobbles on its downrod as it spins.

icons.name: air-conditioner
icons.label: Air conditioner
icons.intent: Light: three airflow waves drift 2.2 units down from the vent in a stagger, fade and return. Strong: the vent kicks open and the waves blast 3.2 units down in a tight burst.

icons.name: smart-speaker
icons.label: Smart speaker
icons.intent: Light: the light ring on top flickers and the two sound arcs above swell 0.8 units and return. Strong: the speaker squats and springs as it speaks, the ring flashes twice and the arcs push out 1.4 units with a second pulse.

icons.name: video-doorbell
icons.label: Video doorbell
icons.intent: A visitor rings. Light: the ring button is pressed in, the chime sounds as a pair of arcs that flick out beside the button and fade as they spread, and the button springs back with a small overshoot. Strong: ding-dong: a deeper press, two chimes in turn, the second wider, and the camera wakes as the lens pupil opens wide, holds and closes again. The doorbell housing never moves.

icons.name: security-camera
icons.label: Security camera
icons.intent: The camera spots movement and records it. Light: the camera snaps down about its wall joint onto the scene, stops dead, and the lens flashes once as recording starts; then it swings back up with a small overshoot and settles. Strong: it scans up first, sweeps down hard onto the target with a recoil, the lens flashes twice while it holds the view, and it swings back and settles. The arm, joint and wall plate never move.

icons.name: window-blinds
icons.label: Window blinds
icons.intent: Light: the cord is pulled and the blind rises one slat, its top slat folding into the head rail as the tassel comes down. Strong: it is yanked up past its stop, drops back and settles. The raised state is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: robot-vacuum
icons.label: Robot vacuum
icons.intent: Light: the vacuum drives 2.6 units right, the dust specks ahead of it vanish, and it reverses home. Strong: it backs up, charges 3.6 units into the dust, rebounds off it and reverses. The clean floor is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: washing-machine
icons.label: Washing machine
icons.intent: Light: the laundry swirl turns half a revolution inside the door. Strong: it rocks back, spins a turn and a half and settles, and the machine shudders during the spin.

icons.name: refrigerator
icons.label: Refrigerator
icons.intent: Light: the lower door swings open past square to hang at the left, showing the shelves inside, then closes. Strong: it is flung open against its stop and bounces, holds, then is slammed shut with a small rebound.

icons.name: oven
icons.label: Oven
icons.intent: Light: the display lights and two heat waves rise inside the window in turn. Strong: the display snaps on, the waves shoot up and shimmer before they settle. The heated state is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: smoke-alarm
icons.label: Smoke alarm
icons.intent: Light: the LED blinks and the two alarm arcs swell 0.8 units and return. Strong: the puck buzzes on its mount, the LED flashes three times and the arcs push out 1.6 units with a second pulse.

icons.name: water-leak
icons.label: Water leak
icons.intent: Light: the hanging drop falls into the puddle, the puddle spreads 1.2 units and a new drop forms. Strong: the drop swells heavy, drops fast, the puddle splashes 2.6 wider and the next drop forms with a small overshoot.

icons.name: power-outlet
icons.label: Power outlet
icons.intent: Light: the button presses 0.6 units and the status light comes on. Strong: a hard 1.2-unit press with a small rebound, and the status light pops on past full size and settles. The on state is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: energy-usage
icons.label: Energy usage
icons.intent: Light: the four usage bars rise from the baseline in turn to their readings. Strong: the bolt flashes and jolts, then the bars shoot up in a quick sequence. The readings are retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: motion-sensor
icons.label: Motion sensor
icons.intent: Light: two detection beams open out from the dome in turn and a person appears in range. Strong: the beams flash open in a tight burst and the person rises in fast, overshoots upward and settles. The detection is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: graduation-cap
icons.label: Graduation cap
icons.intent: Graduation: the cap is tossed in celebration. Light: the cap flies up with a tilt, drops back and lands with a hit and one small bounce, and the tassel swings behind it and damps out. Strong: a dip to throw, a higher toss with more tumble, and a landing with two decaying bounces while the tassel swings wide and damps out.

icons.name: chalkboard
icons.label: Chalkboard
icons.intent: Light: chalk writes a wavy line across the board, then underlines it. Strong: the line is written in 0.22 s, the underline snaps in, and the chalk tap jolts the board. The writing is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: flashcards
icons.label: Flashcards
icons.intent: Light: the card turns edge-on and over, from the question mark to the answer. Strong: the card lifts off the deck, flips in a quarter second and lands with a small tap. The answer is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: quiz
icons.label: Quiz
icons.intent: Light: the first answer on the quiz card is selected as a dot grows inside its ring. Strong: the dot snaps in and the whole marker pops 12% and settles. The answer is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: certificate
icons.label: Certificate
icons.intent: Light: the seal grows onto the certificate and its ribbon tails unfurl. Strong: the seal slams down from twice its size, the paper jolts, and the tails snap out. The seal is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: notebook
icons.label: Notebook
icons.intent: Light: three lines of notes are written one after another. Strong: the notebook is picked up and set down, the lines are dashed off in 0.09 s each, and it taps down when done. The notes are retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: pencil
icons.label: Pencil
icons.intent: Light: the pencil writes a wave line, its tip riding the ink as it grows. Strong: the pencil lifts and drops onto the page, writes in 0.3 s and flicks up at the end. The line is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: ruler
icons.label: Ruler
icons.intent: Light: a measuring pulse runs along the ticks, each lengthening 0.6 units in turn. Strong: the pulse runs faster and deeper (1.5 units) while the ruler rocks 2.5° and settles.

icons.name: lab-flask
icons.label: Lab flask
icons.intent: Light: three bubbles rise from the liquid up the neck and fade while the surface ripples. Strong: the flask is swirled 5° either way, the surface sloshes and the bubbles race up in 0.34 s.

icons.name: microscope
icons.label: Microscope
