icons.intent: Bringing the specimen into focus. Light: the focus knob is turned (a turning stroke sweeps clockwise round it and fades), and a beat later the tube racks down its own axis toward the slide and stops dead in focus, holds, then racks back up. Strong: coarse then fine focus: two turns of the knob, the second shorter, and the tube racks down in two steps, each smaller, with a hard stop and a small shudder before it returns. The arm, stage and base never move.

icons.name: abacus
icons.label: Abacus
icons.intent: Light: four beads slide across their rods one after another to record a count. Strong: each bead is flicked across in 0.1 s and knocks to a stop with a small recoil. The count is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: school-bell
icons.label: School bell
icons.intent: The school bell rings. Light: the hand bell is swung from its handle, the clapper trails it and strikes, a ring arc flicks out at each upper side and fades as it spreads, and the swing decays back to rest in smaller beats. Strong: a back-swing to wind up, then a hard shake that rings twice, once at each end of the swing, while the clapper chases the bell through a longer decay (family match with the set 01 bell).

icons.name: course-progress
icons.label: Course progress
icons.intent: Light: the progress scrubber advances steadily to three quarters of the course. Strong: the play button is pressed in and springs out, then the scrubber drives to the same point in 0.24 s. Progress is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: lecture
icons.label: Lecture
icons.intent: Light: the presenter raises the pointer to the screen as two bullet lines appear in turn. Strong: two sharp taps of the pointer, each snapping a bullet line onto the screen. The slide is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: library-shelf
icons.label: Library shelf
icons.intent: A book is taken down and shelved again. Light: the middle book is drawn up out of the row, held, and dropped home with a knock; the knock rattles the row: the leaning book rocks back on its corner and the left book tips, each settling a beat later. Strong: the book sticks first (a short tug), is pulled out higher, then shelved hard with a rebound, and the knock rocks both neighbours wider before they settle. The shelf never moves.

icons.name: language-learning
icons.label: Language learning
icons.intent: Light: a speech bubble with the letter A grows up out of the open book. Strong: the pages flap as the bubble pops out wide (120%), tilts and settles. The bubble is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: alphabet-blocks
icons.label: Alphabet blocks
icons.intent: Light: the A block is lowered onto the two blocks below and settles. Strong: it falls from higher while turning 10°, lands hard with a double bounce, and the blocks below take the thud. The stack is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: homework
icons.label: Homework
icons.intent: Light: a tick is drawn across the finished worksheet. Strong: the sheet is slapped down, the tick is struck in 0.14 s and the sheet hops once in approval. The tick is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: exam-grade
icons.label: Exam grade
icons.intent: Light: a hand-drawn ring circles the A+ grade. Strong: the ring is struck round in 0.26 s and the grade pops 6% when circled. The ring is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: geometry-compass
icons.label: Geometry compass
icons.intent: Light: the compass swivels 6° on its needle and back while an arc is drawn on the paper beneath it. Strong: it cocks 9°, holds, then snaps upright as the arc is struck in 0.16 s, with a small recoil. The arc is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: coffee-cup
icons.label: Coffee cup
icons.intent: Light: two steam wisps drift up 1.6 units, fade and reform above the mug. Strong: the wisps shoot up 2.4 units in 0.3 s and lean as they rise before reforming.

icons.name: tea-cup
icons.label: Tea cup
icons.intent: Light: the spoon stirs one loop, its foot sliding along the rim. Strong: it stirs two quick loops after a short backstroke and the cup jiggles on its saucer.

icons.name: wine-glass
icons.label: Wine glass
icons.intent: Light: a stream pours in and the wine level rises to the bowl's widest part with a small slosh. Strong: it fills in 0.28 s, the glass dips half a unit on the pour and the surface sloshes harder before settling. The filled glass is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: beer-mug
icons.label: Beer mug
icons.intent: Cheers: the mug is raised and clinks. Light: the mug lifts and tips toward the right, stops dead at the clink as three sparks flash out from its rim, recoils a little and comes back down; the foam head sloshes on over the rim a beat behind the stop and settles. Strong: the mug draws back first, swings in harder to the clink, recoils and clinks a second, smaller time with a second flash, then comes down; the foam sloshes harder with a second swing. The glass stays rigid.

icons.name: cocktail
icons.label: Cocktail
icons.intent: Cheers: the glass is raised and clinks, and the drink takes the knock. Light: the glass lifts and tips toward the right while the drink stays level, stops dead at the clink, and the drink surges up the far wall and sloshes back once as the glass comes upright. Strong: the glass draws back first, swings in harder to the clink, recoils and clinks a second, smaller time; the drink surges higher and sloshes back and forth twice before it settles. The glass stays rigid. (There is no room for clink sparks: the tipped rim reaches within 3.4 of the right edge.)

icons.name: cooking-pot
icons.label: Cooking pot
icons.intent: The pot comes to the boil. Light: steam puffs out from under the lid on both sides and pushes it up, the lid pops 1.8 and tips, then drops back with a clatter and one small bounce. Strong: the lid pops higher and tips further, lands hard, rattles up once more on the other side and lands again; steam puffs out twice, the second time smaller. The pot never moves.

icons.name: frying-pan
icons.label: Frying pan
icons.intent: Light: the pancake is tossed 4.6 units and turns over once in the air before landing. Strong: the pan dips and flicks, the pancake flies 7.2 units high, turns over twice and lands hard with a small bounce.

icons.name: kettle
icons.label: Kettle
icons.intent: Light: a wisp of steam rises 1.8 units from the spout, fades and reforms. Strong: the kettle rocks on its base as it boils and the steam jets up 3.2 units before reforming.

icons.name: toaster
icons.label: Toaster
icons.intent: Light: two slices rise smoothly out of the slots and the lever springs up. Strong: the toaster jolts, the slices pop 1.8 units past their rest, drop back with one small bounce and hold. Toast is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: blender
icons.label: Blender
icons.intent: Light: the cross blade spins two turns and pulls the drink into a shallow vortex that relaxes. Strong: it spins four turns, the vortex deepens and the whole blender buzzes before settling.

icons.name: chef-hat
icons.label: Chef hat
icons.intent: The chef's work is done to perfection: the toque puffs up proudly and a sparkle twinkles. Light: the soft crown puffs up taller and rounder from the band, a sparkle twinkles at its upper right as it peaks, and the crown settles back with one small rebound. Strong: the crown squishes down first, puffs up bigger, a sparkle twinkles at the upper right and a second one at the upper left in turn, and the crown settles in two decaying swings. The band never moves.

icons.name: cutlery
icons.label: Cutlery
icons.intent: Time to eat: the fork and knife clink. Light: both tip in on their handles until the tines meet the blade with a hit, a bright twinkle flashes where they touch, and they bounce apart and settle upright. Strong: they spread apart first, swing in harder to the clink, bounce apart and clink a second time with a second, smaller twinkle, then settle. Both stay rigid.

icons.name: pizza
icons.label: Pizza
icons.intent: Light: the slice's tip sags 1.2 units and springs back. Strong: the slice is lifted 2 units, its tip droops 3 units, rebounds once and settles.

icons.name: burger
icons.label: Burger
icons.intent: The burger is pressed together and springs back, soft and juicy. Light: the top bun presses down onto the stack with a hit, the patty squashes and bulges out at both sides, then the bun springs back up past its place and settles as the patty rounds out again. Strong: the bun lifts first, slams down harder so the patty squashes flatter and wider, and the stack rebounds in two decaying beats. The bottom bun never moves.

icons.name: cake
icons.label: Cake
icons.intent: Light: a flame grows from the candle's wick and flickers once. Strong: it catches with a flare to 120%, sways, and settles into a steady flame. The lit candle is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: ice-cream
icons.label: Ice cream
icons.intent: Light: the scoop stretches up, squashes and settles on the cone. Strong: it crouches, stretches up 10% with a small hop, lands squashed to 84% and wobbles to rest; its volume stays constant.

icons.name: noodle-bowl
icons.label: Noodle bowl
icons.intent: A bite of hot noodles is pulled up out of the bowl. Light: the chopsticks pull up 2.6 and the noodles stretch up from the rim with them, bob once on the springy noodles, then lower back and settle; a wisp of steam rises from the bowl as the noodles come up. Strong: the chopsticks dip in first, pull up 3.4, bob twice, hold and lower back with a small settle; two wisps of steam rise in turn. The bowl never moves.

icons.name: bread
icons.label: Bread
icons.intent: Light: the dough rises from a low mound into a domed loaf. Strong: it springs up past full height by 10% and settles. The risen loaf is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: recipe-book
icons.label: Recipe book
icons.intent: The cookbook opens to a recipe. Light: the front cover swings open on the spine (it foreshortens toward the spine and its spoon emblem turns away), the recipe's lines write on across the page one after another, then the cover swings shut with a thump, bounces once, and the bookmark ribbon swings from the jolt. Strong: the cover is flung open past its stop and wobbles, the lines write on and hold longer, and the cover slams shut with two bounces while the ribbon swings back and forth. The book block never moves.

icons.name: restaurant-menu
icons.label: Restaurant menu
icons.intent: Light: the menu's cover swings open about its centre fold, revealing items on both pages. Strong: it lifts, swings past flat by 8% and settles open. The open menu is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: new-folder
icons.label: New folder
icons.intent: Light: the plus on the folder front pops 15% and settles. Strong: it presses down, pops to 125% with a hit and the folder thumps half a unit before settling.

icons.name: folder-open
icons.label: Folder open
icons.intent: Closed → open: the front panel leans open, its top edge sliding right and up while the bottom stays hinged. Strong: a small inward pull, then the panel swings past open with a hit and settles. Reverse closes it.

icons.name: move-file
icons.label: Move file
icons.intent: Origin → destination: the sheet lifts off its shelf mark and lands on the empty one. Strong: a short pull back, a fast flight with a higher arc, a hit and a settle. Reverse moves it back.

icons.name: rename-file
icons.label: Rename file
icons.intent: The title line on the sheet is erased and retyped while the caret follows. Light: a smooth shorten-and-regrow. Strong: a fast erase, a pause, then four decisive typing steps.

icons.name: duplicate-file
icons.label: Duplicate file
icons.intent: Single → duplicated: a copy slides out from behind the sheet to the lower right; the original stays visible along its top and left edges. Strong: a short pull, a fast slide past the mark with a hit and a settle. Reverse tucks the copy back.

icons.name: restore-file
icons.label: Restore file
icons.intent: The restore arrow on the sheet turns one full anticlockwise turn. Light: one smooth turn. Strong: a short clockwise wind-up, a fast turn past the mark with a hit, then a settle back onto it.

icons.name: approve-file
icons.label: Approve file
icons.intent: Pending → approved: a check draws across the sheet from its left end. Strong: a fast strike that lands with a hit and thumps the sheet. Reverse withdraws the check.

icons.name: lock-file
icons.label: Lock file
icons.intent: Unlocked → locked: the raised shackle swings down about its left leg and seats in the body. Strong: a small extra lift, a fast slam with a hit that thumps the body, and a short bounce. Reverse lifts the shackle open.

icons.name: file-search
icons.label: File search
icons.intent: The file is searched and the match is found. Light: the magnifier makes one quick searching loop over the sheet, stops dead back on its spot and zooms in on the find (it swells and settles). Strong: a short dip, a faster and wider loop, a harder stop, and a bigger zoom that settles in two beats. The sheet holds still under it.

icons.name: file-preview
icons.label: File preview
icons.intent: Hidden → previewed: the upper lid lifts off the lower lid and the pupil appears. Strong: the lid snaps open past its mark with a hit while the pupil dilates and settles. Reverse closes the eye.

icons.name: file-tag
icons.label: File tag
icons.intent: The file is tagged. Light: the tag lifts off the sheet toward you, then slaps back down onto it and stops dead; the sheet takes the slap, rebounds and settles. Strong: the tag peels up higher by its point, slams down flat, the sheet takes a harder knock and settles in two beats, and the tag gives one small bounce. The tag and its eyelet stay rigid.

icons.name: file-star
icons.label: File star
icons.intent: Unstarred → starred: the star on the sheet fills in with a small swell. Strong: a press, a pop past size with a hit as the fill lands, then a settle. Reverse empties the star.

icons.name: file-sync
icons.label: File sync
icons.intent: Two sync arrows on the sheet turn one full clockwise turn. Light: one smooth turn. Strong: an anticlockwise wind-up, a fast turn past the mark with a hit, then a settle.

icons.name: import-file
icons.label: Import file
icons.intent: Content arrives. Light: the arrow drives through the opening into the sheet and stops dead; the sheet takes the knock, rebounds and settles, and a content line draws on inside it where the arrow points. The spent arrow fades and a fresh one slides in from the left to its rest pose, and the line fades as it lands. Strong: a short draw-back, a harder drive, a bigger knock that rebounds twice, and the line snaps on.

icons.name: export-file
icons.label: Export file
icons.intent: Content leaves. Light: the arrow launches out through the opening with a short trail streaking behind it and fades before the edge; the sheet recoils from the launch, rebounds and settles; a fresh arrow slides out of the sheet, just past its rest pose, and settles. Strong: the arrow draws back into the sheet first, then launches faster with a longer trail, the sheet recoils harder and settles in two beats, and the fresh arrow overshoots further and settles in two beats.

icons.name: image-file
icons.label: Image file
icons.intent: The sun rises over the picture. Light: the sun sinks into the peaks and fades as it goes down, then rises back out of them, swelling and brightening, overshoots its spot and settles. Strong: it sinks deeper, rises faster and higher with a hit, swells more, and settles in two beats. The peaks never move.

icons.name: code-file
icons.label: Code file
icons.intent: Code is written into the file. Light: the brackets spring apart and a slash slides out of the left bracket into the gap, so the sheet reads </> for a beat; then the slash tucks back and the brackets snap shut, quicker than they opened. Strong: the brackets fly wider with the slash, overshoot and settle on </>, hold, snap shut and rebound once.

icons.name: spreadsheet-file
icons.label: Spreadsheet file
icons.intent: A 2 x 2 table on the sheet; a selected cell appears in the first cell and travels through the table. Light: it glides to the next column and fades. Strong: it pops in, hops across and down with hits, then fades.

icons.name: audio-file
icons.label: Audio file
icons.intent: Three level bars on the sheet. Light: each bar bumps up in turn and settles. Strong: each bar leaps with a hit, dips below rest and settles, one after the other.

icons.name: video-file
icons.label: Video file
icons.intent: Play is pressed and the video starts. Light: the play triangle presses in (the sheet gives under the press), then springs forward with a kick, stops and eases home. Strong: a deeper press with the sheet sinking further, a harder kick forward that pops the triangle past full size, and a settle in two beats.

icons.name: bell-ring
icons.label: Bell ring
icons.intent: Light: the bell rocks 6° about its crown and the clapper follows. Strong: it winds back, strikes 14° with the clapper swinging wide, two strike marks flash, and it rings down to rest.

icons.name: bell-off
icons.label: Bell off
icons.intent: Light: a slash draws across the bell from upper-left to lower-right and stays. Strong: the bell shakes "no" while the slash strikes through with a small overshoot. Reverse retracts the slash.

icons.name: bell-snooze
icons.label: Bell snooze
icons.intent: Light: the bell leans 12° asleep and two Z's fade up beside it. Strong: it nods over with an overshoot while the Z's pop up 3 units. Reverse: the Z's sink away and the bell rights itself.

icons.name: notification-badge
icons.label: Notification badge
icons.intent: A new notification arrives: the badge springs out of the app tile. Light: the badge ducks into the tile's corner, shrinking, then springs back out to its spot and pops past full size before it settles; the tile recoils as the badge launches. Strong: a deeper duck, a bigger pop with two rebounds, a second ping, and the tile recoils harder and rocks to rest.

icons.name: toast-message
icons.label: Toast message
icons.intent: Light: a toast pill fades in and rises 2.5 units into place at the bottom of the screen. Strong: it springs up past its mark and settles. Reverse: it sinks and fades away.

icons.name: banner-alert
icons.label: Banner alert
icons.intent: Light: the rolled banner unfurls about its centre to full width, revealing an exclamation mark. Strong: it snaps open past full width with a ripple and settles. Reverse rolls it back up.

icons.name: push-notification
icons.label: Push notification
icons.intent: Light: a notification card fades in and drops 3.5 units into the top of the phone screen, then stays. Strong: it lands with a bounce and the phone buzzes on impact. Preview reset rearms.

icons.name: inbox-zero
icons.label: Inbox zero
icons.intent: Light: a check draws in above the empty tray, stroke by stroke. Strong: the check snaps in and its landing stroke dips the tray, which springs back. The check is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: mark-all-read
icons.label: Mark all read
icons.intent: Light: from the top row down, each unread dot fades while a check draws in its place. Strong: the checks snap in faster and each row nudges right as its check lands. Result retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: notification-stack
icons.label: Notification stack
icons.intent: A new notification lands on the stack. Light: the unread dot pops, the front card drops onto the stack with a hit, and the stacked edges below give in turn, each less, then everything settles. Strong: the card lifts first, the dot pops harder, the card slams down and bounces once more, and the edges take both landings in order.

icons.name: mention-alert
icons.label: Mention alert
icons.intent: Light: the @ draws from a visible inner ring through the tail and outer sweep, then a badge dot fades in at its upper right. Strong: the sweep draws in 0.34 s and the dot pops in with a bounce. Result retained; preview reset restores the visible inner ring.

icons.name: priority-alert
icons.label: Priority alert
icons.intent: An urgent alert rings. Light: the exclamation badge pops first, then the bell strikes: the shell swings from its crown away from the badge, the clapper trails it, a ring arc flicks out on the open side and fades as it spreads, and the swing decays in smaller beats. Strong: the badge fires twice and the bell rings twice, harder, with a ring arc on each strike and a longer decay. The badge never leaves its corner.

icons.name: do-not-disturb
icons.label: Do not disturb
icons.intent: Light: the bar draws outward from the centre of the ring in both directions and stays. Strong: it slams out with an overshoot and the ring squashes on the hit. Reverse retracts the bar.

icons.name: reminder-ping
icons.label: Reminder ping
icons.intent: Light: the clock nudges and two ping arcs radiate from its upper right in sequence. Strong: it hops 1.5 units, lands with a hit and the arcs radiate out twice, fast.

icons.name: daily-digest
icons.label: Daily digest
icons.intent: Light: three summary lines draw in under the dated header, one after another. Strong: the page taps down and the lines snap in with a quick stagger. Result retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: notification-settings
icons.label: Notification settings
icons.intent: Light: the level knob slides right along its track and the bell rings gently as the level rises, settling upright. Strong: the knob snaps to high with an overshoot and the bell rings 9° before settling. Reverse slides the knob back to low with a quiet nod.

icons.name: alert-dismiss
icons.label: Alert dismiss
icons.intent: Light: the top alert card slides off to the right and fades while the card below rises into its place. Strong: it flicks away with a 7° tilt and the lower card springs up with a small overshoot. Result retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: alert-expand
icons.label: Alert expand
icons.intent: Light: the collapsed alert card grows downward to more than twice its height, revealing two detail lines as it passes them. Strong: it springs open past full height and settles. Reverse collapses it.

icons.name: sound-alert
icons.label: Sound alert
icons.intent: Light: the outer sound arc swells outward from the bell and fades. Strong: the bell shivers while inner and outer arcs radiate out twice in quick succession.

icons.name: vibrate-alert
icons.label: Vibrate alert
icons.intent: The phone buzzes. Light: one burst: the rigid handset rattles fast about its centre in decaying beats while both vibration arcs kick out and spring back. Strong: buzz, pause, buzz: two harder bursts, the arcs kicking out further on each.

icons.name: search-suggest
icons.label: Search suggest
icons.intent: Light: typing extends the field stub and three suggestions fade down into place one after another. Strong: the stub types faster and the suggestions drop 3 units with an overshoot. Reverse lifts and hides them.

icons.name: recent-searches
icons.label: Recent searches
icons.intent: Light: the minute hand inside the lens swings back 60° and returns. Strong: it winds up, turns one full revolution backwards and the hour hand recoils before both settle.

icons.name: search-clear
icons.label: Search clear
icons.intent: Light: the clear cross presses and the text run wipes out of the field from the right. Strong: a hard press, the field jolts and the text vanishes in 0.16 s. Reverse types the text back in.

icons.name: search-voice
icons.label: Search voice
icons.intent: Light: a wave runs across the three voice bars in the lens, each bulging 1.2 units. Strong: the bars crouch, spike 2.2 units in turn and bounce before settling.

icons.name: search-image
icons.label: Search image
icons.intent: The search finds what is in the picture. Light: the magnifier sweeps across the sky and stops dead over the far peak; the lens pops as it finds it and the mountain hops in answer a beat later, then the magnifier glides home. Strong: it draws back first, shoots across to a hard stop with a recoil, and the mountain hops twice before the magnifier returns. The frame never moves.

icons.name: search-filter
icons.label: Search filter
icons.intent: The filter is applied to the results. Light: the magnifier takes a press, and the push passes down the result lines: the middle line narrows as it is reached, then the bottom one, each stopping dead at its funnel width; the magnifier springs back. Strong: a deeper press with a rebound narrows most of the way, then a second, smaller press clicks both lines to their final widths. The widths never overshoot; the funnel is kept.

icons.name: sort-ascending
icons.label: Sort ascending
icons.intent: Light: the three bars morph into ascending lengths while the arrow nudges up. Strong: every bar retracts to a stub, then the sorted lengths are written in one fast stroke as the arrow hops. Reverse restores the unsorted lengths.

icons.name: sort-descending
icons.label: Sort descending
icons.intent: Light: the three bars morph into descending lengths while the arrow nudges down. Strong: every bar retracts to a stub, then the sorted lengths are written in one fast stroke as the arrow hops. Reverse restores the unsorted lengths.

icons.name: hashtag
icons.label: Hashtag
icons.intent: Light: the two bars of the hash nudge right 1 unit and settle back. Strong: the posts hop 2.4 units in turn and land with a hit while the bars kick right 2 units and rebound.

icons.name: tag-add
icons.label: Tag add
icons.intent: Light: the tag hops 0.8 and a plus grows in its body. Strong: it crouches, hops 1.8, lands with a hit and the plus snaps in past full size. Reverse shrinks the plus away.

icons.name: tag-remove
icons.label: Tag remove
icons.intent: Light: a cross grows in the tag while it droops 8° from its eyelet. Strong: the tag lifts, drops to 11° with a rebound and the cross snaps in. Reverse erases the cross and lifts the tag level.

icons.name: trending-up
icons.label: Trending up
icons.intent: The trend breaks out. Light: the arrow's tip breaks upward first, its head turning to the new heading, and the rest of the line rises into the trend about 80 ms behind it; both stop dead at the trend (no overshoot on the values) and the head nods once past its heading and settles. Strong: the flat arrow crouches first, then the tip shoots up faster with the line chasing it, and the head nods hard and rocks to rest in decaying beats. The trend is kept; the reverse flattens it.

icons.name: trending-down
icons.label: Trending down
icons.intent: The trend breaks out. Light: the arrow's tip drops away first, its head turning to the new heading, and the rest of the line falls into the trend about 80 ms behind it; both stop dead at the trend (no overshoot on the values) and the head nods once past its heading and settles. Strong: the flat arrow lifts first, then the tip plunges faster with the line chasing it, and the head nods hard and rocks to rest in decaying beats. The trend is kept; the reverse flattens it.

icons.name: telescope
icons.label: Telescope
icons.intent: The telescope spots a star. Light: the tube swings up onto the star and stops dead with a small rebound, the star flares and twists as it is found, and the tube lowers. Strong: the tube dips first, swings higher onto the star with a recoil, holds on the find while the star flares twice, then lowers. The post and base never move.

icons.name: related-items
icons.label: Related items
icons.intent: Light: three items slide out from the hub along their spokes and fade in. Strong: they pop out past their positions with a bounce and settle. Reverse draws them back into the hub.

icons.name: saved-search
icons.label: Saved search
icons.intent: Light: the bookmark in the lens dips 0.6 and fills as the search is saved. Strong: it is pressed 1.2 with a hit, rebounds and the fill snaps in. Reverse lifts the ribbon and empties it.

icons.name: web-search
icons.label: Web search
icons.intent: Light: the globe turns a quarter turn, its meridians sweeping across the disc. Strong: it winds back and spins a half turn while the magnifier taps onto it with a hit.

icons.name: search-match
icons.label: Search match
icons.intent: Light: a check draws inside the lens from left to tip. Strong: it draws in 0.28 s and the magnifier stamps down 0.9 with a hit as the tip lands. Reverse erases the check from its tip.

icons.name: search-scope
icons.label: Search scope
icons.intent: The scope narrows and locks onto the search. Light: the four viewfinder brackets close in 2.5 units, one after another clockwise, and stop dead; the lens pops once as the scope locks. Strong: the brackets flare out first and snap in to a dead stop, and the lens pops harder with a rebound and settle. The narrow scope is kept.

icons.name: searching
icons.label: Searching
icons.intent: Continuous: a three-quarter arc orbits inside the lens, one turn per cycle in Light and two turns in Strong. Reduced motion shows the still arc.

icons.name: pin-cluster
icons.label: Pin cluster
icons.intent: Light: two small pins rise into place beside the main pin and fade in. Strong: they shoot up past their places and land, and the main pin hops in response; reverse sinks them away.

icons.name: current-location
icons.label: Current location
icons.intent: Light: one ripple leaves the ring, expands and fades. Strong: the dot pulses and two ripples race outward in quick succession.

icons.name: directions
icons.label: Directions
icons.intent: The pointer sets off along its heading. Light: it draws back, launches forward and streaks out of view with two speed lines left behind its tail, then comes back up from behind as the route rolls on and arrives on its spot with a small overrun and settle. Strong: it first swings to find its heading and locks on with a hard stop, then draws back further, launches and arrives with a two-beat settle. The pointer stays rigid.

icons.name: turn-by-turn
icons.label: Turn by turn
icons.intent: Light: the pointer drives up the lane, rounds the bend and stops facing the exit. Strong: it launches, carries speed through the bend and brakes with a short overrun. The arrived pointer is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: route-recalculate
icons.label: Route recalculate
icons.intent: Light: the route between the start dot and the destination pin bends smoothly onto a new course. Strong: it whips past the new course, settles, and the pin hops; reverse restores the original route.

icons.name: traffic-light
icons.label: Traffic light
icons.intent: Light: red fades to a dot as amber grows, then amber gives way to green. Strong: red drops, amber pops in and holds, and green lands with a small overshoot; reverse runs the signal back to red.

icons.name: map-layers
icons.label: Map layers
icons.intent: A new map layer is laid onto the stack. Light: a sheet fades in above the stack, falls onto the top layer and becomes it; the stack takes the landing in order, top first, then the two layers below 50 ms apart, and rebounds into place. Strong: the sheet comes in from higher and lands harder, and the stack compresses deeper and settles in two beats.

icons.name: satellite
icons.label: Satellite
icons.intent: Light: the satellite rolls 4° and one downlink pulse fades out below it. Strong: it rolls 11° with a damped wobble while two pulses fire twice.

icons.name: street-view
icons.label: Street view
icons.intent: The pegman is dropped into the street. Light: it is picked up 2.6 units, dropped onto its feet with a hit, squashes on landing while two dust marks kick out from its feet and fade, and springs back into its stance. Strong: it is picked up higher, lands harder with a deeper squash and a bigger kick of dust, bounces once and lands again with a smaller puff before it settles. The street never moves.

icons.name: geofence
icons.label: Geofence
icons.intent: Light: six fence dashes draw clockwise around the pin from the top. Strong: all dashes whip on together as the fence snaps outward and settles; reverse retracts the dashes.

icons.name: distance
icons.label: Distance
icons.intent: Light: a measuring tape extends from the left pin to the right pin and its far tick appears on arrival. Strong: the tape launches, overruns the far pin slightly and the pin hops. The measurement is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: elevation
icons.label: Elevation
icons.intent: Light: the marker climbs the trail from the lower slope to the summit. Strong: it climbs with a change of pace, arrives hard and hops once on the summit; reverse descends.

icons.name: parking
icons.label: Parking
icons.intent: Light: the car pulls smoothly into the bay and stops. Strong: it drives in fast, brakes with a short overrun and settles; reverse backs it out.

icons.name: fuel-station
icons.label: Fuel station
icons.intent: The pump dispenses fuel. Light: the nozzle tips 20° on its hose joint to pour, a drop swells at the spout and falls away as the nozzle swings back and clacks onto its hook with a small rebound. Strong: the nozzle is eased off the hook, tips further, squeezes out two drops in turn and clacks back with a two-beat settle. The pump body, window, hose and base never move.

icons.name: ev-charger
icons.label: EV charger
icons.intent: Light: the bolt on the charger face fades in and settles to full size. Strong: it pops in past full size, flickers once and holds; reverse fades it out.

icons.name: transit-stop
icons.label: Transit stop
icons.intent: The next bus pulls in to the stop. Light: the bus pulls away to the right and fades, the next one rolls in from the left, decelerates to a stop at its place, and its body dips 7° onto its front wheel and rocks back to rest. Strong: it comes in faster and brakes harder with a short overrun, the body dipping 10° and rocking back in two beats. The sign, post and ground never move.

icons.name: walking-route
icons.label: Walking route
icons.intent: Light: three footprints appear one after another up the route. Strong: each is stamped down from 125% with a short settle, faster. The trail is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: roundabout
icons.label: Roundabout
icons.intent: Light: the three arrows turn one third of the way round the island. Strong: they wind back, whip past the next position and settle on it.

icons.name: offline-map
icons.label: Offline map
icons.intent: Light: the download arrow sinks into the map and fades as a check draws on. Strong: the arrow lifts, drives in hard, the map jolts and the check whips on. The saved state is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: toll-gate
icons.label: Toll gate
icons.intent: Light: the barrier arm rises 55° about its hinge. Strong: it dips, swings up past the open position and settles; reverse lowers it, and Strong drops it onto the stop with one rebound.

icons.name: flash-toggle
icons.label: Flash toggle
icons.intent: Off to on: three rays grow outward from the bolt's tip and stay. Strong: the bolt jolts and the rays shoot past their length before settling. Reverse pulls the rays back into the tip.

icons.name: self-timer
icons.label: Self-timer
icons.intent: The lens ring counts down clockwise from 12, then the lens dot flashes as the shot fires. Strong counts faster, the flash is bigger and the camera jolts on the shot. The fired camera is retained; preview reset rearms the ring.

icons.name: switch-camera
icons.label: Switch camera
icons.intent: Light: the two arrows turn a half circle inside the camera and land on each other's start. Strong: a short wind-back, then a fast half turn that overshoots and settles.

icons.name: tripod
icons.label: Tripod
icons.intent: The camera is set down on the tripod and the tripod takes its weight. Light: the stand lifts a little with its legs drawn in, then plants: the hub drops and the feet splay out on the ground as the head lands, and the stand springs back once. Strong: a higher lift, a harder plant with the feet spreading wider, two decaying rebounds, and the camera head rocks forward on its mount as it lands and levels again. The feet never leave the ground line.

icons.name: aperture
icons.label: Aperture
icons.intent: Open to stopped down: the six blades sweep in together and close the iris to a small opening, like an aperture ring clicking to a smaller f-stop. Light: one decisive close that stops dead on the stop, bounces open a little off it and settles. Strong: the iris stops down in two clicks, half way and then fully, each landing with a bounce, the second harder. The ring never moves. Reverse opens the blades again.

icons.name: portrait-mode
icons.label: Portrait mode
icons.intent: Off to on: the two background discs blur, growing and fading to 35%, while the subject stays sharp. Strong snaps the background away and the subject pops forward with one settle. Reverse restores the background.

icons.name: live-photo
icons.label: Live photo
icons.intent: Light: the dashed outer ring indexes one step while the centre dot pulses and the inner ring breathes. Strong: a short wind-back, then two steps with an overshoot, a bigger pulse and a wider breath.

icons.name: burst-mode
icons.label: Burst mode
icons.intent: Two extra shots pop out behind the photo in quick succession and stay fanned up to the right. Strong fires them faster with overshoot, and the photo kicks on each shot. The fan is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: panorama
icons.label: Panorama
icons.intent: Photo to panorama: the frame widens from 13 to 24.6 units, its long edges bow inward, the landscape stretches with it and a sun fades in. Strong overshoots the width and settles. Reverse narrows it back.

icons.name: exposure
icons.label: Exposure
icons.intent: Exposure goes up a stop. Light: the light side grows: the divider clicks a full stop toward the minus corner, pushing the shadow back, bounces a little off the stop and holds, then the exposure eases back. Strong: two clicks, each landing with a bounce, the second deeper into the corner than Light's one, before it eases back. The divider's ends stay on the frame the whole way; the frame, plus and minus never move.

icons.name: photo-gallery
icons.label: Photo gallery
icons.intent: Light: the four thumbnails lift one unit each in reading order and settle. Strong: each tile crouches, hops 2.2 units, lands hard and rebounds once, rippling through the grid.

icons.name: photo-album
icons.label: Photo album
icons.intent: Light: the album cover swings 28° on its binding to peek inside and closes. Strong: it presses, swings 58° with a hard stop, and closes with one small rebound. The page behind shows past the cover's edge.

icons.name: photo-edit
icons.label: Photo edit
icons.intent: The photo is being edited: the pencil writes on it. Light: the pencil swoops down under the photo's corner, writes a short squiggle that draws on behind its tip, and lifts back to its place while the mark fades. Strong: the pencil comes down with a tap that bounces, writes the squiggle faster, then flicks off past its place and settles. The photo never moves.

icons.name: rotate-photo
icons.label: Rotate photo
icons.intent: Landscape to portrait: the photo turns a quarter turn clockwise about its centre. Strong winds back 10°, overshoots to 98° with a hard stop and settles while the arrow nods. Reverse turns it back.

icons.name: flip-photo
icons.label: Flip photo
icons.intent: Original to mirrored: the photo turns over about its vertical axis. Light: the axis marks reach in toward the photo first, then the photo turns over through edge-on, its landscape and sun crossing to the other side, lands a touch wide and settles flat; the axis marks let go. Strong: the axis marks grip harder, the photo whips over faster, lands wider and rebounds twice before it settles, and the marks spring back with a recoil. Reverse turns it back the same way.

icons.name: brightness
icons.label: Brightness
icons.intent: Brightness turns up. Light: the lit half of the disc spreads across the dark half until the disc is full, and the light pours out through the rays: each ray shoots out in turn, clockwise from the top, and springs back; then the disc eases back to half. Strong: the brightness steps up in two clicks: the disc fills to three quarters with a first, shorter wave of rays, then to full with a second, longer wave that overshoots and settles, before the disc dims back to half.

icons.name: saturation
icons.label: Saturation
icons.intent: Low to high: colour is added and the saturation rises. Light: a drop of colour forms under the tip, falls through the drop and lands in the colour; on contact the level rises from a fifth to just above half in one decisive fill while the surface sloshes and settles level. Strong: two drops land in turn and the level climbs in two clicks that stop dead, each landing sloshing the surface harder. The level never overshoots and the drop never moves. Reverse drains the colour back down with a small slosh as it lands.

icons.name: red-eye-fix
icons.label: Red-eye fix
icons.intent: The hollow pupil fills in as the fix is applied and a sparkle flashes at the eye's corner. Strong snaps the fill with a small overshoot and a sharper sparkle. The corrected eye is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: photo-delete
icons.label: Photo delete
icons.intent: The photo drops into the bin and fades as it passes the lid. Strong drops it fast, the bin jolts and the lid hops on impact. The emptied bin is retained; preview reset brings the photo back.

icons.name: photo-favorite
icons.label: Photo favorite
icons.intent: Unmarked to favourite: the heart pops and fills in from its centre, then holds. Strong squeezes the heart first and pops it bigger with one settle. Reverse empties the heart with a small dip.

icons.name: music-note
icons.label: Music note
icons.intent: A note is played. Light: the note springs up and lands on the beat, its flag trailing in the air and whipping out on the landing, as a sound arc rings out beside it and fades. Strong: it crouches, leaps higher, lands hard, bounces once more and lands again, the flag whipping on each landing and an arc ringing out with each.

icons.name: vinyl-record
icons.label: Vinyl record
icons.intent: Light: the platter turns one smooth revolution while the tonearm rests. Strong: it winds back 15°, spins two fast revolutions and the tonearm dips onto the rim and settles.

icons.name: cassette-tape
icons.label: Cassette tape
icons.intent: Light: both reels turn one slow revolution. Strong: they wind back 20°, then spin two quick revolutions and stop together.

icons.name: audio-waveform
icons.label: Audio waveform
icons.intent: Light: a soft swell travels across the bars, each rising about a third of the way to the ceiling. Strong: a fast pulse throws every bar to full height in turn.

icons.name: loudspeaker
icons.label: Loudspeaker
icons.intent: The speaker plays a beat. Light: the woofer cone kicks out once (the ring jumps wider and the dust cap punches out a beat behind it) and a sound arc leaves each side of the cabinet, fading as it travels out. Strong: two kicks, the second harder, each sending its pair of arcs, and the cabinet jolts with the second. The tweeter stays still.

icons.name: radio
icons.label: Radio
icons.intent: Light: the tuning needle slides across the dial and drifts back. Strong: the antenna whips and springs, the grille pulses and the needle snaps across the dial before returning.

icons.name: metronome
icons.label: Metronome
icons.intent: The metronome ticks. Light: the pendulum swings out to the left and stops dead on the beat, a tick arc flashing out beside the weight, then falls back to centre with a small settle. Strong: tick then tock: it hits the left stop (tick arc left), swings across to hit the right stop (tock arc right) and settles back on centre. The body never moves.

icons.name: tuner
icons.label: Tuner
icons.intent: Light: the needle rises smoothly from flat to the centre mark. Strong: it swings past the mark to 283°, springs back and settles on centre. Reverse drops it back to flat.

icons.name: piano-keys
icons.label: Piano keys
icons.intent: Light: the middle black key presses 1.4 units and lifts. Strong: the three black keys press 2.2 units in a quick run from left to right.

icons.name: guitar
icons.label: Guitar
icons.intent: A strum rings out. Light: the strum knocks the guitar into a quick sway, the sound hole pumps once and a pair of sound arcs leave both sides of the body and fade as they travel out. Strong: a down-strum then an up-strum: two knocks the other way each time, two pumps and two waves of arcs, settling upright.

icons.name: drum
icons.label: Drum
icons.intent: Light: the left stick lifts 10° and taps the head. Strong: the sticks alternate two hard 22° hits and the shell jolts down on each contact.

icons.name: lyrics
icons.label: Lyrics
icons.intent: Light: a bright highlight sweeps along the middle lyric line and fades back. Strong: the note hops on two beats while the highlight sweeps in 0.35 s.

icons.name: music-album
icons.label: Music album
icons.intent: Light: the disc slides 2 units out of the sleeve while the sleeve shifts 1.5 the other way, revealing a groove. Strong: the disc pops out past its stop and settles back. Reverse slides it home.

icons.name: earbuds
icons.label: Earbuds
icons.intent: Music plays in the earbuds. Light: on the beat each bud pops up and lands hard, and a sound arc leaves its outer side and fades as it travels out; the right bud answers the left a beat later. Strong: two beats, the first bigger, each bud sending an arc on every landing.

icons.name: mute-audio
icons.label: Mute audio
icons.intent: Light: the sound arcs fade and an X draws beside the speaker. Strong: the arcs cut instantly, the X snaps out past full size and settles while the speaker recoils. Reverse shrinks the X and restores the arcs.

icons.name: crossfade
icons.label: Crossfade
icons.intent: Light: the fader knob slides from A to B while curve A dims and curve B brightens. Strong: the knob pulls back, overshoots the B end and settles. Reverse rides it back to A.

icons.name: equalizer-preset
icons.label: Equalizer preset
icons.intent: Light: the three knobs glide from flat to the preset curve, bass first. Strong: each knob overshoots its target and springs back. Reverse returns every knob to the centre line.

icons.name: audio-jack
icons.label: Audio jack
icons.intent: Light: the plug rises 5.5 units and its pin seats in the socket. Strong: it dips first, jabs in with a hard stop and a small recoil. Reverse pulls it out.

icons.name: spatial-audio
icons.label: Spatial audio
icons.intent: Sound moves around the listener. Light: the sound sweeps from the left, over the top, to the right: each arc in turn pushes in toward the listener and springs back. Strong: the whole sound field winds back, then travels a full turn around the listener, overshoots and settles where it started.

icons.name: tuning-fork
icons.label: Tuning fork
icons.intent: The fork is struck and rings. Light: a tap jolts the fork, its prongs ring (spreading and closing in a decaying vibration) and a pair of sound arcs leave the prong tips and fade as they travel out. Strong: the fork is raised and struck hard, the prongs ring wider and longer, and two waves of arcs leave in turn.

icons.name: pen-tool
icons.label: Pen tool
icons.intent: Light: the pen nib dips 1 unit onto the path's last anchor and a soft selection ring spreads from it. Strong: the nib lifts, stabs 1.5 units with a hard stop, the ring bursts to twice the size and the nib rebounds.

icons.name: brush
icons.label: Brush
icons.intent: Light: the brush sweeps down and across in one 0.54 s stroke and the paint swash appears under its bristles. Strong: it lifts, drops onto the canvas, sweeps in 0.24 s leaning into the stroke and flicks up at the end. The swash is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: eraser
icons.label: Eraser
icons.intent: The eraser rubs the line out. Light: the eraser presses down onto the line with a stop, sweeps left 11 units in one pass while the line disappears under it, and lifts off at the far end, leaving the short line (v1's end state). Strong: it lifts first, slams down with a bounce, scrubs back and forth in three decaying strokes as it travels, and lifts off with a small hop. The erased length never grows back; the reverse slides it back while the line redraws.

icons.name: corner-radius
icons.label: Corner radius
icons.intent: Light: the square's corners round from sharp to a 6-unit radius in 0.5 s while the radius handle slides inward along the diagonal. Strong: the radius snaps past 7 and settles at 6. Reverse sharpens the corners.

icons.name: line-tool
icons.label: Line tool
icons.intent: Light: a line is pulled from the start anchor to the end anchor in 0.52 s and the end anchor fades in. Strong: the start anchor is pressed, the line shoots across in 0.18 s and the end anchor pops in oversized and settles. The line is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: rectangle-tool
icons.label: Rectangle tool
icons.intent: Light: a rectangle is dragged out from its origin handle to the far corner in 0.56 s while the drag handle rides the corner. Strong: the handle is grabbed, the corner shoots out in 0.2 s, overshoots by 6% and settles. The rectangle is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: ellipse-tool
icons.label: Ellipse tool
icons.intent: Light: a pen tip sweeps an ellipse clockwise from its top anchor in 0.64 s and the interior tints as the contour closes. Strong: the tip swings back 12°, sweeps 372° with a stop and settles onto the anchor. The ellipse is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: polygon-tool
icons.label: Polygon tool
icons.intent: Light: a hexagon is drawn vertex by vertex in one 0.64 s run; an anchor appears at each vertex reached and the interior tints when the contour closes. Strong: six quick hops with a stop at each vertex, each anchor popping in oversized. The hexagon is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: fill-bucket
icons.label: Fill bucket
icons.intent: Light: the paint bucket tips 8° further, a stream falls from its lip for 0.4 s and a puddle spreads below in 0.5 s. Strong: the bucket rocks back, tips 16° with a stop and the puddle surges past full before settling. The puddle is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: eyedropper
icons.label: Eyedropper
icons.intent: Light: the dropper's bulb is squeezed, the tip dips 1.2 units onto the swatch, the bulb releases to draw the sample and the dropper lifts. Strong: a hard squeeze, a 1.7 unit stab with a stop, a snap release that wobbles the swatch, and a rebound.

icons.name: group-objects
icons.label: Group objects
icons.intent: Light: the square and the circle glide together in 0.44 s and a group frame fades in around them. Strong: they flinch apart, snap together with a stop and the frame pops in oversized. Reverse dissolves the frame and parts them.

icons.name: align-objects
icons.label: Align objects
icons.intent: Light: three ragged blocks slide left in turn until their edges sit on the guide, 0.44 s each. Strong: each block pulls back, whips to the guide with a stop and settles. Reverse scatters them to their ragged positions.

icons.name: magic-wand
icons.label: Magic wand
icons.intent: Light: the wand taps 6° and two soft sparkles pop while the tip star twinkles. Strong: the wand winds back 8°, flicks 16° with a stop, the star spins a full turn and three sparkles burst in sequence before fading.

icons.name: lasso-select
icons.label: Lasso select
icons.intent: A lasso is drawn around the object and the object is selected. Light: the loop is drawn freehand from where the tail joins it, up the right side, over the top and back round the bottom, closing on itself; the object inside pops once as it is caught. Strong: the tail is drawn in first, the loop sweeps round faster and closes hard, then it cinches tight around the object and springs back while the object pops and settles in two beats.

icons.name: transform-tool
icons.label: Transform tool
icons.intent: Light: the far corner handle is dragged and the selection box scales 14% from its origin corner with the object inside, then eases back. Strong: a short back-step, a 26% scale with a stop, a hold and a spring return.

icons.name: rotate-tool
icons.label: Rotate tool
icons.intent: Light: the square turns a quarter turn about its centre in 0.5 s under the fixed rotation cursor. Strong: it winds back 12°, turns fast past 90° with a stop and settles onto the quarter turn.

icons.name: mirror-tool
icons.label: Mirror tool
icons.intent: The left shape is reflected across the axis. Light: the old reflection clears, a copy peels off the left triangle and folds over the dashed axis like a page, flattening to a line on the axis and opening out on the right, where it lands with a stop and is pushed out a little before it settles. Strong: the source triangle pulls back and pushes into the mirror, the copy folds across faster, the axis dashes ripple apart as it passes through, and the landed reflection recoils further and settles in two beats.

icons.name: snap-to-grid
icons.label: Snap to grid
icons.intent: Light: the square is dragged 2.2 units off the centre grid point and snaps back in 0.1 s while the point pulses. Strong: it is dragged farther, snaps back hard past the point and settles as the point pulses.

icons.name: ruler-guides
icons.label: Ruler guides
icons.intent: Guides are pulled out of the rulers and set on the 17 marks. Light: the vertical guide is drawn down out of the top ruler, and the horizontal guide follows a beat later, drawn across out of the left ruler; each stops at full length. Strong: each guide is also dragged out from its ruler while it draws, runs past its mark, snaps back onto it with a stop and settles; the horizontal one follows the vertical one. The rulers never move.

icons.name: scissors
icons.label: Scissors
icons.intent: The scissors snip. Light: the blades ease a touch wider, then snap shut about the hub with a stop (12 degrees each, the handles squeezing together) and spring back open past rest before settling. Strong: snip-snip, two cuts in a row, the second shallower, then a small settle. The rest pose is the open pair; the hub never moves.

icons.name: rsvp
icons.label: RSVP
icons.intent: Light: a check is drawn onto the reply card in one quiet stroke. Strong: the pen strikes the vertex, the card dips and the long stroke snaps to its end. Reverse retraces the check.

icons.name: event-invite
icons.label: Event invite
icons.intent: Light: the invitation card slides 7 units up out of the envelope. Strong: the envelope dips, the card shoots up past its mark and settles. Reverse slides the card back in.

icons.name: venue
icons.label: Venue
icons.intent: Light: the two door leaves slide into the walls and the arched doorway stands open. Strong: they snap open in 0.18 s and the hall thumps once. Reverse slides the doors shut.

icons.name: seat-map
icons.label: Seat map
icons.intent: A seat is picked on the map. Light: the chosen seat presses in as it is tapped, pops past its selected size and settles at 1.5x. Strong: a deeper press and a bigger pop with a two-beat settle, and the pop sends a ripple through the other seats, nearest first, each dipping and recovering. Deselect: the seat swells slightly, shrinks back past its seat size and settles; the others stay still. The stage never moves.

icons.name: agenda
icons.label: Agenda
icons.intent: Light: three session rows extend from their bullets one after another. Strong: they snap in quickly while the clipboard bumps. Retained; the preview reset retracts the rows.

icons.name: event-speaker
icons.label: Event speaker
icons.intent: Light: two sound arcs leave the microphone, drift right 0.6 and fade. Strong: the mic rocks on its gooseneck and the arcs pulse twice, punching out 1.4 units each time.

icons.name: event-badge
icons.label: Event badge
icons.intent: The badge is shown at the door and its holder is recognised. Light: the badge is flicked up on its lanyard, the attendee's head pops at the top of the swing as they are recognised, and the badge swings back and settles. Strong: a small wind-up, a wider flick, the head pops harder and the shoulders lift with it a beat later, and the badge rocks to rest in decaying swings. The lanyard never moves; the card stays rigid.

icons.name: check-in
icons.label: Check-in
icons.intent: Light: the ticket feeds 8.5 units down into the reader, then a check lights inside it. Strong: the ticket drops in 0.16 s, the reader thumps and the check snaps in. Reverse clears the check and lifts the ticket back out.

icons.name: add-to-calendar
icons.label: Add to calendar
icons.intent: A new event is written onto the calendar. Light: the plus draws on, the upright stroke first and the crossbar a beat later, then it pops once as the entry is set and settles. Strong: the plus draws on with crisp stops, pops harder, and the calendar takes the new entry with a thump, a rebound and a settle. The leaf stays rigid.

icons.name: event-reminder
icons.label: Event reminder
icons.intent: The reminder goes off: the bell on the calendar rings. Light: the bell swings out from the top of its dome, the clapper trails it, and a ring arc flicks out beside the bell on the open side of each of the first two swings and fades as it spreads; the swing decays to rest in smaller beats. Strong: a wind-up, a wider swing and a longer ring-down with three dings that alternate sides and fade. The calendar never moves.

icons.name: ticket-scan
icons.label: Ticket scan
icons.intent: The ticket's code is read at the gate. Light: the scan bar sweeps down over the code at a steady speed, each block of the code blinks in reading order as the bar crosses it, and the bar flicks back up to its start, quicker than it went. Strong: the same read with harder blinks, and as the bar flicks back the ticket is admitted: it hops once and lands with a small bounce. The ticket stays rigid with all its print.

icons.name: ticket-transfer
icons.label: Ticket transfer
icons.intent: Light: the ticket slides 7 units to the right as a forward arrow draws above it. Strong: it pulls back, drives past the mark and settles. Reverse retracts the arrow and returns the ticket.

icons.name: waitlist
icons.label: Waitlist
icons.intent: Light: the front of the queue is admitted and slides away as the list moves up one slot. Strong: it shoots out and the queue snaps up with a bounded overshoot. Retained; the preview reset restores the queue.

icons.name: sold-out
icons.label: Sold out
icons.intent: Light: an X grows across the ticket from its centre. Strong: it stamps past full size and the ticket dips under the blow. Reverse shrinks the X away.

icons.name: early-bird
icons.label: Early bird
icons.intent: Light: the bird on the ticket pecks 8° about its feet and settles. Strong: it hops 2.6 units, lands with a peck and the ticket dips beneath it.

icons.name: event-live
icons.label: Event live
icons.intent: Light: the spotlights fade on and swivel 8° onto the stage. Strong: they swing in 25°, overshoot, and the lamps flash. Reverse swings them out and fades to dark.

icons.name: event-replay
icons.label: Event replay
icons.intent: Light: the replay arrow turns one full revolution around the play mark. Strong: it winds up 25°, spins past the mark and settles while the play triangle pulses.

icons.name: sponsor
icons.label: Sponsor
icons.intent: The sponsor's banner is unveiled. Light: the banner snaps up into a roll under its rod and unfurls down again, catching with a small stretch and settling, and the sponsor's star pops back onto the cloth a beat later. Strong: a quicker snap and a harder unfurl that stretches and bounces twice, the rod and banner jolt down together as the cloth catches, and the star twists in as it pops. The rod stays rigid.

icons.name: networking
icons.label: Networking
icons.intent: Light: two people lean 5° toward each other while a link draws in from both sides and a node appears where it meets. Strong: they lean back, snap together with overshoot and the node pops. Reverse straightens them and retracts the link.

icons.name: event-map
icons.label: Event map
icons.intent: The venue is pinned on the map. Light: the rigid pin lifts, drops and lands on its tip with a hit and a small rebound, and a ripple spreads out across the map from the tip and fades. Strong: a higher drop that jolts the folded map down under it, a bounce and a second, smaller landing, with a ripple on each contact. The map stays rigid.

icons.name: car
icons.label: Car
icons.intent: The car pulls away. Light: it squats back onto its rear wheel as it launches, so the nose and front wheel lift, and two air streaks peel off behind the roof; the nose comes down onto the front wheel with a hit and bounces once. Strong: it loads up first (the nose dips), then launches harder into a bigger lift with three streaks, lands with a hit and bounces twice. The car is rigid and pitches about its rear axle; the streaks are hidden at rest and gone before the end.

icons.name: electric-car
icons.label: Electric car
icons.intent: Light: the lightning bolt on the door swells 15% and eases back. Strong: it pops to 120% with a snap while the car dips 0.7 units on its suspension and settles.

icons.name: fuel-pump
icons.label: Fuel pump
icons.intent: The pump dispenses fuel. Light: fuel surges down the hose and the hose and nozzle kick out, rebound and settle; a drop swells at the nozzle tip and falls, fading. Strong: two surges, each kicking the hose harder, and a drop forms and falls after each. The pump body never moves; the hose stays rigid and swings from where it leaves the pump; the drop is hidden at rest and gone before the end.

icons.name: speedometer
icons.label: Speedometer
icons.intent: The car accelerates and the speedometer reads it. Light: the needle sweeps up to the top mark, each mark it passes flares inward, it holds the reading a beat and drops back to its stop quicker than it rose. Strong: the car pulls through the gears: the needle climbs in three surges with a pause at each change, the marks flare in turn and the red-line mark flares hardest on arrival, then the needle drops back to its stop. The needle never overshoots its reading.

icons.name: parking-brake
icons.label: Parking brake
icons.intent: Forward: the two brackets of the tell-tale grow out from their midpoints to 60° arcs; Strong snaps them past full while the lamp bumps 7%. Reverse: the brackets shrink back and go dark.

icons.name: tire-pressure
icons.label: Tire pressure
icons.intent: Light: the tyre sags 8% and re-inflates. Strong: it slumps 18% with bulging side walls, the exclamation mark bounces on the tread and the tyre re-inflates.

icons.name: engine
icons.label: Engine
icons.intent: The engine fires up. Light: the block jolts up as it fires, rocking a little, and a vibration mark flicks out from each shoulder; it drops back with a hit and rattles down in two smaller bounces as the marks fade. Strong: the starter cranks twice (two small jolts), then the engine catches: a bigger jolt and rock, marks flick out from both shoulders and the top, and it rattles down in three decaying bounces. The block stays rigid; the marks ride with it and are gone before the end.

icons.name: seatbelt
icons.label: Seatbelt
icons.intent: Forward: the belt is pulled from the shoulder across to the hip; Strong pulls it taut past the hip and clicks home while the figure settles. Reverse: the belt retracts to the shoulder.

icons.name: headlights
icons.label: Headlights
icons.intent: Forward: three beams extend out of the lamp in sequence; Strong flashes them out past full length and the lamp recoils. Reverse: the beams draw back into the lamp.

icons.name: wiper
icons.label: Wiper
icons.intent: Rain lands on the windscreen and the wiper clears it. Light: two drops land on the glass, then the arm sweeps 80 degrees across and each drop vanishes as the blade crosses it; the arm comes back to park quicker, stops with a hit and settles. Strong: three drops land in turn, the arm whips 95 degrees across to a hard stop, wiping them in order, slams back to park and settles. The screen and pivot never move; the drops are hidden at rest and gone before the end.

icons.name: steering-wheel
icons.label: Steering wheel
icons.intent: Steer into a bend and let go: the wheel self-centres. Light: the driver turns the wheel 36 degrees, holds it a beat, and releases; it spins back faster than it went, swings 6 degrees past centre and settles. Strong: a short counter-steer, a hard 92-degree turn, a hold, then the release spins it back through centre with two settling swings. The rigid wheel turns about its hub.

icons.name: car-key
icons.label: Car key
icons.intent: Light: the two signal arcs blink in sequence. Strong: the key bumps as the button is pressed and both arcs radiate a unit outward, fade and reform.

icons.name: car-lock
icons.label: Car lock
icons.intent: The car locks, and it answers like a key fob chirp. Light: the raised shackle swings 28 degrees shut and slams down into the padlock with a hit, the padlock jolts, and a beat later the car dips on its springs and rebounds. Strong: the shackle lifts and opens a little first, snaps shut and slams in, the padlock jolts harder, and the car answers with a double dip, chirp-chirp. The reverse pops the shackle up and swings it open with a small overshoot while the car stays still. The wheels stay planted; the shackle holds shut.

icons.name: car-battery
icons.label: Car battery
icons.intent: Light: the plus mark pulses 20% and settles. Strong: the battery jolts up a unit, rocks 2° and its plus mark pulses 35% before settling.

icons.name: gear-shift
icons.label: Gear shift
icons.intent: Shift from first into second. Light: the knob is drawn down the left slot, catches for a beat at neutral where the crossbar meets it, then clunks into second with a hit, rebounds and seats. Strong: the knob is tugged up out of first, runs down to neutral, catches, slams into second and bounces twice before it seats. The reverse runs it back up through neutral and clunks it into first. The gate never moves; the knob holds in second.

icons.name: car-navigation
icons.label: Car navigation
icons.intent: Forward: the route draws from the car dot up to the destination pin; Strong draws it in 0.24 s and the pin hops as the route arrives. Reverse: the route withdraws to the car.

icons.name: car-wash
icons.label: Car wash
icons.intent: Light: three water drops fall 4 units onto the roof, fade and reform above. Strong: they fall twice as fast in two bursts while the car rocks 2° under the spray.

icons.name: engine-oil
icons.label: Engine oil
icons.intent: Light: a drop falls 3.8 units from the spout, fades and reforms. Strong: the can tips 10° toward its spout and the drop falls 5.2 units fast before the can settles.

icons.name: car-window
icons.label: Car window
icons.intent: The window rolls down. Light: the glass runs down 5 units inside the window, lands on its bottom stop with a hit, rebounds almost a unit and seats. Strong: one-touch express down: the glass breaks free of the top seal with a short jerk, drops fast onto its stop, and bounces twice before it seats. The reverse runs the glass up into the top seal with a hit and a small rebound. The door, window frame and handle never move; the glass holds open.

icons.name: trunk
icons.label: Trunk
icons.intent: The trunk opens. Light: the latch releases and the lid pops up a few degrees and catches, then the gas struts lift it to 70 degrees open; it overshoots a little and settles. Strong: the latch pops harder with a thunk through the car, the struts fling the lid 12 degrees past open, it swings back under and settles. The reverse swings the lid down and slams it shut: it bounces on the seal and the car dips on its springs. The wheels stay planted; the lid holds open.

icons.name: gavel
icons.label: Gavel
icons.intent: Light: the gavel taps, lifting 10° off its block and dropping back. Strong: it is raised 30°, held a beat and slammed down; the block takes the shock.

icons.name: justice-scale
icons.label: Justice scale
icons.intent: Something is weighed and the scale finds balance. Light: a weight drops onto the left pan's hanger and vanishes into it; the beam tips under it, swings back through level once and settles, the pans hanging plumb from its ends. Strong: the weight lands harder, the beam tips further and rings down through three shrinking swings to level. The post and base never move.

icons.name: contract
icons.label: Contract
icons.intent: Light: a signature is drawn across the signature line of the sheet. Strong: it is dashed off in 0.26 s and the sheet dips under the pen. The signed contract is retained; the reverse erases it.

icons.name: rubber-stamp
icons.label: Rubber stamp
icons.intent: Light: the stamp presses 3.2 units onto the paper and lifts, leaving its mark. Strong: it lifts, slams down with a hold and the mark pops in under it. The mark is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: official-seal
icons.label: Official seal
icons.intent: Light: the seal rocks 5° and its ribbons sway after it. Strong: it is pressed to 94%, rocks 12° and the ribbons whip 22° before settling.

icons.name: courthouse
icons.label: Courthouse
icons.intent: The court is raised. Light: the pediment is lifted clear, the three columns rise from the base one after another, left to right, and the pediment is set down on them with a hit and one small rebound. Strong: the pediment is hoisted higher, the columns rise in quicker succession, and it drops onto them hard, bounces and settles. The base never moves.

icons.name: gdpr-shield
icons.label: GDPR shield
icons.intent: Every principle is checked and the data is protected. Light: a pop runs once round the ring of stars, clockwise from the top, each star swelling and settling in turn; as the last one lands the shield swells once and settles. Strong: a quicker, bigger pop runs round the ring, then the whole ring pops together as the shield swells, rebounds and settles. The stars never leave their places.

icons.name: audit
icons.label: Audit
icons.intent: The ledger is checked line by line. Light: the magnifier hops down to the next entry and the one after, stopping dead on each, focuses (the glass swells) on the second, and springs back to its spot. Strong: it hops down all three entries, focusing on each stop and hardest on the last, then snaps back home with an overshoot and settles. The sheet never moves.

icons.name: policy
icons.label: Policy
icons.intent: Light: the bottom roll unrolls 6 units, extending the page and revealing a second clause. Strong: it snaps down past its stop and settles. The unrolled policy is retained; the reverse rolls it up.

icons.name: terms-of-service
icons.label: Terms of service
icons.intent: The terms are read to the end. Light: the scrollbar thumb runs down the track and lands at the end with a hit and a small rebound, while the clauses scroll up against it and rubber-band back into place as the end is reached. Strong: the thumb is pulled up, flicked down, hits the end, bounces and lands again; the text flies up further and springs back with an overscroll bounce. The thumb stays at the end (read); the reverse scrolls back to the top, the text moving down and springing back.

icons.name: compliance-check
icons.label: Compliance check
icons.intent: Light: three ticks draw in down the clipboard, one after another. Strong: they snap in quickly and the board dips as the last one lands. The checked board is retained; the reverse erases the ticks.

icons.name: redact
icons.label: Redact
icons.intent: Light: two marker bars sweep across the second and fourth lines of the sheet. Strong: the bars are struck through in 0.16 s each and the sheet kicks as the marker lifts. The redacted sheet is retained; the reverse withdraws the bars.

icons.name: consent
icons.label: Consent
icons.intent: Light: a tick draws inside the consent box. Strong: the box squashes under the tap and the tick snaps in. The agreed state is retained; the reverse clears the tick.

icons.name: cookie-banner
icons.label: Cookie banner
icons.intent: Light: a banner rises from the bottom of the screen and its cookie and message fade in. Strong: it shoots up past its height, settles and the content lands. The shown banner is retained; the reverse drops it away.

icons.name: data-retention
icons.label: Data retention
icons.intent: Light: the retention clock badged on the database sweeps one full turn. Strong: the hand winds back, whips round past twelve and settles as the clock jolts.

icons.name: disclaimer
icons.label: Disclaimer
icons.intent: The fine print is attached. Light: the fine print clears, the asterisk clicks round a sixth of a turn and pops, and the three lines of fine print write themselves out beside it, top to bottom. Strong: the asterisk winds back, spins two sixths and stops dead, pops harder and settles in two beats while the lines write out in quicker succession.

icons.name: copyright
icons.label: Copyright
icons.intent: The work is claimed: the C is written into the ring and the mark is stamped. Light: the C clears and writes itself round from its top end like a pen stroke; as it closes, the whole mark stamps once (swells and settles). Strong: the mark lifts while the C writes faster, then stamps down hard, rebounds and settles. The ring never redraws.

icons.name: whistleblower
icons.label: Whistleblower
icons.intent: Light: the whistle tilts 5° as it is blown and one sound arc blinks. Strong: it jerks 12° with a snap, shakes, and both sound arcs burst outward.

icons.name: evidence-bag
icons.label: Evidence bag
icons.intent: Light: the zip pull slides across the band and seals the bag. Strong: it is snapped shut and the bag jolts as it seats. The sealed bag is retained; the reverse unseals it.

icons.name: legal-hold
icons.label: Legal hold
icons.intent: Light: the padlock shackle drops into its body, placing the document on hold. Strong: it slams shut and the body jolts. The hold is retained; the reverse lifts the shackle out.

icons.name: language
icons.label: Language
icons.intent: The language switches. Light: the A slides out to the left as a 文 slides in from the right and holds for a moment, then the 文 slides on out and the A comes back in from the right and settles, like flipping through a list of languages. Strong: the A pulls back before it leaves, each glyph lands with an overshoot, the 文 holds longer, and the bubble puffs about its tail as each one arrives. The glyphs cross-fade, so the bubble is never empty.

icons.name: region
icons.label: Region
icons.intent: The world turns to your region and the pin marks it. Light: the globe turns one step (its meridian narrows to a line and opens out again) while the pin lifts off it, and as the globe stops the pin plants back on it with a hit; the globe dips under the impact and the pin settles. Strong: the globe spins two steps, the pin lifts higher, lands with a hit and bounces once, and the globe dips harder.

icons.name: currency
icons.label: Currency
icons.intent: Light: the coin turns over in half a second, its dollar face giving way to the euro face. Strong: it winds back, flips past flat with a stop, hops 1.6 and lands. Reverse flips it back.

icons.name: appearance
icons.label: Appearance
icons.intent: Light: the brush glides 14 units to the right and paints a band behind its tip. Strong: it dabs, drags its handle back 12° through a fast sweep, stops and straightens. The painted band is retained; reverse wipes it back.

icons.name: dark-mode
icons.label: Dark mode
icons.intent: Light: the rays draw into the sun and the disc morphs into a crescent moon. Strong: the rays snap in, the disc grows into the moon with a stop and swings 50° into place. Reverse: the moon morphs back and the rays grow out.

icons.name: quiet-hours
icons.label: Quiet hours
icons.intent: Light: the bell nods 5° while a slash draws across it. Strong: the bell rings 12° each way, the slash strikes through it with a stop and the bell freezes. Reverse: the slash wipes back and the bell rings once, free again.

icons.name: privacy-shield
icons.label: Privacy shield
icons.intent: Light: the eye inside the shield closes, its upper lid settling onto the lower lid. Strong: the eye widens 15%, snaps shut with a stop and the shield dips half a unit. Reverse: the eye opens; Strong pops it open past full.

icons.name: shortcut-key
icons.label: Shortcut key
icons.intent: The shortcut fires. Light: the keycap is struck down into its base with a hit, holds for a beat and springs back past rest; as it bottoms out the bolt on it fires, popping bigger and settling. Strong: a harder strike after a small lift, a longer spring back, and the charged bolt crackles with a quick shaking twist as it pops. The base never moves.

icons.name: mouse
icons.label: Mouse
icons.intent: A click. Light: the mouse is pressed into the desk with a hit, three click marks flash out beside the left button and spread as they fade, and the mouse springs back with a small overshoot. Strong: a double-click, two presses in quick succession, the second deeper, each with its own flash of click marks. The mouse stays rigid and only dips as a whole.

icons.name: auto-rotate
icons.label: Auto-rotate
icons.intent: Light: the phone turns a quarter turn clockwise into landscape. Strong: it winds back 1.8°, whips through the turn past 90° with a stop and settles while hopping 0.96. Reverse turns it back to portrait.

icons.name: sound-toggle
icons.label: Sound toggle
icons.intent: Light: the sound arcs fade back into the speaker and a cross fades in beside it. Strong: the speaker recoils 0.7 as the arcs cut out, then the cross snaps in 20% large with a stop. Reverse: the cross fades and the arcs return.

icons.name: battery-saver
icons.label: Battery saver
icons.intent: Light: the low charge block fades out and a leaf grows into the battery. Strong: the block drops away and the leaf pops in 1% past full with a stop before settling. Reverse restores the charge block.

icons.name: mobile-data
icons.label: Mobile data
icons.intent: Light: the transfer arrows slide apart by 1 and the signal bars bob taller one after another. Strong: the arrows dart 2.4 apart with a stop while the bars collapse to a third and spring back up in sequence past full.

icons.name: haptic-feedback
icons.label: Haptic feedback
icons.intent: The phone buzzes in your hand. Light: the rigid phone rattles side to side in a quick decaying buzz, and a ripple of vibration leaves each arc and fades as it spreads. Strong: two bursts, buzz, pause, buzz, with a twist in the rattle and a ripple on each burst. The phone never bends.

icons.name: reset-settings
icons.label: Reset settings
icons.intent: Light: the two slider knobs glide back to centre while the ring makes one anticlockwise turn. Strong: the ring winds 20° back and spins fast to a stop while the knobs snap 15% past centre and settle. Reverse slides the knobs back to their custom positions.

icons.name: auto-update
icons.label: Auto-update
icons.intent: The update installs by itself. Light: the ring runs one clockwise cycle on its own, and as it comes round the download arrow pulls back and plunges into place with a hit, rebounds a little and settles. Strong: the ring winds back before it whips round, overshoots and settles, and the arrow pulls back further and plunges harder with a two-beat settle. An invisible step returns the ring from 360 to 0.

icons.name: startup-apps
icons.label: Startup apps
