icons.intent: Light: the rocket lifts 1.4 on a short exhaust and eases back down. Strong: it crouches 0.6, launches 2.8 with a longer exhaust, hangs, drops back with a stop and settles.

icons.name: pointer-speed
icons.label: Pointer speed
icons.intent: The pointer goes fast. Light: the pointer draws back, then dashes to the right and stops dead; its speed lines are dragged after it a beat later and stretch out behind it, top line first, then everything glides home. Strong: a deeper draw-back and a longer dash that stops with a bounce, and the speed lines stretch further.

icons.name: advanced-settings
icons.label: Advanced settings
icons.intent: Something gets tightened. Light: the wrench winds back a little, cranks hard clockwise about the nut held in its jaw and stops dead, three short marks flash out of the jaw as it bites, and the wrench swings back and settles. Strong: it ratchets twice, crank, swing back, a harder crank, with a flash of marks on each bite. The wrench stays rigid and turns about the nut.

icons.name: trackpad
icons.label: Trackpad
icons.intent: A two-finger swipe. Light: the two fingertips swipe right across the pad, tracing a swipe trail behind them, then lift (shrinking) and slide quickly back, touching down where they started with a small pop. Strong: the fingertips press in first, swipe farther, lift higher and land with a bouncier two-beat touch-down. The pad never moves.

icons.name: sparkle
icons.label: Sparkle
icons.intent: Light: the large sparkle twinkles (scale 0.86, 10° turn) while the small one dims. Strong: it shrinks to 0.6, bursts to 1.12 with a 40° twist and settles; the small sparkle blinks out and pops back.

icons.name: lightbulb
icons.label: Lightbulb
icons.intent: Off → on. Light: the filament fades in and three rays extend 1.9 units from the glass. Strong: the bulb jolts up 0.7 as the rays shoot out 2.2 and settle back to 1.9. The reverse retracts the rays and fades the filament.

icons.name: product-tour
icons.label: Product tour
icons.intent: The tour marker travels from the first stop over the second to the last stop along the route. Light: two smooth glides with a pause at the middle stop. Strong: two quick hops that lift 2.2 and land hard on each stop. Reverse walks the route back.

icons.name: tooltip
icons.label: Tooltip
icons.intent: The target is hovered and its tooltip pops up with the hint. Light: the target dot swells, the bubble ducks into its tail, pops out with an overshoot and settles, and its two text lines write in from the left, the second a beat after the first. Strong: the target taps in and swells, the bubble ducks deeper, pops bigger with a two-beat settle, and the lines write in turn. The bubble grows from its tail tip, so it stays anchored to its target.

icons.name: hotspot
icons.label: Hotspot
icons.intent: Light: one pulse ring expands from the beacon to r9.6 and fades. Strong: the dot pops to 1.35× and two faster rings expand to r11.5 in succession.

icons.name: new-badge
icons.label: New badge
icons.intent: A new badge is pinned on and gleams. Light: the seal dips, pops out with a twist and settles, the star inside pops a beat behind it, and a glint flashes off the seal's upper-right corner as it settles. Strong: a deeper dip with a counter-twist, a bigger pop and twist with a two-beat settle, the star pops harder, and two glints flash in turn, upper right then lower left. The seal and star keep their shape.

icons.name: confetti
icons.label: Confetti
icons.intent: Light: the scattered pieces drift and turn gently in place. Strong: the lower ribbon stays visible while the other pieces burst from the bottom centre to their resting places with a full spin and fade back in.

icons.name: welcome-wave
icons.label: Welcome wave
icons.intent: Light: the hand waves once, 8° each way about the wrist. Strong: a bigger, faster wave (15° each way with two hard reversals) that damps out over four beats.

icons.name: progress-checklist
icons.label: Progress checklist
icons.intent: Unchecked → complete. Light: three checks are drawn in sequence, each in 0.22 s. Strong: fast overlapping strokes 0.1 s apart, and each row line nudges right as its check lands. Reverse erases the checks from the bottom up.

icons.name: skip-step
icons.label: Skip step
icons.intent: Light: both chevrons nudge 1.4 toward the stop bar and ease back. Strong: they swing back 1.2, the leading chevron drives 2.5 into the bar, the bar kicks 0.7 and both chevrons rebound to rest.

icons.name: next-step
icons.label: Next step
icons.intent: The button is pressed and the flow advances one step. Light: the button dips under the press while the arrow draws back a little, then the arrow lunges right inside the button with two speed lines streaking out behind its barbs, and springs back to rest with a small overshoot. Strong: a deeper press and draw-back, a longer lunge, and a spring back that settles in two beats.

icons.name: spark-wand
icons.label: Spark wand
icons.intent: Light: the sparkle twinkles (0.8×, 18° turn) and the spark dots dim. Strong: the wand flicks 6° back and 12° forward about its base while the sparkle bursts to 1.12× with a 45° twist and the dots blink.

icons.name: hotkey-hint
icons.label: Hotkey hint
icons.intent: The shortcut is struck. Light: the keycap is pressed down into its well with a hit, two strike marks flash out from its top corners as it bottoms out, and the key springs back past rest and settles. Strong: a quick double tap: a light first tap, then a hard press that bottoms out with the strike marks flying further, and a two-beat spring back. The well never moves; the keycap stays rigid.

icons.name: spotlight
icons.label: Spotlight
icons.intent: Left → right. Light: the spotlight glides 9 units across the dimmed page. Strong: it draws back 0.7, drives across with a hard stop 0.7 past the target, settles and swells once. Reverse glides back.

icons.name: coachmark
icons.label: Coachmark
icons.intent: Hidden → shown. Light: the callout card fades in while sliding 1 unit down-right to its tail target. Strong: the button is pressed 0.8, then the card springs in with a 0.5 horizontal overshoot and settles. Reverse slides it out.

icons.name: getting-started
icons.label: Getting started
icons.intent: Light: the rocket hops 1.4 and settles while its exhaust stretches slightly. Strong: it squats 0.6, launches 3.6 with the exhaust stretching to 4 units, hangs, then lands with a single soft bounce.

icons.name: tip-of-the-day
icons.label: Tip of the day
icons.intent: Today's tip lights up on the calendar page. Light: the sparkle draws in on itself with a counter-twist, then flares out with a twist and settles, and a small twinkle flashes beside it at the top right. Strong: a deeper gather, a bigger flare and twist with a two-beat settle, and two twinkles flash in turn, right then left. The calendar never moves.

icons.name: welcome-gift
icons.label: Welcome gift
icons.intent: Closed → open. Light: the lid with its bow lifts 4.2 off the box. Strong: the box is pressed 0.5, the lid launches 4.5 and settles at 4.2. Reverse lowers the lid; Strong slams it with a small box squat.

icons.name: first-run
icons.label: First run
icons.intent: Start is clicked and the first run begins. Light: the pointer drives down onto the start button, the button dips under it and rebounds, and the label inside runs like a progress bar from left to right while the pointer lifts away. Strong: the pointer winds up first, strikes harder, the button takes the press with a two-beat settle and the label runs from the moment of contact. Hardware stays rigid.

icons.name: dismiss-tip
icons.label: Dismiss tip
icons.intent: Shown → dismissed. Light: the text and close mark fade, then the card folds into a small pill at the bottom. Strong: a short lift, then the card snaps into the pill with a 6% squash and settles. Reverse expands the pill and fades the details back in.

icons.name: cut-clip
icons.label: Cut clip
icons.intent: Light: the razor glides down through the clip and leaves a cut mark joined to both edges. Strong: it lifts, slams through with the clip dipping on impact, and the mark stays.

icons.name: trim-clip
icons.label: Trim clip
icons.intent: The clip is trimmed. Light: the trim handle cuts 7 units into the clip and stops dead with a small knock, and the 7-unit offcut it leaves behind tips off its cut edge, falls away and fades. Strong: the handle takes a short backswing, cuts in hard and settles in two beats, and the offcut tumbles farther. The clip stays trimmed. The reverse brings the offcut back up into place, then the handle drags the clip back out to full length.

icons.name: transition
icons.label: Transition
icons.intent: A cut becomes a dissolve. Light: the second frame glides up over the first and stops dead in the overlap with a small knock; as it covers it, the first frame dissolves (dims) and comes back up once the second has seated, so one shot fades through the other. Strong: the second frame draws back first, drives in hard and settles in two beats, and the first frame dissolves deeper. The frames stay overlapped. The reverse is a hard cut: the second frame slides straight back out, with no dissolve, and knocks once on arrival.

icons.name: speed-ramp
icons.label: Speed ramp
icons.intent: The speed ramps up. Light: the bead rides the speed curve from slow to fast, picking up speed all the way, and slams into the top, where it is knocked back a little down the curve and seats. Strong: it backs off and hesitates, then takes the ramp much harder (the speed builds faster), slams into the top and is knocked back twice in decaying beats. The bead stays at the top. The preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose. The curve and the clip never move.

icons.name: reverse-clip
icons.label: Reverse clip
icons.intent: The clip now plays backwards. Light: the play mark flips through its axis to point left with a hard stop, then kicks backward 1.6 units with two speed streaks trailing behind it on the right, and eases back to its place as the streaks fade. Strong: it stretches forward first, snaps through past the mirror and settles, kicks back farther with longer streaks, overshoots its place and settles. It stays pointing left. The reverse flips it forward again and it kicks forward once, without streaks. The clip frame never moves.

icons.name: rotate-clip
icons.label: Rotate clip
icons.intent: Light: the 20×12 frame and its play mark turn a quarter turn clockwise into portrait. Strong: a small counter-wind, a fast turn past 90° and a settle back. Reverse turns it back.

icons.name: green-screen
icons.label: Green screen
icons.intent: Light: the backdrop frame retracts into corner brackets and its tint fades, leaving the keyed subject. Strong: the arms stretch out, snap in past the mark and settle. Reverse restores the backdrop.

icons.name: stabilize
icons.label: Stabilize
icons.intent: A shaky shot is locked steady. Light: the frame jitters around the fixed lock ring (1.2 units and 3 degrees, two jolts), then the ring clamps (squeezes in with a hard stop) and the frame stops dead, centred; the ring springs back open and settles. Strong: a longer, bigger shake (1.8 units and 4 degrees, four jolts), a harder clamp, and the ring settles in two beats. The frame never drifts after the clamp. The rest pose is the v1 drawing.

icons.name: thumbnail
icons.label: Thumbnail
icons.intent: A frame is picked for the thumbnail. Light: the picture scrubs: the scene (mountains and sun) is dragged left inside the card, then springs back and knocks into place with a small rebound; the card clicks (a quick squeeze) and a flash lights the card as the frame is set. Strong: the scene leans right first, scrubs further left, knocks into place twice, the card clicks harder and the flash is brighter. The rest pose is the v1 drawing.

icons.name: export-video
icons.label: Export video
icons.intent: The video goes out. Light: the arrow presses into the clip, then launches up a short way with two speed lines streaking out below its barbs, and springs back to seat; the clip recoils down from the push and dips again as the arrow seats. Strong: a deeper press that holds, a higher launch, a bigger recoil, and the arrow seats in two beats. The rest pose is the v1 drawing.

icons.name: resolution
icons.label: Resolution
icons.intent: Light: the extra grid lines grow from the centre lines until the frame holds a 4×4 grid. Strong: verticals snap out first, then horizontals. Reverse retracts them to the 2×2 grid.

icons.name: aspect-ratio
icons.label: Aspect ratio
icons.intent: The frame is cropped to 4:3. Light: crop marks draw in above and below the frame where the new 4:3 edges will be, then both side walls slam in to them, knock back a little and seat; the diagonal follows the corners, and the marks fade once the walls sit under them. Strong: the marks draw in while the wide frame stretches out against them, then the walls slam in and seat in two decaying beats. The frame stays 4:3. The reverse retracts the marks while the walls widen back to 16:9 and knock once on arrival.

icons.name: mute-track
icons.label: Mute track
icons.intent: The track goes silent. Light: the waveform is cut down left to right: each bar drops to a dot on the centre line in turn, 50 ms after the one before, and stops dead there. Strong: the waveform swells into one last loud beat that rolls across the bars, then each is cut to a dot in the same left-to-right order with a hard stop. The dots stay: the track is muted. The reverse raises the bars back out of the dots in the same order. The track frame never moves.

icons.name: voiceover
icons.label: Voiceover
icons.intent: Light: the three level bars rise in a rolling wave and settle. Strong: the microphone bobs and the bars surge 4–5 units in a staggered snap before settling.

icons.name: screen-record
icons.label: Screen record
icons.intent: Light: the record dot grows to fill the ring. Strong: it pops past size with the ring flashing wider, then both settle. Reverse shrinks the dot away.

icons.name: clapperboard
icons.label: Clapperboard
icons.intent: The take is marked with a clap. Light: the clapper snaps open 14 degrees on its hinge, then claps shut with a hard stop; the board jolts down on the clap and springs back, the clapper bounces once, and three short clap lines flick out above its free end and fade. Strong: it opens 20 degrees and holds, then slams shut, bounces twice in decaying beats, and the board takes a bigger jolt. The rest pose is the v1 drawing.

icons.name: merge-clips
icons.label: Merge clips
icons.intent: Two clips are spliced into one. Light: the clips drive together and meet with a hard stop, knock apart a little and seat joined; on contact a splice mark flicks out above and below the seam and fades. Strong: each clip draws back first, then they drive in hard, knock apart twice in decaying beats and seat, with a longer splice mark. They stay joined. The reverse cuts them: the marks draw in at the seam, then the clips spring apart past their places and settle.

icons.name: add-caption
icons.label: Add caption
icons.intent: Light: two caption lines extend smoothly along the bottom of the frame. Strong: they type in word by word with short holds. The caption is retained; preview reset clears it.

icons.name: video-filter
icons.label: Video filter
icons.intent: The filter is applied across the frame. Light: the wipe sweeps 14 units to the right, accelerating, with the filtered region following it, stops dead at the far side with a small knock and seats; a sparkle twinkles on in the filtered picture as the wipe lands and fades. Strong: the wipe pulls back first, sweeps hard, settles in two decaying beats, and the sparkle pops bigger. The frame stays filtered. The reverse sweeps the wipe back and the region shrinks with it, knocking once on arrival.

icons.name: render-progress
icons.label: Render progress
icons.intent: Light: the render bar fills its track steadily. Strong: it fills in three decisive chunks with short holds. The finished bar is retained; preview reset empties it.

icons.name: composing-message
icons.label: Composing message
icons.intent: The message is being typed. Light: the caret sweeps back over the top line, erasing it, then types it out again in three quick keystrokes, sliding right with each character until it is back at its insertion point. Strong: the caret sweeps back a touch past the line's start, types the line in four quicker keystrokes, then blinks twice, waiting for more. The bubble and the lower line never move.

icons.name: message-sent
icons.label: Message sent
icons.intent: Send acknowledgement → a single check enters the receipt lane → it seats → sent is retained. Light: a 2-unit rise over .64 s. Strong: a 3-unit rise with a decisive .30 s arrival. Reverse withdraws the check while the message stays.

icons.name: message-delivered
icons.label: Message delivered
icons.intent: Recipient receives → the second receipt check joins the first → both align → delivered is retained. Light: a 3-unit leftward seat. Strong: a 4.5-unit snap with delayed release. Reverse removes only the second receipt.

icons.name: message-read
icons.label: Message read
icons.intent: Reader opens → the eye opens in the receipt lane → its pupil appears → read is retained. Light: the lid opens smoothly. Strong: the lid opens decisively after a short wait. Reverse closes the lid and removes the pupil.

icons.name: message-reaction
icons.label: Message reaction
icons.intent: React → a heart rises below the message → it settles beside the tail → reaction stays. Light: a 1.6-unit rise. Strong: a 2.4-unit rise and a 14-degree turn. Reverse lowers and removes the heart.

icons.name: quoted-message
icons.label: Quoted message
icons.intent: A quote is inserted. Light: the two quote marks lift and stamp down in turn, left then right, while the quoted line winds back; once both have landed the quoted line draws on beneath them. Strong: the marks lift higher, tipping back, and stamp down with a hit and a second smaller tap; the line draws on after them. The bubble never moves.

icons.name: forward-message
icons.label: Forward message
icons.intent: The message is sent on. Light: the arrow flies off to the right, speeding up and fading as it goes, and a new arrow draws out from under the bubble, its head riding the end of the shaft until it stops dead at its rest point and rebounds once. Strong: the arrow pulls back first, flies off harder, and the new arrow lands with a rebound and a settle. The bubble never moves.

icons.name: pin-message
icons.label: Pin message
icons.intent: Pin command → the pin descends into the upper edge of the chat → its needle seats → pinned is retained. Light: 2 units of insertion. Strong: 2 units with an 18-degree preparation. Reverse lifts the pin out.

icons.name: conversation-history
icons.label: Conversation history
icons.intent: The conversation replays from the top. Light: a quick rewind pulls the two transcript rows back into the history rail (latest first) and the rail winds up toward the top message; then the rail runs down again and each row unrolls out of it as the rail reaches it, in order. Strong: a deeper rewind in which the rows slide into the rail as they wind in, and a replay in which each row slides back out, overshoots and settles. The top message never moves.

icons.name: mute-chat
icons.label: Mute chat
icons.intent: Mute command → a diagonal strike spans the conversation → notifications stop → muted stays. Light: the stroke wipes in over .64 s. Strong: a fast .30 s wipe after .10 s preparation. Reverse retracts the strike.

icons.name: group-chat
icons.label: Group chat
icons.intent: Members talk in one shared conversation. Light: the member on the left ducks and pops up to speak, and a line of words writes itself across the shared bubble from the left, then clears. Strong: the left member speaks and writes the first half of the line; a beat later the right member pops up and finishes it; both land and the line clears. Shoulders follow their heads a little; the bubble never moves.

icons.name: voice-note
icons.label: Voice note
icons.intent: Play recorded note → three waveform bars articulate around a fixed baseline → the recorded clip remains in its pill → playback rests. Light: shallow staggered amplitude. Strong: a larger travelling waveform. This is a saved clip, distinct from live Voice chat.

icons.name: sticker
icons.label: Sticker
icons.intent: The sticker is slapped on and comes alive. Light: it lifts toward you with a slight tilt, slaps down flat with a hit (pressed a little below its size), springs back, and winks. Strong: a higher lift with more tilt, a harder slap that rebounds and settles in two beats, then the wink. The face rides on the sticker; the sticker stays flat and rigid.

icons.name: gif-picker
icons.label: GIF picker
icons.intent: Browsing GIFs flips to the next one. Light: the GIF tile flips over like a split-flap card (it folds flat about its middle and opens again with the next GIF), overshoots a little and settles. Strong: the tile is picked up off the stack, flips through two GIFs in turn, and drops back onto the stack with a hit; the stack dips under it and springs back.

icons.name: edit-message
icons.label: Edit message
icons.intent: Edit → the pen moves along the message baseline → ink extends exactly to its tip → the edited line is retained. Light: a 7.5-unit writing stroke. Strong: the same meaningful stroke arrives in .30 s after preparation. Reverse erases back along the baseline.

icons.name: delete-message
icons.label: Delete message
icons.intent: Delete → two message lines retract into a removal mark → the bubble becomes a deleted-message placeholder → deletion is retained. Light: gradual replacement. Strong: fast leftward removal. Reverse restores the message content.

icons.name: unread-divider
icons.label: Unread divider
icons.intent: The unread boundary is marked. Light: the divider lines wind in toward the centre marker as it hops up, the marker drops back into place with a hit, and the lines snap out of it to both sides while the messages above and below are nudged apart to make room. Strong: a short dip before a higher hop, a landing that bounces, lines that snap out past their ends and spring back, and a firmer push that settles in two beats.

icons.name: archive-chat
icons.label: Archive chat
icons.intent: The chat is filed into the archive tray and stays there. Light: the message lifts a little, drops 7 units into the tray and lands with weight: it pushes the tray down with it, and both spring back once. Strong: a higher lift with a forward tip, a faster drop, and a heavier landing that pushes the tray deeper and settles in two beats. The reverse lifts the message back out of the tray.

icons.name: disappearing-message
icons.label: Disappearing message
icons.intent: The message timer is set. Light: the hourglass flips over (a half turn about its waist) and stops dead with a small rebound; the old sand empties out as it turns, then a stream of sand runs through the waist into the lower chamber and the sand settles there again. Strong: a short wind-up the other way, a harder flip that rebounds and settles in two beats, then the same stream. The hourglass draws in a little while it turns so its corners clear the bubble; the bubble never moves.

icons.name: chat-search
icons.label: Chat search
icons.intent: The search finds the message. Light: the lens sweeps 3 units left beneath the message, swings back and stops dead on its result, then zooms in on it (the magnifier grows from the hand toward the message) and settles. Strong: the lens winds up to the right, sweeps 4 units with its glass trailing, snaps back onto the result and zooms further, settling in two beats. The bubble and its text never move.

icons.name: trophy
icons.label: Trophy
icons.intent: Light: the trophy is raised 1.2 units and set back down. Strong: it crouches, is hoisted 2.6 units with a 3° rock, lands and rebounds once.

icons.name: medal
icons.label: Medal
icons.intent: The medal is won and gleams. Light: the medal swings out 20 degrees on its ribbon knot and, at the top of the swing, its star flashes larger and turns one point before the medal settles. Strong: the medal is knocked back, swings out 30 degrees and rings down through decaying swings while the star flashes twice and turns two points. The ribbon never moves.

icons.name: level-up
icons.label: Level up
icons.intent: Light: the ball hops from the second step up onto the top step. Strong: it crouches, springs higher and faster, lands hard and bounces once. The new level is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: xp-gain
icons.label: XP gain
icons.intent: Light: a star pellet drops onto the progress track, is absorbed and the bar extends from 40% to 85%. Strong: it drops fast, bounces once on the track and the bar drives out sooner. The gained progress is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: streak-flame
icons.label: Streak flame
icons.intent: The streak flares up. Light: the flame gathers low and wide, then flares 14 percent taller and narrower on its base, rebounds and settles, and an ember rises off its right shoulder and fades. Strong: a deeper gather, a 16 percent flare with a lean that swings back through two smaller beats, and two embers rise in turn. The inner tongue rides with the flame.

icons.name: badge-unlock
icons.label: Badge unlock
icons.intent: Unlock: the shackle lifts 1.6 units and swings open 25°, the padlock fades and a star pops into the badge. Strong: a snap lift with overshoot, a hard swing and a bigger star pop. Reverse: the star shrinks away, the lock returns and the shackle drops shut.

icons.name: leaderboard
icons.label: Leaderboard
icons.intent: Light: the three places rise out of a flat stand in order, third, second then first, and a star settles above first place. Strong: each place drives up with a hard stop and overshoot, and the star pops in. The podium is retained; preview reset rearms.

icons.name: dice
icons.label: Dice
icons.intent: The die is rolled. Light: it is tossed 2.4 units, tumbles a half turn in the air (the three-pip diagonal lands on itself), lands flat with a hit and one small bounce, and two impact dashes flash at its feet. Strong: a dip to gather, a 3.2-unit toss with a full tumble, a hard landing with dashes and two decaying bounces with a small rock. The die stays rigid.

icons.name: game-controller
icons.label: Game controller
icons.intent: Light: the top button presses in and the pad dips half a unit under the thumb. Strong: the pad rumbles with a decaying shake while both buttons press in turn.

icons.name: coin
icons.label: Coin
icons.intent: Light: the coin turns once about its vertical axis, going edge-on and back, with a small hop. Strong: it is tossed 4 units, turns twice in the air and lands with a bounce.

icons.name: gem
icons.label: Gem
icons.intent: The gem catches the light. Light: a four-point sparkle twinkles off the upper-right corner, swelling and turning as it fades, and the stone flashes with a pop, rebounds and settles. Strong: the stone gathers, the first sparkle is answered by a second off the upper-left corner, and the stone pops with each, the second pop smaller. Facets stay joined to the rim.

icons.name: treasure-chest
icons.label: Treasure chest
icons.intent: Open: the lid pivots 23 degrees at its left hinge and exposes the full rim. Strong: a brief latch press leads into a 27-degree swing and settles open. Close: a separate return seats the lid; Strong has a small contact rebound.

icons.name: quest
icons.label: Quest
icons.intent: The quest goal is reached. Light: the marker crouches, leaps across the map from the lower-left start to the upper-right goal while the route is traced on the map beneath it, lands with a squash and stays; the route fades once it has arrived. Strong: the marker reaches the goal in two hops, stopping at the halfway point, the route tracing in two legs, and lands harder. Reverse: the route reappears and the marker hops back to the start along it (twice in Strong) as it retracts, landing with a squash.

icons.name: achievement
icons.label: Achievement
icons.intent: The achievement is unlocked. Light: the check ticks itself onto the seal, the whole rosette pops on the last stroke, rebounds and settles, and a ray flashes out from each upper side. Strong: the rosette gathers in while the check ticks, pops harder and settles in two beats, and the diagonal rays are followed by a second pair at the sides. The tails stay attached to the seal.

icons.name: star-rating
icons.label: Star rating
icons.intent: Select: the star rocks and the second and third rating dots fill in sequence. Light uses a 5-degree acknowledgement. Strong winds back and turns 16 degrees before settling. Reverse clears the dots in the opposite order and rocks left.

icons.name: high-score
icons.label: High score
icons.intent: A new record is set. Light: the 1 is written on the display, flag stroke first, then its foot, and the crown jumps 2.1 units off the display with a tilt and lands back with a hit and one small bounce. Strong: the crown jumps higher (2.2), twirls one way then the other and lands with two decaying bounces. The crown only rises, so its gap above the display never closes, and the display never moves.

icons.name: bonus
icons.label: Bonus
icons.intent: The bonus multiplier is applied. Light: the times sign winds back and spins a quarter turn onto itself, flashing larger as it turns, then the 2 hops and lands with a squash. Strong: the sign spins a half turn with an overshoot and settle, and the 2 hops twice, the second hop smaller, landing with a squash each time: the bonus doubles. The ticket stays still.

icons.name: power-up
icons.label: Power up
icons.intent: The power-up charges and strikes. Light: the bolt draws up 1.5 units and squeezes in to gather charge, then strikes down past its seat with a surge to 1.2, rebounds and settles. Strong: the bolt crackles (a quick buzz of turns) as it draws up higher, strikes harder with a bigger surge, and settles through two smaller beats. The capsule never moves and the bolt keeps at least 2.3 from the capsule's centreline (set 54's one-unit painted gap).

icons.name: lives
icons.label: Lives
icons.intent: The lives count off. Light: the main heart beats once, and the beat runs down the line: the left reserve heart hops and lands, then the right one. Strong: the main heart draws in and gives a strong beat with a smaller echo, and each reserve heart hops higher in turn once the beat has passed, lands with a squash and a small bounce.

icons.name: round-countdown
icons.label: Round countdown
icons.intent: The round runs out. Light: the crown button is pressed, the hand sweeps 270 degrees from twelve to nine o'clock and stops dead there, and the watch jolts once as time is up; the hand stays at nine. Strong: a harder press, a faster sweep, and the watch rings like an alarm, rocking about its hub through decaying swings. Reverse: the button is pressed again and the hand snaps back to twelve with a small jolt. The hand never leaves the hub and never overshoots its reading.

icons.name: api-key
icons.label: API key
icons.intent: Authorize an app: the key goes in, turns, and the code opens. Light: the key pushes in 2 units and stops with a hit, then turns on its shaft (its profile closes up toward the shaft line, as a key seen side-on does when it turns); a beat later the code brackets spring apart and settle, and the key turns back and withdraws. Strong: the key draws back first, drives in 2.5 with a hit and a rebound, turns further, and the brackets spring wider with a bounce. The brackets never leave their rows; the key stays rigid.

icons.name: endpoint
icons.label: Endpoint
icons.intent: Connect a configured endpoint. Light: the plug drives 5 units into the socket and seats with a hit and a small rebound; the socket takes the shock and its live light flicks on inside it, then fades. Strong: the plug draws back first, rams home with a hit, a rebound and a second hit; the socket is knocked twice and the light blinks twice (a handshake). The plug stays seated (connected). The reverse pulls the plug back out, tugging the socket as it releases; no light.

icons.name: rate-limit
icons.label: Rate limit
icons.intent: Requests are throttled. Light: the first packet rushes the closed gate, hits it and is knocked back to the queue; the packet behind follows and is held short of the gate; the gate shudders on its foot from the impact and settles. Strong: both packets wind up and rush the gate in turn, each hits and is thrown back past its place before settling, and the gate shudders twice. The foot never moves; the gate stays rigid and only rocks on its base.

icons.name: token-counter
icons.label: Token counter
icons.intent: Count token groups on two abacus rails. Light slides each bead 3.5 units; Strong drives each 8 units with staggered contact. The full beads slide along the rails and return to the starting tally.

icons.name: request-timeout
icons.label: Request timeout
icons.intent: A request runs out of time. Light: the request line clears and runs out again along its path while the timer hand sweeps one full lap; as the lap closes the line reaches its end and the stop at the time boundary shudders. Strong: the hand winds back first, laps and knocks at the top with a rebound, the timer rattles like an alarm, and the stop shudders harder. The hand ends a whole turn from where it started; an invisible step returns it to 0 so the end matches the rest pixel for pixel.

icons.name: model-card
icons.label: Model card
icons.intent: Inspect a model specification. Light: the model emblem on the card turns a quarter (a gem turned to show its other face) and lands with a click, and the specification lines are written out beneath it in order. Strong: the emblem winds back, turns a half with a pop, knocks and settles, and the lines write out with a longer stagger. The card never moves. A 90 or 180 degree turn of the four-fold emblem ends on its own outline; an invisible step returns the angle to 0 so the end matches the rest pixel for pixel.

icons.name: open-weights
icons.label: Open weights
icons.intent: Make the parameter weights accessible. Light: the shackle springs open 38 degrees about its right foot, swinging a little past and settling, and the three weight columns inside hop up in turn as they are released. Strong: the shackle is pressed shut first, springs open past its stop and settles with a bounce, and the columns hop higher with a small second bounce. The shackle stays open (accessible). The reverse closes it: the shackle swings shut and latches with a hit and a click, and the columns are pressed down in turn.

icons.name: model-picker
icons.label: Model picker
icons.intent: Choose the second model. Light: the selection chevron drops 14 units to the second option and lands with a hit and a small rebound, then clicks it: the chevron pokes in and the option is pushed back a step and settles. Strong: the chevron lifts first, dives, knocks twice, and the click pushes the option further with a recoil. The chevron stays at the second option. The reverse climbs back to the first option and clicks it the same way.

icons.name: provider-switch
icons.label: Provider switch
icons.intent: Switch the active provider. Light: the selector contact runs 16 units along the rail and lands under provider B with a hit and a small rebound; B's lead drops to meet it and B's status light pops on. Strong: the contact backs up first, crosses fast, knocks twice; the lead engages twice and the light blinks twice. The contact stays under B. The reverse runs back to A and A engages the same way. The cabinets never move.

icons.name: latency-meter
icons.label: Latency meter
icons.intent: Measure a round trip. Light: the duration bar resets, the request arrow shoots out and stops with a hit, the destination node takes it (a quick squeeze), the reply arrow shoots back and the source node takes it; the duration bar grows through the trip and stops dead as the reply lands. Strong: each arrow gathers before it shoots, travels further and knocks with a rebound, and the nodes squeeze harder. Endpoints never leave their places.

icons.name: cost-estimate
icons.label: Cost estimate
icons.intent: The cost is worked out. Light: the two approximate figures on the slip are written out in turn, then the coin is tossed: it rises, flips once in the air (its face closes to an edge and opens again) and lands with a clink and a small rebound. Strong: the figures write out, the coin dips before the toss, rises higher, flips twice and lands with two decaying knocks. The slip never moves; the coin stays rigid, only seen edge-on as it flips.

icons.name: temperature-dial
icons.label: Temperature dial
icons.intent: Set sampling temperature with a rotary knob. Light turns from minus 60 to plus 60 degrees; Strong prepares 13 degrees, turns decisively and settles 7 degrees back. Reverse returns to the low setting. Outer setting marks remain fixed.

icons.name: top-p
icons.label: Top P
icons.intent: Set the nucleus cutoff. Light: the cutoff marker is pulled out along the tail of the distribution, snaps back to its threshold with a hit, and the nucleus it keeps (the area under the curve up to the cutoff) lights up and fades. Strong: the marker is pulled further down the tail, snaps back, knocks twice, and the nucleus lights up twice with the knocks. The marker's top stays on the density curve throughout (a morph between two points on the curve; between them the chord is within 0.2 of the curve).

icons.name: max-tokens
icons.label: Max tokens
icons.intent: Set a hard output length. Light: the end bracket slams 5 units in toward the output and stops dead at the new limit with a small rebound; the output rows flinch back from it in turn (longest row first) and settle. Strong: the bracket is pulled back first, slams in, rebounds and hits again; the rows flinch harder and twice. The bracket never passes the new limit (no overshoot on the value) and stays there. The reverse: the bracket is pressed in to release, then swings back out to the large limit and lands; the rows breathe out after it.

icons.name: seed-lock
icons.label: Seed lock
icons.intent: Lock a repeatable random seed. Light: the open shackle swings 30 degrees shut onto the die and latches with a hit and a small click back; the whole lock dips under the impact and recovers. Strong: the shackle opens a little further first, slams shut, clicks twice, and the lock takes two decaying dips. The shackle stays shut (locked). The reverse unlocks: the shackle is pressed down to release, springs open past its stop and settles, and the lock lifts as it lets go. The die's three pips never move on the die.

icons.name: api-quota
icons.label: API quota
icons.intent: A request spends one permit from the allowance. Light: the middle permit is drawn out to the right, leaving a speed line in its slot, and snaps back into the stack with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: the permit is gripped (a short pull back) and yanked further out, snaps back with a hit and a second smaller knock, and the permits above and below flinch apart as it seats.

icons.name: model-status
icons.label: Model status
icons.intent: Enable a ready model: the flat diagnostic line becomes a heartbeat and the status lamp fills. Light grows the signal steadily; Strong drives the complete waveform in 0.34 seconds. Reverse returns to the flat offline signal; housing and lamp rim remain visible.

icons.name: fallback-model
icons.label: Fallback model
icons.intent: Use the reserve model after a primary failure: the upper status stroke turns to a slash while an elbow path reaches the lower backup card. Light extends the route steadily; Strong makes the complete downward handoff in 0.38 seconds. Reverse clears the handoff and restores the primary.

icons.name: prompt-cache-hit
icons.label: Prompt cache hit
icons.intent: Reuse cached prompt work: a check draws inside the stored-result card above a fixed cache tray. Light draws in 0.61 seconds; Strong draws in 0.26 seconds while the card lifts 0.65 units and catches once. Reverse retracts the check; the complete card and tray remain visible.

icons.name: multimodal-input
icons.label: Multimodal input
icons.intent: Accept image and audio together. Light: the image drops into the mouth of the input tray and stops with a hit, then the waveform bars drop in after it one by one; the tray dips under each arrival and springs back, and both inputs lift back to their places. Strong: each input gathers (a small lift) before it drops, knocks twice on arrival, and the tray takes three decaying dips. The tray stays rigid; only its position answers the weight.

icons.name: epoch-counter
icons.label: Epoch counter
icons.intent: A training pass completes and the counter registers it. Light: the two cycle arrows run one lap, each taking the other's place, overshoot a little and settle; as the lap lands the counter ticks, swelling and settling. Strong: the arrows wind back, run two laps with a stop between, and the counter ticks on each, the second harder. The tally never changes shape; the arrows end exactly where they started.

icons.name: loss-curve
icons.label: Loss curve
icons.intent: Training lowers the loss. Light: the latest loss point drops ten units in one move and stops dead, the trace bending down with it, while a faint copy of the old point stays behind for a moment and fades, showing how far it fell. Strong: two training steps: the point drops most of the way, pauses, then drops the rest; the old point lingers longer. The loss is data and never overshoots; the axes never move.

icons.name: learning-rate
icons.label: Learning rate
icons.intent: The learning rate steps down on its schedule. Light: the second step size drops to its shorter length and stops dead, and the third follows a beat later and drops further. Strong: a step decay in two milestones: at the first both later steps drop to the middle length in turn, and at the second the last step halves again. The first step stays fixed; the sizes are data and never overshoot.

icons.name: gradient-step
icons.label: Gradient step
icons.intent: The parameter takes one step downhill. Light: the gradient vector thrusts along its direction and springs back, and the parameter block hops down one stair, landing on the next tread with a hit and a small rebound; then it is carried back up in one quick straight glide and set down on the top tread. Strong: the vector winds back and thrusts harder, and the block hops down two stairs, landing on each, before a quick glide carries it home while the vector ducks back out of its way. The stairs never move.

icons.name: overfitting
icons.label: Overfitting
icons.intent: A fitted curve flexes around three fixed observations in a plot window. Light adds a restrained 1.8-unit wave; Strong pulls the fit 3.7 units around the samples, releases it and settles. Observation points and the window never move.

icons.name: validation-split
icons.label: Validation split
icons.intent: A validation block is held out of the data. Light: the bottom block slides out four units to the right and stops dead, and the two training blocks answer a beat later, shifting two units left in turn. Strong: the held-out block tugs left first, then pulls out past its place and settles back, while the training blocks lean in, then shift left in turn with a hit and a small rebound. The blocks keep their sizes; the partition stays.

icons.name: data-augmentation
icons.label: Data augmentation
icons.intent: A transformed copy is made from the source image. Light: a copy of the source frame lifts off it, flies up to the second view while it twists and straightens, shrinking to fit, and lands on it; the view swells as the copy merges and settles. Strong: two copies leave in turn, twisting one way and then the other, and the view takes each arrival. The source never moves; the copies are gone when the action ends.

icons.name: data-labeling
icons.label: Data labeling
icons.intent: The label is hung on the selected record. Light: the tag drops nine units down the record's edge to the selected record and stops dead; it hangs from its hook, so it swings on, down and back, and settles. Strong: the tag lifts off its first record, drops harder, swings wider and settles in two swings. The connector stays hooked to the record edge and the tag stays on the selected record.

icons.name: gpu-cluster
icons.label: GPU cluster
icons.intent: The cluster exchanges its results around the ring. Light: every module sends a packet to its neighbour at once, clockwise; the packets run along the four links and each module swells as its packet lands, then settles. Strong: the modules gather themselves, then two exchange rounds run back to back, the first landing harder. The links never move; the packets are gone when the action ends.

icons.name: hyperparameter
icons.label: Hyperparameter
icons.intent: Three independent parameter handles sweep candidate values and return to the selected configuration. Light explores 2.5 units; Strong prepares against each direction and explores six units with a staggered response. Rails stop at each handle boundary, preserving the open counters.

icons.name: early-stopping
icons.label: Early stopping
icons.intent: Training is stopped where the loss flattens. Light: the stop block drops thirteen units onto the end of the flat loss trace and slams down with a hit; the trace gives under it and springs back, and the block rebounds a little and settles on the plateau. Strong: the block lifts first, drops harder, bounces once and lands again, and the trace gives under each impact. The axes never move; the block stays down on the plateau.

icons.name: distillation
icons.label: Distillation
icons.intent: A knowledge packet passes through a wide teacher funnel into a small student receiver. Light sends one packet over 0.76 s; Strong sends two faster packets. Each packet leaves the channel before an invisible recycle; the funnel and receiver remain visible throughout.

icons.name: adapter-layer
icons.label: Adapter layer
icons.intent: An adapter is inserted between two frozen model layers and the stack clamps onto it. Light: the adapter drives left four units, seats with a hit and a small recoil, and as it seats the upper and lower layers close in on it and let go. Strong: the adapter draws back first, drives in harder, rebounds off its seat and seats again; the layers clamp on each impact, the second smaller. The adapter stays inserted; the layers end where they started.

icons.name: reward-model
icons.label: Reward model
icons.intent: The reward model scores the outputs and rewards the better one. Light: the reward star spins one point and stops with a small overshoot, and the preferred output on the right jumps up and lands with a hit. Strong: the star winds back and spins two points with a settle; the preferred output jumps higher and bounces once while the other output sinks a little and recovers. The star ends on its exact starting angle.

icons.name: benchmark-score
icons.label: Benchmark score
icons.intent: The measured score climbs and beats the benchmark. Light: the score bar rises in one push and stops dead at its new height; as its top passes the benchmark level the benchmark rule reaches across toward it, marking the crossing, and draws back. Strong: the bar climbs, stalls just under the benchmark, then breaks through to its score; the rule reaches across at the crossing and holds a beat before drawing back. The score never overshoots; the baseline never moves.

icons.name: tokenizer
icons.label: Tokenizer
icons.intent: The word is cut into tokens. Light: two cuts draw down through the word's boundaries, and as they fade the three cells spring apart into separate tokens and stop dead. Strong: the left cut lands, then the right, and the cells spring apart with a small overshoot and settle. The word line never moves; the tokens stay separate.

icons.name: quantize
icons.label: Quantize
icons.intent: Continuous values snap to discrete levels. Light: the slope snaps into three steps in one decisive move and stops dead, and as it locks the three level cells click down in order, left to right, and spring back. Strong: the slope steps partway and pauses, then locks into its levels, and the cells click harder in order with a small settle. The signal is data and never overshoots; the cells end where they started.

icons.name: pretrained-weights
icons.label: Pretrained weights
icons.intent: The stored weights are loaded. Light: the load arrow drives down and stops dead, springing back, and the four stored coefficients light up one after another in reading order, each swelling and settling. Strong: the arrow rises first and drives down harder, the cartridge takes the load with a dip and a rebound, and the coefficients light up in order, larger. The shelf never moves; the coefficients stay rigid in the cartridge.

icons.name: data-shuffle
icons.label: Data shuffle
icons.intent: Three sample packets are mixed in opposing horizontal lanes. Light makes one two-unit exchange; Strong crosses four units, mixes back through a second shorter pass and parks the packets. Each packet remains rigid and its vertical lane remains clear.

icons.name: convergence
icons.label: Convergence
icons.intent: The error closes and the run locks onto its target. Light: the upper and lower trajectories bend in toward the target in one move and stop dead in the narrow band; as they arrive the target ring takes the hit, swelling and settling. Strong: two training steps: the trajectories close most of the error and pause, then close the rest; the target answers each arrival, the last time harder with a two-swing settle. The starting observations stay fixed and the error never overshoots.

icons.name: boolean-union
icons.label: Boolean union
icons.intent: Two overlapping square operands select the combined area. Light: a quiet separation then a smooth selection. Strong: both operands draw apart 1.2 units and snap together before the result holds. Reverse restores both operands with its own timing.

icons.name: boolean-subtract
icons.label: Boolean subtract
icons.intent: Two overlapping square operands select the first area outside the second. Light: a quiet separation then a smooth selection. Strong: both operands draw apart 1.2 units and snap together before the result holds. Reverse restores both operands with its own timing.

icons.name: boolean-intersect
icons.label: Boolean intersect
icons.intent: Two overlapping square operands select the shared area. Light: a quiet separation then a smooth selection. Strong: both operands draw apart 1.2 units and snap together before the result holds. Reverse restores both operands with its own timing.

icons.name: boolean-exclude
icons.label: Boolean exclude
icons.intent: Two overlapping square operands select the two areas outside their overlap. Light: a quiet separation then a smooth selection. Strong: both operands draw apart 1.2 units and snap together before the result holds. Reverse restores both operands with its own timing.

icons.name: outline-stroke
icons.label: Outline stroke
icons.intent: Convert a curved stroke to an editable closed ribbon. Light: the two boundaries separate quietly. Strong: the ribbon opens 1.4 units farther before settling into the same outlined path. Reverse closes the ribbon back onto the source stroke.

icons.name: offset-path
icons.label: Offset path
icons.intent: The source pushes its offset out. Light: a copy of the source's outline ripples outward and fades as it reaches the offset contour, which is pushed out by the wave, rebounds and settles. Strong: two ripples leave the source in turn and the offset takes two decaying pushes. The source never moves.

icons.name: join-paths
icons.label: Join paths
icons.intent: Two open endpoints snap together into one node. Light: the endpoints are drawn toward each other, speeding up like magnets, meet at the shared node with a hit, and the welded node pops once and settles. Strong: they pull back first, then snap together harder and the welded node pops bigger with a rebound. The reverse pulls the joint apart. The arch's feet never move; the joined path holds.

icons.name: simplify-path
icons.label: Simplify path
icons.intent: Reduce a bumpy five-node path to a smooth arch with three anchors. Light: unnecessary bends relax. Strong: the bends open farther before a rapid smooth reduction. Reverse restores the original editable path.

icons.name: stroke-dash
icons.label: Stroke dash
icons.intent: The dash pattern runs along the stroke. Light: the top row of dashes marches one full dash period to the right, the last dash slipping out at the row's end while a new one grows in at its start, and the second row follows 80 ms behind; both land a touch past the period and settle. Strong: the rows draw back first, then march harder, overshoot further and settle in two beats. The source stroke swatch never moves.

icons.name: auto-layout
icons.label: Auto layout
icons.intent: Three free child objects become an evenly padded row inside their container. Light: each child moves directly into place. Strong: the outer children prepare in opposite directions and the row closes quickly. Reverse restores the free positions.

icons.name: component-instance
icons.label: Component instance
icons.intent: An edit to the main component reaches its instance. Light: the main component is pressed in and pops back bigger; the connector pulls back into it and shoots out to the instance, and the instance replays the same pop as the change arrives. Strong: the main component is pressed deeper and pops with a twist and a rebound, the change travels down the connector, and the instance replays every beat of it. The connector's corner never moves.

icons.name: detach-instance
icons.label: Detach instance
icons.intent: Separate an instance from its source while preserving both objects. Light: the connector retracts and the instance moves away. Strong: it prepares toward the source, then pulls 2.2 units clear. Reverse reconnects the two cells.

icons.name: pin-constraints
icons.label: Pin constraints
icons.intent: The child is pinned to the container's left and top edges. Light: both pins pull back into the edges, then shoot out to the child in turn, left then top, and the child clicks into place with a pop when the second pin lands. Strong: the pins lock on faster and the child pops harder, then the container's top-left corner is dragged out and the pinned child rides along with its edges, springs back with it and settles. The container's bottom-right corner never moves.

icons.name: artboard-frame
icons.label: Artboard frame
icons.intent: A frame is drawn out from its origin, the way the frame tool makes one. Light: the board snaps down to a small square at its fixed upper-left origin, then is dragged back out to full size, lands a little past it and settles; the frame ticks ride on the moving edges. Strong: it snaps smaller and is flung out further, past its size, then pulls back and settles in two beats. The upper-left ticks never move.

icons.name: export-slice
icons.label: Export slice
icons.intent: A copy of the selected slice is exported. Light: the tile presses down and a copy of it springs up out of the open region, shrinking as it goes, and disappears into the export arrow, which kicks up as it arrives and settles. Strong: two copies leave in turn (two export sizes), the tile presses for each and the arrow kicks twice, harder the second time. The region marks never move.

icons.name: vectorize-image
icons.label: Vectorize image
icons.intent: Convert a stair-stepped raster silhouette to a smooth editable vector curve. Light: the stepped edge resolves into the curve. Strong: the pixels spread slightly before a quick trace. Reverse restores the visible raster silhouette.

icons.name: blend-steps
icons.label: Blend steps
icons.intent: The in-between step is generated from the circle. Light: the middle step slides back into the circle, turning round as it goes, the circle gulps it and kicks it back out, and it travels along the blend to its place, changing shape on the way, overshoots toward the square and settles. Strong: the circle kicks harder, the step flies further toward the square and swings back to its place in two decaying beats. The square never moves.

icons.name: gradient-stops
icons.label: Gradient stops
icons.intent: Dragging the middle colour stop re-flows the gradient. Light: the stop is grabbed (it swells), dragged 4 units right along the ramp and stops dead; the colour boundary above follows a beat later, so the mid tone spreads, then both ease home as the stop is let go. Strong: a small tug left, a longer drag right that stops dead, and on release the stop snaps home past its place and settles in two decaying beats, the boundary a beat behind. The frame and the two end stops never move.

icons.name: convert-to-curves
icons.label: Convert to curves
icons.intent: Inspect an outlined letter as editable curve nodes. Light: three node squares separate one unit and seat back on their anchors. Strong: the nodes travel 2.5 units before seating. The full letter silhouette remains visible throughout.

icons.name: path-direction
icons.label: Path direction
icons.intent: The path shows which way it winds. Light: the tangent arrow runs one full lap clockwise along the contour, each anchor point pops in turn as the arrow passes it (bottom, then left), and the arrow lands back on top with a small settle. Strong: the arrow draws back first, runs the lap faster, overshoots the top and settles, and the anchors pop harder. The closed path never moves; the arrow ends exactly where it started.

icons.name: turn-taking
icons.label: Turn taking
icons.intent: The caller yields the floor and the agent takes it. Light: the floor token hops up inside the caller's bubble, swells and drops out through its bottom, falls on a curve into the agent's bubble, landing with a hit; the agent's bubble pops as it takes the floor and settles. Strong: the token gathers higher, the caller's bubble recoils as it lets go, the token lands with a bounce, and the agent's bubble pops harder. Reverse: the token is tossed back up into the caller's bubble, which pops as it takes the floor again.

icons.name: barge-in
icons.label: Barge in
icons.intent: Caller speech enters beneath the speaking agent. The incoming arrow reaches the agent bubble and its output bars stop. Strong briefly raises the output before cutting it off. Reverse releases the interruption and restores speech.

icons.name: end-of-turn-detection
icons.label: End of turn detection
icons.intent: A trailing utterance reaches its end boundary. The final syllable contracts while the end gate closes. Light settles over 0.78 s; Strong briefly gathers the syllable and closes the gate decisively. Reverse opens a new turn.

icons.name: backchannel
icons.label: Backchannel
icons.intent: While the caller keeps talking, the listener chimes in with a brief mm-hm and never takes the floor. Light: the small acknowledgement bubble pops up from its tail (it swells, snaps back with a hit and settles), saying one quick mm. Strong: it says uh-huh, two pops in a row, the second smaller. The main utterance stays steady throughout.

icons.name: speaker-diarization
icons.label: Speaker diarization
icons.intent: Two speakers take turns and each one's speech lands in its own lane. Light: speaker A's marker pops and the three segment bars on A's lane swell in turn; then speaker B answers, its marker pops and B's bars swell in turn. Strong: each speaker says two syllables, the bars swelling twice, with a clear gap between the turns. Nothing changes lanes and the lanes never move.

icons.name: live-transcript
icons.label: Live transcript
icons.intent: A live utterance appends text under two committed transcript lines. The caret leads the new line and the text remains. Light writes evenly; Strong accelerates through the full line after a short input beat. Reverse removes this transcript segment.

icons.name: call-summary
icons.label: Call summary
icons.intent: Two call utterances converge into a compact summary. The branch junction stays attached while summary rows form. Light condenses steadily; Strong gathers both inputs and writes the result with a faster main stroke. Reverse clears the summary.

icons.name: sentiment-meter
icons.label: Sentiment meter
icons.intent: The caller's sentiment reads positive and the face answers it. Light: the marker slides four units toward positive and stops there (a reading, so no overshoot); a beat later the flat mouth curves into a smile and the face lifts, bounces and settles, then the reading and the face ease back to neutral. Strong: the reading climbs in two steps, and the face smiles a little, then breaks into a wide grin with a happy bounce before both return to neutral.

icons.name: intent-confirmation
icons.label: Intent confirmation
icons.intent: The agent asks the caller to confirm an interpreted intent. The question resolves into a full check in the same utterance. Light traces the check calmly; Strong makes one decisive stroke. Reverse restores the question.

icons.name: language-detection
icons.label: Language detection
icons.intent: The detector samples the utterance and recognises its language. Light: the detector sweeps ten units along the sampling rail; as it reaches the end, the language glyph is identified and pops (it swells with its crossbar, snaps back and settles), and the detector glides home. Strong: the detector draws back before a faster sweep, and the glyph pops harder with a second, smaller swing. The speech card never moves.

icons.name: silence-timeout
icons.label: Silence timeout
icons.intent: Nobody speaks, the waiting interval runs out and the timeout fires. Light: the clock's long hand sweeps one full lap and stops dead back at twelve; the clock rings, rocking on its base and settling. Strong: the hand ticks back before a faster lap, and the clock rings harder with more swings. The quiet utterance and the waiting dash never move.

icons.name: dtmf-input
icons.label: DTMF input
icons.intent: A keypad key is pressed and sounds its dual tone. Light: the key is pushed in (it shrinks into the panel with a hit) and springs back; a beat later both tone waves ring at once, their amplitude swelling and decaying, the low tone in one slow swing and the high tone in quicker flutters. Strong: the key lifts a touch before a harder press, and both tones ring louder and longer. The waves never leave their lines.

icons.name: on-hold
icons.label: On hold
icons.intent: The call is parked on hold. Light: the receiver is set down 1.5 units onto its rest with a hit and a small bounce, then the pause sign rises out of the two dots, the left bar first and the right one just after, each overshooting a touch and settling. Strong: the receiver is lifted first and set down harder with a double bounce, and the bars shoot up further before settling. Reverse: the pause bars collapse back into dots, right then left, and the receiver is picked up again.

icons.name: recording-consent
icons.label: Recording consent
icons.intent: Caller permission enables call recording. The permission check is drawn while the recording dot becomes active. Light confirms in 0.78 s; Strong commits with one faster full check. Reverse withdraws consent.

icons.name: ivr-menu
icons.label: IVR menu
icons.intent: The phone menu routes the caller into the chosen option. Light: the route token swells into a bead you can see on the line, runs down the trunk, turns at the junction, runs along the right branch and drops into option two, shrinking as it lands with a hit; the option box pops to confirm the choice. Strong: the bead waits at the junction and leans toward option one before it commits, drives right and drops in, and the box pops harder with a settle. Reverse: the bead lifts out of option two and runs back up the route to the menu.

icons.name: speech-buffer
icons.label: Speech buffer
icons.intent: A queued speech chunk feeds the agent output, is consumed, and the queue refills. Light delivers the chunk over 0.58 s. Strong prepares then drives the full 15.5-unit path in 0.26 s. Refill occurs only while the packet is invisible.

icons.name: agent-persona
icons.label: Agent persona
icons.intent: The character mask comes alive and speaks in its persona. Light: the smile opens into a broad grin and the eyes lift with it, then the voice arc beside the mask pulses out toward the caller; the face relaxes back to its rest expression. Strong: the persona says two words, the grin opening twice (wider the second time) and the voice arc pulsing with each. The mask itself never moves.

icons.name: concurrent-calls
icons.label: Concurrent calls
icons.intent: Three live call lanes carry utterances at the same time. Both endpoints remain fixed while independent packets traverse their lanes. Light moves 2 units; Strong drives 3.2 units with staggered responses.

icons.name: escalation-flag
icons.label: Escalation flag
icons.intent: A call issue is escalated: the problem call shakes, then the flag is hoisted to the top of the pole and catches the wind. Light: the call bubble gives a quick alarm shake, the flag runs ten units up the fixed pole, stops dead at the top and flutters, settling flat. Strong: the bubble shakes harder, the flag gathers low, is hoisted past the top and settles back onto it, and flutters longer. Reverse: the flag is lowered down the pole and lands at its old place; the call does not shake again.

icons.name: voicemail-detection
icons.label: Voicemail detection
icons.intent: An answering-machine greeting plays and the detector recognises it. Light: the three greeting syllables swell in turn, left to right; the pupil glances to the first and follows them across, then snaps back to centre and dilates: machine detected. Strong: the greeting plays two phrases, the pupil searches wider, and the recognition beat is bigger with a second, smaller swing. The greeting card and the eye outline never move.

icons.name: face-with-tears-of-joy
icons.label: Face with tears of joy
icons.intent: Laughing so hard that tears burst out. Light: one laugh kicks the head up and it lands, and a fresh tear spurts out of each eye-corner tear in a short arc outward and down, then fades. Strong: the head dips first, then two laugh beats (the second smaller) tip it back and forth, the grin opens wider on the first beat and the tears spurt farther.

icons.name: red-heart
icons.label: Red heart
icons.intent: The heart beats and sends love out. Light: one lub-dub about its centre: a squeeze, a swell, a smaller second swell, landing on rest, and three short rays flick out round the top on the first beat and fade. Strong: a deeper squeeze before a bigger beat, the rays flicking farther, then a second and a third, smaller, beat before it rests.

icons.name: rolling-on-the-floor-laughing
icons.label: Rolling on the floor laughing
icons.intent: Laughing so hard it rolls over. The tilted tears-of-joy face rocks back, then rolls one whole turn on the spot, flinging a droplet off each tear as it spins. Light: a slight rock back and one even turn. Strong: a deeper wind-up, a faster turn that travels a little and hops, a landing bounce, and the tears flung farther.

icons.name: thumbs-up
icons.label: Thumbs up
icons.intent: Approval given: a fist with its thumb up jabs upward. Light: the hand dips and tips back a little to wind up, jabs about 2 units up with the thumb leading, stops with a hit and settles back down. Strong: a deeper wind-up tipped back, a higher jab that tilts the thumb forward, hits and rebounds, and two short sparks flash off the thumb tip at the hit.

icons.name: loudly-crying-face
icons.label: Loudly crying face
icons.intent: A sob with streaming tears. Light: the mouth opens wider in one wail while a bead runs down each tear stream to the jaw and drips off. Strong: the head shudders with two sob beats (a quick dip and recoil, decaying), the mouth wails wider on each, and two waves of tears run down and drip off the jaw.

icons.name: folded-hands
icons.label: Folded hands
icons.intent: A thank-you bow: two palms pressed together, fingers up, sleeves at the wrists. Light: the hands press together (a little taller and narrower), then bow toward the viewer, foreshortening down onto the wrists, as three short glow rays appear above the fingertips and fade; they rise back to rest. Strong: a firmer press, a deeper bow, a quick rise and a second, smaller bow, and the rays reach farther.

icons.name: face-blowing-a-kiss
icons.label: Face blowing a kiss
icons.intent: The kiss is blown. Light: the puckered lips push, the heart lifts off them and floats up and to the right, swells with one beat as two small hearts puff out toward the upper right, then drops back to the lips with a small pulse. Strong: the face draws back, then leans into the kiss as the lips push harder; the heart flies higher with a small turn and beats twice, puffing out a small heart on each beat, then lands back at the lips and the face settles.

icons.name: smiling-face-with-hearts
icons.label: Smiling face with hearts
icons.intent: Hearts pop around the smiling head. Light: the smile widens and the three hearts pop in turn round the head, lower left, upper left, upper right, 80 ms apart, each swelling past its size and settling. Strong: the face tilts happily as the smile widens further; the hearts dip and pop bigger in turn while they drift a little way round the head and back.

icons.name: smiling-face-with-heart-eyes
icons.label: Smiling face with heart-eyes
icons.intent: The heart eyes pump with love. Light: the heart eyes beat once, a swell and a smaller second swell (lub-dub), while the grin opens a little. Strong: the heart eyes draw in, then pop out bigger and beat twice as the face lifts and the grin opens wider; the face drops back with a small settle.

icons.name: smiling-face-with-smiling-eyes
icons.label: Smiling face with smiling eyes
icons.intent: A warm smile spreads and the cheeks blush. Light: the smile widens from its centre and two blush marks fade in on the cheeks under the smiling eyes and out again as the smile settles. Strong: the face lifts and tips toward its right shoulder as the smile widens further, the blush lingers, and the head drops back with a small settle.

icons.name: party-popper
icons.label: Party popper
icons.intent: The popper pops. Light: the cone kicks back about its base, a burst of confetti flies out of the mouth along arcs and fades, and the streamer shoots out again. Strong: the cone aims first, kicks back harder and rebounds, more confetti flies farther, and a second, smaller burst follows.

icons.name: beaming-face-with-smiling-eyes
icons.label: Beaming face with smiling eyes
icons.intent: The grin beams. Light: the wide grin spreads from its centre and a beat later the cheeks lift the whole face a little, then it relaxes. Strong: the face dips, pops up and lands with a short settle as the grin spreads further.

icons.name: two-hearts
icons.label: Two hearts
icons.intent: Two hearts flutter up together like love bubbles. Light: the large heart beats once, and 100 ms later the small heart rises, tipping as it goes, and lands back with a little tilt. Strong: the large heart dips and rises with a beat, then the small one floats up higher, swinging from side to side; each lands with a soft settle.

icons.name: pleading-face
icons.label: Pleading face
icons.intent: Puppy eyes. Light: the big eyes well up, swelling bigger as the brows lift, then settle. Strong: the eyes squeeze a little first, then swell bigger with the brows lifting higher, a tear wells at the lower lid of one eye and fades, and the face trembles before it settles.

icons.name: grinning-face-with-sweat
icons.label: Grinning face with sweat
icons.intent: A nervous laugh: the sweat runs. Light: the sweat drop at the temple swells and slides a little way down the side of the face while the face gives a small nervous chuckle; a small droplet breaks off it and drips away, and the drop slips back up and settles. Strong: the face winces first, dipping and squashing, then the drop swells more and slides farther in two jerks, catching hard so the droplet flies off, with a second smaller chuckle.

icons.name: fire
icons.label: Fire
icons.intent: The fire roars up. Light: the inner flame gathers and surges up inside the outer one while the three tongues lick upward in turn, left, middle, right, and an ember rises off the top and fades. Strong: a bigger surge with the whole flame leaning on its base, the tongues licking higher and once more, two embers rising, then a settle.

icons.name: person-facepalming
icons.label: Person facepalming
icons.intent: A facepalm. Light: the hand lifts off the face a little and slaps back with a hit, and the head nods back with the impact. Strong: the hand presses in, lifts further off, slaps back hard; the head recoils and rocks back, and two impact ticks flash off the back of the hand.

icons.name: person-shrugging
icons.label: Person shrugging
icons.intent: A shrug, ¯\_(ツ)_/¯. Light: both open palms pop up together with a hit as the shoulders lift, while the head dips and tilts, then everything settles. Strong: the arms dip first, then the palms rise higher with a bounce, the head tilts further, the eyebrows lift, and everything settles back.

icons.name: face-with-rolling-eyes
icons.label: Face with rolling eyes
icons.intent: An eye roll. Light: the pupils roll one whole circuit round the inside of the eyes, from the top and back to it, as the head tips back a little. Strong: the pupils wind back first, then roll slower and further, overshooting the top and settling, while the head tips back further and the mouth slides to one side in a sigh.

icons.name: grinning-squinting-face
icons.label: Grinning squinting face
icons.intent: A burst of laughter. Light: the squinting eyes squeeze shut harder as the face hops once and lands, the grin opening on the hop. Strong: three quick laugh hops, each smaller, the grin opening on each, the eyes squeezed tight throughout, and short laugh lines flicking out at the upper sides of the head as the first two land.
